intro: The etlh class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.
042 was a Federation worker bee that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the Federation starship Discovery. ()

208 was the registry number of an emergency evac jumpship in service to Starfleet in London, on Earth, in 2259. At that time, it was reported that 208 had been commandeered by following his bombing of the Kelvin Memorial Archive in London.

title: 313-C
intro: 313-C was the designation of a Constitution-type escape pod in 2258.
5 was the registry number of a shuttlecraft that was in service in 2381.

title: AQF sequencer
intro: An AQF sequencer was a component on the 's bridge.

title: ATW-11
intro: ATW-11 was a 32nd century Federation shuttlecraft operated by Starfleet.

title: AWOL Falls
intro: AWOL Falls was a Latinum Elite Guest experience near the indoor water park on the Cosmic Duchess. It offered extended happy hour on Mondays.

title: Abaddon's space station
intro: Abaddon's space station functioned as the hub of Abaddon's Repository of Lost Treasures. This space station was where Abaddon lived. It also housed his miscellaneous pieces of merchandise. ()

title: Ablative generator
intro: Ablative generators were an advanced armor technology used by Starfleet. Shield emitters generated a nearly-impenetrable layer of Ablative armor around the hull of a ship so equipped. This defensive technology was acquired by the crew of in 2378 from Admiral Kathryn Janeway of an alternate timeline. ()

title: Abronian ship
intro: The Abronian ship was a small spacecraft used by the Abronians. Large numbers of them were stored aboard the moon that the Abronians had converted into a starship to save their species from a supernova.

title: Academy class
intro: The Academy-class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 32nd century. ()

title: Academy class decks
intro: The turbolift display provided an overview of navigation, from levels 1 through 10, sub level a1 through a7, and decks 1 through 35. Not all decks were accessible from all turbolifts. (, et al.)

title: Academy trainer craft

infobox.name: Academy trainer craft
infobox.caption: Forward view
infobox.image3: Academy trainer craft, port aft view.jpg

intro: The Academy trainer craft was a type of agile sublight spacecraft flown by Starfleet Academy cadets as flight training vessels, that were also utilized for competitive or demonstrative purposes.

title: Accelerometer relay
intro: An accelerometer relay was a component aboard starships such as the .

title: Access point
intro: An access point was a connection between corridors and decks with maintenance shafts and Jefferies tubes aboard a starship.

title: Access port
intro: An access port was any type of panel which granted access to another area on a starship or space station, or to a computer interface. Such access ports were built into holodecks, for use in accessing ship's systems from within the holographic environment. ()

title: Access tunnel
intro: Access tunnels or access conduits were tunnels used for accessing various systems and portions of space-borne starships or stations. These passageways were also sometimes referred to as access ducts, maintenance ducts, or power conduits.

title: Actuator circuit
intro: An actuator circuit was an engineering component on Vulcan starships and Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttles. Aboard the latter vessel, the port actuator was a switch in the craft's cockpit, on the port bulkhead.

title: Adonis
intro: Adonis was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .

title: Aeon
intro: The Aeon was a 29th century Model HB-88 Federation timeship operated by Starfleet. It was capable of traveling through time via generation of temporal rifts. Captain Braxton was the commanding officer of the ship.

title: Aeroshuttle
intro: An aeroshuttle was a runabout-sized spacecraft embedded in the saucer underside of , , and starships, and detached to Starfleet starbases in the 2370s and 2380s.

title: Agena target vehicle
intro: The Agena target vehicle (or ATV) was an unmanned spacecraft that was in service to NASA in the mid-1960s. This vehicle was used for developing and practicing orbital rendezvous between spacecraft in the Gemini Program. This was an essential step in the preparation up to the Apollo program. The first successful docking of an Agena test vehicle to a manned spacecraft occurred on March 16, 1966 during the Gemini 8 mission. On approach, the crew of Gemini 8 photographed the vehicle's profile as it orbited over Earth.

title: Airlock
intro: An airlock was the point of entry to a space station or starship which allowed ingress and egress to empty space or another vessel which had docked at the portal.

title: Airponics bay
intro: An airponics bay also known as "Aeroponics" was a facility that utilized suspended growing mediums to cultivate plants and fungi. Often a section of a starship or dwelling were used for decorative, scientific, but mainly mainstay production of agricultural foodstuffs.

title: Aisle
intro: An aisle was a path where people could walk between seats or shelves.

intro: The Akira-class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s.

title: Akritirian cargo vessel
intro: An Akritirian cargo vessel (also called a Akritirian freighter) was a type of freighter used by the Akritirians during the 24th century. The vessel was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.

title: Akritirian maximum security detention facility
intro: The Akritirian maximum security detention facility was a space station used as a prison, operated by the Akritirian government, located somewhere in their space.

title: Akritirian patrol ship
intro: The Akritirian patrol ship was a type of starship used by the Akritirians to enforce laws in their space.

title: Aksani vessel
intro: The Aksani vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Aksani during the late 24th century.

title: Al-Leyan transport
intro: An Al-Leyan transport was a type of transport utilized during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Aldara
intro: The Aldara was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century. In the late 2360s, the Aldara was under the command of Gul Danar.

title: Aldebaran III
intro: Aldebaran III was the inhabited third planet in the Aldebaran system. Located in the Beta Quadrant, this planet was approximately 67 light years from Sol. (; , okudagram)

title: Algonquin
intro: The Algonquin was a Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 24th century.

title: Alice (ship)
intro: Alice was the name that Tom Paris gave to an alien shuttlecraft he bought from Abaddon's Repository of Lost Treasures in the Delta Quadrant. The ship's computer contained a program that could manifest itself as a person to its pilot. ()

title: Alignment module
intro: An alignment module was a component aboard Federation starships such as the .

title: Alita class
intro: The Alita class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.

infobox.image: Maquis attack wing gearing up for action.jpg
infobox.caption: Alpha Nine somewhere in the mix

intro: Alpha Nine was the designation for a ship used by the Maquis in a joint attack of a Yridian convoy in 2370.

intro: Alpha Seven was the designation for a Maquis fighter in 2370.

title: Alvarez (shuttle)
intro: The Alvarez (NCC-1701/13) was a Stamets-type Federation shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the 23rd century. It was attached to the , with the number 13.

title: Amargosa observatory

infobox.caption2: A level-12 shock wave approaches the observatory

intro: The Amargosa observatory was a Federation K-7D space station operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. The observatory was located in orbit of the star Amargosa and was used for scientific research regarding the star. Its coordinates were 917358-358268-102879.

title: Ambassador class
intro: The Ambassador-class starship was a type of heavy cruiser in service with Starfleet during the mid- to late-24th century. ()

title: Analysis sector
intro: The analysis sector was among one of the departmental subdivisions utilized aboard Federation starships during the mid-23rd century.

title: Andorian battle cruiser
intro: The Andorian battle cruiser was a type of warship in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the mid-22nd century through the late 24th century.

title: Andorian cruiser
intro: The Andorian cruiser was a type of small cruiser and support ship that was in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the 22nd century.

title: Andorian escape pod
intro: An Andorian escape pod was a type of emergency vessel-escape vehicle used by the Andorian Imperial Guard in their vessels during the 22nd century, particularly in Andorian battle cruisers.

title: Andorian freighter (22nd century)
intro: Andorian freighters were cargo vessels commonly used in the Andorian Empire during the 22nd century.

title: Andorian freighter (24th century)
intro: Andorian freighters were freighter used by the Andorians during the 24th century.

title: Andorian renegade ship
intro: The Andorian renegade ship was operated by Andorian renegades in the Triangulum system.

title: Andorian ship

infobox.name: Andorian ship
infobox.caption: A scan of the surface and the vessel

intro: An Andorian ship was a type of transport operated by the Andorian Imperial Guard for the Andorian Empire in the mid-22nd century.

title: Andorian shuttle

infobox.name: Andorian shuttle
infobox.caption: Shran contacts ''Enterprise'' from his Andorian shuttle

intro: The Andorian shuttle was a small shuttlecraft operated by the Andorians in the mid-22nd century.

title: Andorian starship
intro: This Andorian starship was a type of armed starship operated by the Andorians during the 24th century. This class's body was based on the Andorian battle cruiser space frame but also included the tail fin similar to that found on the smaller Andorian cruiser.

title: Andorian transport
intro: An Andorian transport was a type of transport operating under an Andorian registry.

title: Angel's shuttle
intro: Angel's shuttle was a small warp-capable shuttle operated by the pirate .

title: Angelo-1
intro: The Angelo-1 was a 23rd century Federation surveillance probe.

title: Angelou class
intro: The Angelou class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st and 32nd centuries. It featured a torus-shaped design that supported a rainforest ecosystem within a transparent exterior. ()

title: Angosian escape pod
intro: The Angosian escape pod was a type of escape pod used by Angosian police shuttles.

infobox.caption3: The interior of an Angosian police shuttle

intro: The Angosian police shuttle was a type of small police vessel utilized by the Angosians to transport prisoners. It had a cockpit designed for two operators and at least two additional compartments.

title: Ankari vessel
intro: The Ankari vessel was a class of starship used by the Ankari in the late-24th century. Vessels of this type used a form of propulsion that was difficult for normal sensors to detect.

title: Annari warship (2372)
intro: The Annari warship was a vessel designed for armed conflict used by the Annari in the early 2370s.

title: Annari warship (2377)
intro: A class of Annari warship was utilized by the Annari in the late 2370s.

title: Anodyne relay
intro: An anodyne relay, or anodyne circuit, was a piece of technology used for various purposes on Federation starships.

title: Anomaly storage room
intro: The anomaly storage room (also called the anomaly room) was a compartment on Federation starships where objects awaiting further study or return to their previous entities were stored. Access was restricted to lieutenants junior grade or higher, due to the objects' often-dangerous nature.

intro: The Ansel Adams was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 06, and was not equipped with warp drive.

title: Antares
intro: The Antares (NCC-501) was a 23rd century Federation starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Antares class
intro: The Antares class cruiser was a type of starship operated by civilians, sometimes independently, in and around the United Earth colonies, throughout the , and by the Petarians.

title: Antares class (Corvallen)
intro: The Antares-class freighter was an old-style warp-capable freighter utilized by the Corvallens during the 24th century.

title: Antares class (carrier)
intro: The Antares class was a type of spacecraft used by the Bajorans and the Cardassians as transports, freighters, and low-capability warships during and after the Occupation of Bajor.

intro: The Antares-type was a small, multipurpose 23rd century Federation starship identified as a survey ship, transport, cargo, science-probe vessel, or ore freighter.

title: Antares type (32nd century)
intro: The Antares type was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century. This class was notable for having four nacelles.

title: Antarian starship
intro: The Antarian starship was a type of warp-capable starship utilized by the Antarians, who employed the class in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.

title: Antidean transport
intro: An Antidean transport was a type of transport used by the Antideans.

title: Antimatter storage
intro: The antimatter storage was a spacecraft section reserved for storing antimatter in the starships in the late 23rd century. It was located in the lowest decks of the secondary hull, in the vicinity of the antimatter fill port and antimatter generator.

title: Antimatter storage system
intro: The antimatter storage system was a component of a starship used to safely contain antimatter.

title: Apergosian shuttle
intro: The Apergosian shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Apergosians during the 2380s.

title: Apollo 11
intro: Apollo 11 was an American Apollo Program spacecraft that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. This craft carried the astronauts Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins to Luna. Apollo 11 was launched atop a Saturn V rocket from Cape Kennedy. The original launch time was set for 6 am Eastern Standard Time on a Wednesday. (; )

title: Apollo class
intro: The Apollo-class was a class of Federation starship in operation during the 24th century.

title: Apollo spacecraft

infobox.name: Apollo spacecraft
infobox.caption: Apollo Command/Service Module and Lunar Module

intro: The Apollo spacecraft was a type of 20th century Earth spacecraft used by the United States of America during the 1960s and 1970s. The Apollo spacecraft, which consisted of three primary components, was propelled into space by means of a rocket. In the Apollo program, it was responsible for successfully placing a man in orbit of Earth and the moon, as well as conducting several successful moon landings. After the last mission on Luna, the spacecraft was responsible for transporting astronauts to the space station Skylab.

title: Aqua-shuttle
intro: The aqua-shuttle was a type of Federation shuttle stowed aboard the shuttlebay of vessels during the late 2260s.

title: Aquarius class
intro: The Aquarius class was a 24th and 25th century Federation starship class used as an auxiliary escort vessel, which was embedded within the aft section of starships.

title: Aquatics lab
intro: The aquatics lab was a facility on board the .

title: Arboretum
intro: The arboretum was a botanic garden with trees as its dominant feature. While arboretums were normally on planetary surfaces, they were built and found on board several Federation starship classes, like the , , and . (; ; )

title: Arcade
intro: An arcade was a gaming establishment where arcade games could be ed. ()

title: Archanis IV Research Outpost
intro: The Archanis IV Research Outpost was an apparent research station located on the Beta Quadrant planet Archanis IV during the mid-23rd century.

title: Archer Spacedock
intro: Archer Spacedock was a spacedock constructed by the Federation near its Headquarters in 3190. Its purpose was to upgrade the existing fleet and construct the next generation of Starfleet vessels.

title: Archimedes (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Archimedes (NCC-1701/08) was a Stamets-type Federation shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the 23rd century. It was attached to the .

title: Archive vault
intro: The archive vault was a location aboard the in the .

title: Archon (starship)
intro: The Archon was a 22nd century Federation starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Arcos
intro: The Arcos was an Federation freighter that was in service during the mid-24th century. Tan Tsu served aboard the Arcos in the 2360s.

title: Arctic One

infobox.caption: Arctic One at the Arctic Circle
infobox.name: ''Arctic One''

intro: Arctic One was the designation for a United Earth transport that was in service diring the mid-22nd century. In 2153, this starship was assigned to the A-6 excavation team, an Arctic Archaeology Team, a branch of the Earth Sciences Institute, for an exploration of Earth's Arctic Circle.

title: Arctic One type

infobox.name: ''Arctic One'' type
infobox.caption: Vessel of the class at the Arctic Circle

intro: The Arctic One type was a type of transport used by the Earth Sciences Institute during the 2150s. Their maximum speed was warp 1.4.

title: Ardanan shuttle

infobox.name: Ardanan shuttle
infobox.caption: A power relay from an old Ardanan shuttle

intro: An Ardanan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Ardanans prior to the mid-22nd century.

title: Ardra's ship
intro: Ardra's ship was a starship active in the 24th century that was utilized by a con artist posing as Ardra. The ship functioned as 's base of operations during her many ruses throughout the sector. It was manned by a crew.

title: Areore ship (large)
intro: The Areore ship was a type of large starship used by the ancient Areore in their interstellar wars. It was similar in design to the more common smaller Areore ship, and armed with a more powerful version of its energy weapon. The ship could land on a planetary surface.

title: Areore ship (small)
intro: The Areore ship was a type of small starship used by the ancient Areore in their interstellar wars. It was equipped with deflector shields and potent energy weapons of a design unknown to the Federation in the 24th century.

title: Ares IV

infobox.caption: The Ares IV command module in orbit over Mars
infobox.name: ''Ares IV''
infobox.caption2: The lander module on the surface of Mars

intro: Ares IV was an Earth spacecraft used during one of Humanity's early manned missions to Mars, which took place in 2032 under the command of Lieutenant John Kelly. The other members of the crew were Rose Kumagawa and Andrei Novakovich.

title: Ares V
intro: The Ares V was an American expendable rocket used by NASA in the early 21st century.

title: Argo (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Argo was a Federation Type 17 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the .

title: Argus Array

infobox.caption2: A graphic of the Argus Array

intro: The Argus Array (full name: Argus Subspace Radio Telescope Array) was a Federation subspace telescope in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Ariane 1
intro: The Ariane 1 was an European rocket that was in service with the ESA in the late 20th century. This rocket was the first of the Ariane family. In 2143, an assignment patch for this rocket was displayed in the 602 Club. ()

title: Ariel (23rd century)
intro: The Ariel was a 23rd century Federation starship operated by Starfleet.

intro: Arkaria Base was an outpost located on the planet Arkaria that controlled the orbiting Remmler Array, used for baryon sweeps. The base was run by Starfleet Commander Calvin Hutchinson until 2369, when he was murdered.

infobox.name: Arkonian military vessel
infobox.caption: Front view of an Arkonian military vessel
infobox.caption2: Rear view of an Arkonian military vessel

intro: An Arkonian military vessel was a type of military vessel utilized by the Arkonian military during the mid-22nd century.

title: Arkonian patrol ship
intro: An Arkonian patrol ship was a type of patrol ship utilized by the Arkonian military. These one-manned vessels easily outclassed Earth Starfleet s.

title: Armory
intro: The armory, arsenal, weapons room, or weapons bay of a starship or other facility was a secured location in which weapons and other offensive or defensive devices were stored to prevent unauthorized personnel from gaining access. A starship usually had only one armory. On some vessels, armories held photon torpedoes and other ship-based weapons.

title: Armstrong (shuttlepod)

infobox.caption: The Armstrong listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Armstrong''

intro: The Armstrong was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 15.

title: Armstrong type
intro: The Armstrong-type was a type of starship used by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This type was unique for Starfleet in that some of its ships were painted brown.

title: Arretan vessel
intro: The Arretan vessel was a type of ancient starship used by Arretan 6,000 centuries before 2268. With a size equivalent to the , this vessel was powered by an engine the size of a walnut. She, and her sister ships, were used for colonization and exploration. Their travels were documented in records, which were lost in the war which destroyed the species' and their homeworld. ()

title: Arridor's shuttle
intro: Arridor's shuttle was a Ferengi pod originally attached to DaiMon Goss's Marauder during the 2360s.

title: Artifact (Borg cube)
intro: The Artifact was a disabled Borg cube that was abandoned in Romulan space by the Borg Collective during the late 24th century and later captured by the Romulan Free State.

title: Artificial gravity generator
intro: The artificial gravity generator was a major component of the artificial gravity system aboard starships and shuttles. The artificial gravity generator changed the environment of a starship from zero gravity to artificial gravity, using the vessel's gravity plating.

title: Artificial gravity grid
intro: The artificial gravity grid was a series of interconnected artificial gravity-producing devices.

title: Artificial satellite
intro: An artificial satellite was a man-made form of technology that was put in orbit around a planet. () They had countless applications, including defense, weather forecasting, surveillance, and communication, and were used by many cultures.

title: Assault class
intro: The Assault-class was a type of starship utilized by the Hierarchy in the 24th century, equipped with advanced short and long range sensors, including micro-tunneling sensors.

title: Assault probe
intro: An assault probe was a type of probe thought to have been carried by the in the historical holoprogram The Voyager Encounter at the Museum of Kyrian Heritage in the 31st century.

title: Assimilation chamber
intro: An assimilation chamber was a section on a Borg vessel where the assimilation of an individual or group of individuals into the Borg Collective was performed. ()

title: Asteroid mining pod
intro: An asteroid mining pod was a type of spacecraft used to mine asteroids for natural resources. Such pods were operated by the Automated Personnel Units created by the Pralor species.

title: Asteroid ship
intro: An asteroid ship, or asteroid vessel, was a type of generational spaceship built to resemble an asteroid. An example of this type was the Yonada. ()

title: Asteroid-runner
intro: An asteroid-runner was a type of 22nd century spacecraft that used an axis coil for navigation.

title: Astral Queen
intro: The Astral Queen was a Federation transport.

title: Astrogator
intro: An astrogator was a device used for astrogation: navigation through space. Typically, they were located between the helm and navigation stations at the forward section of the bridge.

title: Astrometrics
intro: Astrometrics was a specialized lab used aboard starships and facilities for stellar cartography purposes.

title: Astronomical section
intro: The astronomical section was among one of the departmental subdivisions utilized aboard Federation starships during the mid-23rd century.

title: Astrophysics laboratory
intro: The astrophysics laboratory was a lab dedicated to the study of astrophysics, found aboard Federation starships during the 23rd and 24th centuries.

title: Astrosciences
intro: Astrosciences was a science found aboard Federation starships during the 2260s.

title: Athena shuttle 5
intro: Shuttle 5 was a shuttlecraft carried by the .

title: Atlantis (OV-104)
intro: Atlantis (OV-104) was an American space shuttle orbiter that was operated by NASA from the 1980s to the 2000s. On one of its many missions, the ship serviced the International Space Station, delivering a spacehab module. In 2011, it was retired along with the other surviving shuttles from the first generation of space shuttles. ( opening credits; )

title: Atlantis (starship)
intro: The Atlantis was a Federation starship that was in the service of Starfleet during the late 24th century.

title: Atlas-Agena

infobox.name: Atlas-Agena
infobox.caption: The ascent sequence of an Atlas-Agena carrying a Ranger probe.

intro: The Atlas-Agena was an American expendable rocket that was in service with NASA diring the mid-20th century.

title: Atlec vessel
intro: The Atlec vessel was a Class 7 interplanetary vessel used by the Atlec government in the mid 24th century.

title: Atmospheric probe
intro: Atmospheric probes were Starfleet probes carried aboard the .

title: Attack fighter
intro: In starship classification, an attack fighter, also known as a fighter, attack flier, or attack ship, was a relatively small, maneuverable, and heavily armed starship. It was primarily used as support craft designed to carry out assaults that larger vessels, such as ships or vessels such as attack cruisers could not perform. ()

title: Attack satellite
intro: An attack satellite was a type of artificial satellite that could be used in an offensive capacity.

title: Attack vessel
intro: An attack vessel, assault vessel, or assault ship was a type of warship, typically of the same type as a cruiser or destroyer. The term attack cruiser was applied specifically to the Klingon attack cruiser.

title: Auditorium
intro: An auditorium was a room where people gathered in large numbers to hear and watch performances.

title: Aurora (NC-17740)
intro: The Aurora (NC-17740) was a 23rd century Federation Class J space cruiser. ()

title: Auto-destruct
intro: The auto-destruct system (also known as self-destruct or destruct sequence) was a starship and space station system that allowed the total destruction of the vessel. This was typically activated as a last resort, usually to prevent a ship from falling into enemy hands.

title: Auto-destruct sequencer
intro: An auto-destruct sequencer was a device aboard Romulan starships used to engage auto-destruct.

title: Automated repair station

infobox.caption: The automated repair station
infobox.caption2: Tubes that adjust to the size of new vessels

intro: The automated repair station was an automated alien space station operational in the 22nd century which repaired vessels for payment. The civilization that built the station was not widely known during this time.

title: Automation center
intro: The automation center was a component of Federation starships, responsible for computer-controlling the vast number of critical systems responsible for the necessary functions of the vessel.

title: Auxiliary control center
intro: The auxiliary control center was a section aboard starships which acted as a supplemental control center to the bridge and main engineering. If necessary, a starship could be controlled from this room alone.

title: Auxiliary hatch
intro: An auxiliary hatch was a sort of emergency hatch, used when the main hatch was not accessible.

title: Auxiliary replicator system
intro: When Geordi La Forge was brainwashed by the Romulans in late 2367, he routed energy from the auxiliary replicator systems to a cargo transporter in cargo bay 4 in order to transport weapons down to rebels on Krios and not be detected. ()

title: Auxiliary space vessel
intro: In starship classification, an auxiliary space vehicle, also known as a support craft, landing craft, or launch vehicle was any vehicle capable of spaceflight that was attached to a mother ship that assisted in missions and environments unsuitable for starships. The term would also be applied to any small vessel that worked independently or was incapable of space travel. The most popular form of auxiliary craft attached to starships and starbases were shuttlecraft.

title: Axanar Starbase Terminal
intro: Axanar Starbase Terminal was a Federation starbase.

title: Axanar cargo ship
intro: The Axanar cargo ship was a type of freighter used by the Axanar during the mid-22nd century. Crewed by as many as fifteen, a typical ship of this type was approximately ninety-two meters in length, and had a hull comprised of tritanium and disilicon polymers.

title: Axanar warship
intro: The Axanar warship was a type of warship used by the Axanar during the mid-22nd century.

title: Axis coil
intro: An axis coil was a steering component used aboard asteroid-runners.

title: B'omar patrol ship
intro: The B'omar patrol ship was a type of small starship used by the B'omar Sovereignty to guard B'omar space. It was armed with directed energy weapons and torpedoes, and protected by shields. Tactically, it was inferior to a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft.

title: B-24-CLN
intro: B-24-CLN was a Federation starship decommissioned by 2368.

title: B-25

infobox.caption: B-25 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

intro: The B-25 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the .

title: BA-36
intro: The BA-36 was a Federation Takayama-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: BBI-993
intro: The BBI-993 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. They were in use as early as 2137. ( okudagram)

title: BC 011

infobox.name: BC 011
infobox.caption: Dorsal view, over the USS Enterprise-D

intro: "BC 011" was the ship classification given by Starfleet Operations to a mercenary vessel operated, for a time in 2369 and 2370, by Arctus Baran. ()

title: BCD
intro: BCD was a registry prefix for Iyaaran shuttlecraft.

title: BCD-31775
intro: BCD-31775 was the registry of an Iyaaran shuttle, operated by Ambassador Voval.

title: BDR
intro: BDR was a three-letter prefix used for Federation civilian starships in the 24th century.

title: Ba'Neth ship
intro: The Ba'Neth ship was a type of starship utilized by the Ba'Neth, a xenophobic species in the Delta Quadrant, first discovered in 2376.

title: Ba'Neth space station
intro: The Ba'Neth space station was a type of armed outpost operated as a hub by the Delta Quadrant species Ba'Neth.

title: Ba'ul fighter
intro: The Ba'ul fighter was a type of small, warp-capable attack fighter built by the Ba'ul. It was flown by a single pilot and mounted directed energy weaponry.

title: Ba'ul sentry ship
intro: The Ba'ul sentry ship was a type of starship used by the Ba'ul to defend their homeworld of Kaminar. They were much larger than a Federation starship, and featured multiple weapons emplacements that extended outward when active.

title: Backup system
intro: A backup system was a means of restoring lost computer or functionality, including the operations on a starship or space station.

title: Bahrat's space station

infobox.location:
On the border of the [[Nekrit Expanse]]
[[Delta Quadrant]]

intro: Bahrat's space station was a supply depot for mining and trading ships located on the border of the Nekrit Expanse. It was located in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Bajoran cargo shuttle
intro: A Bajoran cargo shuttle was a type of cargo shuttle used by the Bajorans.

title: Bajoran interceptor
intro: Bajoran interceptors or Bajoran patrol ships, were a type of impulse ship often utilized as interceptors by the Bajoran Militia, that were lightly armed with two phaser emitters. The vessels also had towing facilities. (; ) It was generally believed by Commander Benjamin Sisko that a Starfleet runabout could handle a Bajoran patrol. ()

title: Bajoran interplanetary shuttle
intro: A Bajoran interplanetary shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by Bajorans for traveling between destinations in the Bajor system in the 24th century.

title: Bajoran lightship

infobox.name: Bajoran lightship
infobox.caption: Aft view
infobox.crew: Could be operated by a single individual

intro: A Bajoran lightship was a type of early Bajoran spacecraft, partially constructed of lumber, which utilized solar sail-powered spaceflight.

title: Bajoran raider

infobox.name: Sub-impulse raider
infobox.caption: Stored at the Lunar V base

intro: Bajoran raiders, or more specifically sub-impulse raiders, were antiquated, lightly-armed sub-impulse powered raiders used by the Bajorans during the mid-24th century.

title: Bajoran science probe
intro: The Bajoran science probe was a type of probe used by the Bajorans in the late 24th century. Following the discovery of the Bajoran wormhole, Bajor sent several science probes into the Gamma Quadrant.

title: Bajoran transport
intro: A Bajoran transport was a type of warp-capable transport utilized by the Bajorans following the Occupation of Bajor.

intro: The Bajoran vessel was a versatile type of spacecraft utilized by the Bajoran Militia as an assault vessel, scout ship, and transport during the late-24th century.

title: Ballast
intro: Ballast was material that enabled a vessel to maintain stability.

title: Banean warship
intro: The Banean warship was a class of ship used by the Banea in the late-24th century.

title: Baraam
intro: The Baraam was a space station in operation during the 24th century, serving as a luxury entertainment venue with a nightclub and guest accommodations. The station was constantly surrounded by a large number of small spacecraft and was equipped with warp drive.

title: Barbershop
intro: A barbershop was a place where individuals, particularly males, went to have their hair cut, shaved, or styled by a barber. Barbershops were sometimes identified by a barber pole. ()

title: Bardeen
intro: The Bardeen (70172) was a Federation military shuttle that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: Bardeezan merchant ship
intro: Bardeezan merchant ships were freighters utilized by the Bardeezans during the 24th century.

title: Barkano
intro: The Barkano was a Cardassian transport ship that was in service in the mid-24th century.

title: Barolian freighter
intro: A Barolian freighter was a type of freighter utilized by the Barolians for conducting trade during the mid-24th century.

title: Barradas III
intro: Barradas III was the uninhabited third planet in the Barradas system. It was the sole Class M world in its system. This system was located in Sector 2158, Beta Quadrant.

title: Barzai
intro: The Barzai was a Denobulan medical ship that was in service in the latter half of the 22nd century.

title: Barzan probe
intro: The Barzan probe was an automated probe sent into the Barzan wormhole in early 2366.

title: Base 755
intro: Base 755 was an Emerald Chain outpost in 3189. This was their closest base to the Federation Headquarters.

title: Basketball court
intro: A basketball court was an area where basketball was played.

title: Bathroom
intro: A bathroom, also known as a restroom, toilet facility, lavatory, head, or refresher (also known, colloquially, as a fresher), was a room that generally contained a toilet, and could also contain any of the following: sink, shower/sonic shower, or a bath tub. These fixtures were then connected to a sewage and waste reclamation system via which waste products and water were recycled.

title: Batlh class
intro: The Batlh class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

title: Batris
intro: The Batris was a Talarian freighter that was in service in the mid-24th century.

title: Battle bridge
intro: The battle bridge was a secondary bridge located on Federation starships.

title: Battle cruiser
intro: In traditional terminology, a battle cruiser was any large armed cruiser (or warship) with battleship armament and fast speed, that carried lighter armor than a battleship.

title: Battleship
intro: In starship classification, battleships were a type of large and powerful warship. Based on old naval maritime terms, a battleship was the largest, heaviest armed vessel in a fleet. In conventional terms, battleships were the most powerfully armed and most heavily armored warships of their era. It is likely that the definition was still true among starships, although standards may have varied by species and technological level.

title: Bavali Station
intro: Bavali Station was a Federation fuel refinery constructed by Starfleet in 2259. Located at the frontier of known space inside the deuterium-rich Bannon's Nebula, the outpost was expected to unlock "half the quadrant" for a new age of exploration. It was also positioned to counter recent expansionism by the Gorn, due to its proximity to their territory.

title: Bavali Station type escape pod
intro: The Bavali Station type escape pod was a type of escape pod used by Starfleet aboard space stations such as Bavali Station during the mid-23rd century.

title: Baxial
intro: The Baxial was a Talaxian freighter that was in service in the late 24th century. In the 2370s, the Baxial was owned by Neelix. During his stay aboard the , the Baxial was stored in the starship's shuttlebay. ()

title: Beagle type
intro: The Beagle-type was an early Earth starship from a parallel universe used for exploring different quantum realities, rather than the galaxy.

title: Bedroom
intro: A bedroom, or bed chamber, was a room in one's home where one's bed was located. It served as a place for sleeping, playing, sex and storage of personal items such as clothing.

title: Bela Tyken
intro: Bela Tyken was a Melthusian captain who first encountered the rare space anomaly which came to be known as a Tyken's Rift sometime before 2367.

title: Belak
intro: The Belak was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Tal Shiar in the late 24th century. The Belaks cloaking device was modified to prevent detection by Dominion sensors at speeds under warp 6.

title: Bellerophon class
intro: The Bellerophon class was a class of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 23rd century. ()

title: Benkaran shuttle
intro: A Benkaran shuttle was a starship operated by the Benkarans in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Benthan fighter ship
intro: The Benthan fighter ships were starships used by the Benthan Guard. They were equipped with phasers and tractor beams.

title: Benzite ship
intro: A Benzite ship was a type of starship in the 24th century. One of the regulations observed aboard these ships, contrary to that aboard Federation starships, was that no officer would report an out of the ordinary occurrence until he had a full analysis and resolution.

title: Berengaria VII

infobox.name: Berengaria VII
infobox.ocaption: Berengaria VII specifically labeled on a star chart

intro: Berengaria VII, also known as Berengaria, was the inhabited seventh planet in the Berengarius system, Alpha Quadrant.

infobox.image: Berman and Piller in Enterprise-D main shuttlebay.jpg
infobox.name: ''Berman''

intro: Berman was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .

infobox.name: Bersallis III
infobox.scaption: The surface of Bersallis III during a firestorm

intro: Bersallis III was the third planet in the Bersallis system. This planet was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. Until 2369, this planet was home to a Federation science station.

title: Bersallis III science station
intro: The Bersallis III science station was a Federation research station on the planet Bersallis III in the mid-24th century.

title: Binary matrix
intro: A binary matrix was a computer technology component that could be found aboard starships.

title: Bio-hazard locker
intro: A bio-hazard locker was a containment compartment used aboard , for the purpose of storing material that could be hazardous or toxic to the crew.

title: Bio-matter resequencer
intro: A bio-matter resequencer was a device which recycled waste aboard 22nd century starships such as . In this process, waste matter was sterilized and broken down for reuse in manufacturing boots, cargo containers, insulation, and other necessities. ()

title: Biochemistry lab
intro: The biochemistry lab was a section of devoted to the study of biochemistry.

title: Biopsy lab
intro: A biopsy lab was a room where tissue samples taken from patients were analyzed.

title: Bird-of-Prey
intro: In starship classification, a Bird-of-Prey was a type of smaller warship, essentially smaller warbirds. Generally they resembled large predatory birds. (; )

title: Birdseye type
intro: The Birdseye-type space module was a type of artificial satellite used during the late 20th century and in the late 24th century.

title: Blade (ship)
intro: A blade was a structural component, found on Cardassian and warships, which housed the ship's warp nacelles.

title: Blast shutter
intro: A blast shutter or blast door were a feature of the cockpit windows of Class F shuttlecraft and runabouts that could be closed to protect the inhabitants from external threats.

title: Blood bank
intro: A blood bank was a facility where emergency supplies of blood were collected and stored.

title: Blowscreen
intro: A blowscreen was a component of Federation refitted starships in the 23rd century found within Jefferies tubes.

title: Body enhancement facility
intro: The body enhancement facility was a section aboard Ru'afo's flagship which was used to genetically enhance the Son'a by removing toxins from their body and tightening their skin. Tarlac and Ellora nurses operated the machines and performed the enhancement. ()

title: Bok'Nor
intro: The Bok'Nor was a Cardassian freighter that was in service in 2370.

title: Bok'Nor type

infobox.name: ''Bok'Nor'' type
infobox.caption: Vessel of the class, docked at Deep Space 9

intro: The Bok'Nor-type of Cardassian freighter was a starship used by the Cardassians during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Bolian freighter
intro: A Bolian freighter was a type of freighter utilized by the Bolians during the mid-24th century.

title: Bolian transport
intro: A Bolian transport was a type of transport operated by the Bolians during the late 24th century.

title: Bolian vessel
intro: A Bolian vessel was a type of starship operated by the Bolians during the 2370s.

title: Bolt-coupling
intro: A bolt-coupling was a form of joint. It held hull plating onto the outer hull of an starship. About three hundred bolt-couplings were beneath each hull section.

title: Bonaventure (10281NCC)
intro: The Bonaventure (10281NCC), according to Montgomery Scott, "was the first ship to have warp drive installed." The exterior design was reminiscent of that of a precursor to the . ()

title: Bonaventure (C1-21)
intro: The Bonaventure (C1-21) was an early Earth space warp capable starship.

title: Booster modulator
intro: The booster modulator was a component of a Federation starship's deflector system.

intro: Boradis III was the inhabited third planet of the Boradis system. This planet was located in a sector of the Beta Quadrant.

intro: The Borg Queen's ship was an octahedron-shaped starship that was used by the Borg Collective in the 24th century.

intro: The bortaS bir class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

title: Boslic freighter
intro: A Boslic freighter was a type of freighter used by the Boslics during the 2370s.

title: Botany section
intro: The botany section was a division of the life sciences department found aboard the . This section was responsible for managing plants and other studies in the field of botany.

title: Bothan starships
intro: The Bothan starships were illusory vessels created by a telepathic member of the Botha during his encounter with in 2372. Only one of the ships actually existed, the other two being figments of the crew's imagination caused by the Bothan's psionic field. ()

title: Bow plate
intro: A bow plate was a location in the forward section of most starships in the mid-22nd century.

title: Bowling alley
intro: A bowling alley was an indoor facility used for bowling.

title: Brace (ship)
intro: A brace was a component of a sailing vessel.

title: Bradbury class

infobox.name: ''Bradbury'' class

intro: The Bradbury class was a class of Federation transport ships developed during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Breen dreadnought
intro: The Breen dreadnought was a class of dreadnought operated by the Breen Imperium during the 32nd century. Massive in size, it was the most powerful vessel in the Breen fleet.

title: Breen fighter
intro: The Breen fighter was a small warp-capable warship used by the Breen Imperium as a fighter and scout ship during the late 32nd century. It was equipped with directed energy weapons and a cloaking device.

title: Breen interceptor
intro: The Breen interceptor was a type of light warship that served as the backbone of the Breen Confederacy fleet in the late 24th century.

title: Breen warship
intro: A Breen warship was a type of warship utilized by the Breen Confederacy during the mid-24th century. This class of vessel was armed with phasers. ()

title: Brenari freighter
intro: The Brenari freighter was a class of cargo ship in use by the Brenari during the late-24th century.

title: Bridge
intro: The bridge, also known as the main bridge or the command bridge, was the starship equivalent of an operations center or command center.

title: Briefing lounge
intro: A briefing lounge was an area of Federation starships where officers could relax while off duty. It was equipped with a monitor through which one could watch the view from the viewscreen or communicate visually with the bridge.

title: Briefing room
intro: The briefing room was a dedicated area on Federation starships and on Federation and alien facilities where senior staff or military leaders could conduct meetings and various conferences. On starships, it was generally located near the ship's main bridge.

title: Brig
intro: A brig (also known as a security cell, security holding, or holding cell) was a type of prison on board a starship, space station, or planetary facility. They were heavily guarded rooms that employed either gates or force fields to keep those incarcerated segregated from the general population. These areas were used to contain criminals, fugitives, those who are deemed a danger to themselves or others, and others who posed a security risk and must be detained. They were also used as a means of punishment within the Starfleet ranks. ()

title: Briori ship
intro: The Briori ship was a type of starship used by the Briori in the 20th century. According to John Evansville, their ships were not unlike .

title: Brunali transport vessel
intro: The Brunali transport vessel was a class of starship in use by the Brunali until at least 2376.

title: Brunt's shuttle
intro: Brunt's shuttle was a Ferengi shuttle that Brunt used to travel to Deep Space 9 in 2374, after he heard Ishka had been captured by the Dominion on her way to . Brunt later piloted the ship, with Quark, Rom, Nog, , and Leck aboard, to Empok Nor to make a prisoner exchange.

title: Brunt's shuttle (mirror)
intro: Brunt's shuttle was a Ferengi shuttle used by and . Brunt made modifications to the shuttle including its dilithium matrix to maximize its output.

title: Buffer field generator
intro: A buffer field generator, or energy buffer, was a device capable of reducing power drain on a vessel.

title: Bulkhead
intro: A bulkhead was a wall-like partition in a starship or space station used to aid structural integrity.

title: Bynar ship
intro: A Bynar ship was a type of starship operated by the Bynars during the early 2380s.

title: Byzatium transport
intro: A Byzatium transport was a type of transport utilized during the late 24th century.

title: C-57-D
intro: C-57-D was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: CAR
intro: CAR was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: CAR 54-Q
intro: CAR 54-Q was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century. In 2370, the captain of this ship was R. Savage. The starship's point of departure was Arlington IV. The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47563.1. The CAR 54-Q was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)

title: CGM
intro: CGM was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: CGM Gh'aster
intro: The CGM Gh'aster was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: CGN
intro: CGN was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: CGN Caroliqe
intro: The CGN Caroliqe was a starship in active service in the late 2360s.

title: CO2 filter
intro: A CO2 filter was a component of 22nd century shuttlepods.

title: CR-721
intro: CR-721, also known as COMM Relay Outpost CR-721 and Relay Station 721, was a Federation communication relay station operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. Located at the edge of Federation space, as of 2384 it was the most remote outpost in the Federation and was solely manned by Lieutenant jg Barniss Frex.

title: CR-721 type escape pod
intro: The CR-721 type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard the Federation communication relay station CR-721. Only one escape pod of this type was stowed aboard this type of station. ()

title: CSS
intro: CSS was an identifying prefix used before the names of space-faring ships of the Confederation of Earth.

title: CSS Ahuizotl
intro: CSS Ahuizotl (NCC-93159) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS Cetus
intro: CSS Cetus (NCC-93130) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century under the command of Zilah.

title: CSS Charybdis
intro: CSS Charybdis (NCC-93148) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS Dougherty
intro: In an alternate timeline, the CSS Dougherty (NCC-75489) was a starship in service to the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS Hydra
intro: CSS Hydra (NCC-93135) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS Kappa
intro: CSS Kappa (NCC-93154) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS La Sirena

It was commandeered by a group from the prime timeline led by Jean-Luc Picard and brought to 2024 to restore their timeline, and was later assimilated by Agnes Jurati after she merged with the alternate timeline's Borg Queen.

title: CSS Leyton
intro: In an alternate timeline, the CSS Leyton (NCC-73827) was a starship in service to the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: CSS Makara
intro: CSS Makara (NCC-93142) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

intro: In an alternate timeline, the CSS Quinn (NCC-74536) was a starship in service to the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

intro: CSS Scylla (NCC-93165) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

intro: CSS Selkie (NCC-93147) was a Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate that served the Confederation of Earth during the early 25th century.

title: Caatati vessel (large)
intro: A Caatati vessel was a class of starship that was operated by the Caatati refugees following their assimilation by the Borg in 2373. In all thirty Caatati ships, both small and large, transported the last remaining Caatati refugees from the aftermath of the destruction of their homeworld, including several vessels of this larger type.

title: Caatati vessel (small)
intro: A Caatati vessel was a class of starship that was operated by the Caatati refugees following their assimilation by the Borg in 2373. In all thirty Caatati ships, both small and large, transported the last remaining Caatati refugees from the aftermath of the destruction of their homeworld, including several vessels of this smaller type.

title: Calder II
intro: Calder II was the inhabited second planet in the Calder system. This system was located in Sector 2158, Beta Quadrant.

title: Caleb IV
intro: Caleb IV, also known as Kaleb IV, was the inhabited fourth planet in the Kaleb system. Located in the Kaleb sector, Beta Quadrant, this planet was approximately 57 light years from Sol.

title: California class
intro: The California class, nicknamed the Cali class, was a type of Federation starship in service during the late 24th century. They were support ships designed for second contact missions. ()

title: Callinon VII
intro: Callinon VII was the uninhabited seventh planet in the Callinon system, Gamma Quadrant.

title: Calondon
intro: The Calondon was a Kressari freighter that was in service in the late 24th century.

title: Capital ship
intro: A capital ship was a starship classification used by Starfleet. vessels were not considered capital ships, but ships were. ()

title: Captain's chair
intro: The command chair, also referred to as the captain's chair or simply the chair, was the most important position on board a starship bridge. This seat, as its alternate name implies, was occupied by the captain of the vessel, or the officer who commanded the vessel in the captain's absence. The ship's duty officer sat on the command chair at all times and monitored all operations on the bridge. The chair was usually equipped with companels and other related equipment. In addition, some versions could swivel, so the commanding officer could easily turn to face any relevant station.

title: Captain's dining room
intro: The captain's dining room or captain's mess was an area aboard Starfleet vessels specifically designed for personal use by the captain in order to entertain guests and eat meals in private. It was generally equipped with food service by means of a kitchen, galley, or replicators. The mess sometimes included the services of a steward, who brought the meals and drinks to the captain's table.

title: Captain's ready room
intro: The captain's ready room, also known as the captain's office, was a personal office reserved for the commanding officer of a starship and was typically accessed from the bridge.

title: Captain's yacht
intro: The captain's yacht was a large support craft built into the design of several Federation starship classes, including the , , , , and starships. It was docked to the underside of the saucer section.

title: Carbon dioxide tank
intro: A carbon dioxide tank was a physical storage device on board 22nd century Starfleet vessels which contained a gas capable of rendering Humans unconscious. The tanks could be connected to a ship's central ventilation by rerouting the transfer lines via the atmospheric recycling manifold.

title: Cardassian ATR-4107
intro: The Cardassian ATR-4107 was an incredibly advanced unmanned Cardassian prototype self-guided tactical missile designed in 2369. ()

title: Cardassian ATR-4107
intro: The Cardassian ATR-4107 was an incredibly advanced unmanned Cardassian prototype self-guided tactical missile designed in 2369. ()

title: Cardassian escape pod
intro: The Cardassian escape pod was a small Cardassian spacecraft used to evacuate a ship during an emergency. This type of escape pod measured five meters in length.

title: Cardassian patrol cruiser
intro: A Cardassian patrol cruiser was a type of patrol ship employed by the Cardassian Union during the 24th century, primarily used for patrolling and policing the Demilitarized Zone. They were much larger than Cardassian shuttles. ()

title: Cardassian pursuit vessel
intro: Cardassian pursuit vessels were a type of starship employed by the Cardassian Union, during the 24th century.

title: Cardassian starships
intro: The following is a list of known starships used by the Cardassians and Cardassian Union:

title: Cardassian supply ship
intro: A Cardassian supply ship was a type of Cardassian transport ship utilized by the Cardassian Union during the 24th century. These freighters had minimal weaponry, and were manned with a crew of about fifty.

title: Cardassian workbee
intro: A Cardassian workbee was a small craft used by the Cardassian Union during in the late 24th century.

title: Cardenas class
intro: The Cardenas-class was a type of 23rd century Federation starship in use during the 2250s.

title: Caretaker's array
intro: The Caretaker's array was a large space station in the Delta Quadrant not far from . It was seventy-five thousand light years from the Badlands and fifty thousand from the galactic core. Built by the Nacene and powered by a tetryon reactor, the array served as a location from which the could protect and serve the Ocampa. It acted as an energy source for the underground Ocampa settlements and continually pumped energy into the Ocampa city for nearly 1,500 years.

title: Cargo bay
intro: A cargo bay, cargo hold, or cargo deck was a general-purpose storage facility aboard shuttles, starships and starbases.

title: Cargo bay door
intro: The cargo bay doors, cargo bay hatch, cargo hatch, payload bay doors, or simply bay doors, were the access points for cargo to enter or depart a starship or space station's cargo bay.

title: Cargo conveyor
intro: The cargo conveyor was a type of technology used for moving cargo inside the secondary hull of the starships in the late 23rd century. It connected the forwardmost cargo bays with the aft cargo bay.

title: Cargo drone
intro: A cargo drone was a type of 23rd century and 24th century automated cargo vessel utilized by the Federation.

title: Cargo module
intro: The cargo module was an independent cargo container which was attached to a spacecraft at hardpoints. If the load in a module was not balanced, a vibration would result. One possible solution to the vibraton was to trim the load.

title: Cargo turbo subsystem
intro: The cargo turbo subsystem was an integral design element of the space station. There were nine of these subsystems located in the docking ring of the station. The location of one of these subsystems was labeled on a schematic of Deep Space 9 that was seen in the station's wardroom. ()

title: Carrier vessel
intro: A carrier vessel or carrier ship was a type of vessel that could support and launch smaller craft.

title: Cassini
intro: The Cassini program, was an unmanned space exploration program operated by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration of the United States.

title: Catwalk
intro: The catwalk was the unofficial designation for the lateral access conduit running the entire length of the warp nacelles of an starship. Located at the center of the nacelle, just below the ship's warp coils, the catwalk was accessible through a single vertical Jefferies tube.

title: Centaur class
intro: The Centaur class was a Federation starship design operated by Starfleet during the 24th century.

title: Cervantes
intro: The Cervantes (NCC-1701/5) was a Stamets-type Federation shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the 23rd century. It was attached to the .

title: Cestus III

infobox.name: Cestus III
infobox.scaption: Cestus III outpost after the Gorn attack of 2267

intro: Cestus III was the inhabited third planet of the Cestus system. This planet was located in the Beta Quadrant and was the home to a Federation colony in the 24th century.

title: Cetacean Ops
intro: Cetacean Ops was a facility aboard certain Starfleet starships, during the 23rd and 24th centuries, which was responsible for a ship's navigation. They generally contained an aquarium, so as to simulate the natural habitat of various cetacean lifeforms. In the mid-23rd century, starships had Cetacean Ops on board. By the 2380s, these facilities had also been installed on , , and vessels.

title: Chaffee
intro: The Chaffee was a Federation Type 10 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle 01.

title: Challenger (OV-099)
intro: Challenger (OV-099) was an American space shuttle orbiter that was operated by NASA in the 1980s. In 1986, the shuttle was destroyed with all hands during launch. ()

title: Challenger class

infobox.name: ''Challenger'' class
infobox.caption: Wreckage of the Challenger-class USS Buran
infobox.caption2: The wreck of the Buran on fire

intro: The Challenger-class starships were Starfleet vessels in service in the later 24th century. They shared many design aspects with and starships.

title: Chapel
intro: A chapel was a room inside a larger facility where weddings were performed. One could also retreat to a chapel for solace and prayer.

title: Chargh class

infobox.name: ''chargh'' class
infobox.image: chargh at the Battle of the Binary Stars.png
infobox.caption: Port view

intro: The chargh class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century. It was similar to the , but with a reduced central hull.

title: Charon type
intro: The Charon-type was a starship design that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century.

title: Charybdis
intro: The Charybdis was a mid-21st century NASA exploratory shuttle. ()

title: Chem lab
intro: The chem lab was a science department section aboard .

title: Cheron scout vessel
intro: A Cheron scout vessel was a type of durable long-service starship utilized by Commissioner Bele, the Chief Officer of the Commission on Political Traitors on planet Cheron.

title: Chessu ship
intro: The Chessu ship was a type of starship utilized by the Chessu, who employed the class in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.

title: Cheyenne class

infobox.name: ''Cheyenne'' class
infobox.caption: Wreckage of the Cheyenne-class USS Ahwahnee

intro: The Cheyenne class was a type of starship in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century.

title: Chief medical officer's office
intro: The chief medical officer's office was the primary workspace for the chief medical officer aboard space stations or starships. While they varied in design, they all included a desk and computers.

title: Children's Center
intro: The Children's Center was a facility aboard the starship . It was a child-care and educational center for young children.

title: Chokuzan vessel
intro: A Chokuzan vessel was a type of ship belonging to the Chokuzans.

title: Chris Pike

infobox.caption: The Chris Pike listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Chris Pike''

intro: The Chris Pike was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod number 02.

title: Clarke

infobox.caption: The Clarke on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Clarke''

intro: The Clarke was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 05.

title: Class 1 probe
intro: A class-1 probe was a type of probe used by Starfleet ships in the late 24th century.

title: Class 1 shuttle
intro: The Class 1 shuttle was an early design of Federation shuttlecraft, described as already being "old" during the first half of the 24th century.

title: Class 1 transport
intro: A class 1 transport was a type of unarmed spacecraft used by the Brunali in the late 24th century. This spacecraft, at a minimum, could support one lifeform.

title: Class 2 probe
intro: A class-2 probe was a type of probe carried aboard Federation starships, including and vessels.

title: Class 2 shuttle
intro: The Class 2 shuttle, also referred to as a Type 9 shuttlecraft, was a short range auxiliary space vessel utilized by Starfleet for use as an embarked craft from starships.

title: Class 3 probe
intro: A class-3 probe was a type of surveillance probe, that was carried aboard Federation starships in the 24th century. These probes were designed to survive a planetary landing and, according to Nog, were "designed to be virtually undetectable" by sensors. (; )

title: Class 4 microprobe
intro: A class 4 microprobe was a specific type of microprobe that was used by Starfleet during the late 24th century. The carried these microprobes.

title: Class 4 probe
intro: A class-4 probe was a type of probe with deflector shields utilized by the Federation to study spatial anomalies and spaceborne species. (; )

title: Class 4 stardrive vessel
intro: Class-4 stardrive vessel was the designation for a type of small 23rd century spaceship, utilized by the Federation Merchant Service for the role of survey vessel. This class of vessel was equipped with transporters and utilized iridium in its construction.

title: Class 5 probe
intro: The class-5 probe or level-5 probe was a medium-range probe carried aboard Federation starships and used as a reconnaissance probe and for planetary analysis. It was equipped with visual sensors, as well as sensors that could detect the chemical contents of an atmosphere and geological sensors. It maintained orbit with impulse thrusters. The probe had an operational life span of over two hundred years, by which time its thrusters would permanently degrade. ()

title: Class 7 vessel
intro: A Class 7 vessel was a Starfleet designation for a type of interplanetary sublight spacecraft, used during the 24th century. These vessels were typically armed with lasers and were manned with a small crew of about two dozen. Overall, they were slightly faster than Class 9 cargo vessels.

title: Class 8 probe
intro: A class 8 probe was a type of probe used by the Federation in the late 24th century, usually instrumented heavily with sensor and transceiver equipment, and was designed for extended flight at velocities up to warp 9. Class-8 probes were based on the photon torpedo spaceframe.

title: Class 9 cargo vessel

infobox.name: Class 9 cargo vessel
A graphic of the Erstwhile showing the location of its bridge (red) and laser array (pink)

intro: A Class 9 cargo vessel was the Starfleet designation for a type of interplanetary sublight freighter utilized during the 24th century. These type of vessels had minimal weaponry, including lasers, and were typically slower than Class 7 vessels.

title: Class A probe
intro: The class A probe was a type of probe that was carried aboard Federation starships during the late 24th century. They were used in studying gas giant planets and the birth of stars.

title: Class A shuttlecraft
intro: The Class A shuttlecraft was a type of warp-capable shuttlecraft used by the Terran Empire. The shuttle came equipped with transporters.

title: Class C shuttlecraft
intro: The Class C shuttlecraft was a commonly used Starfleet and civilian shuttlecraft from the mid-23rd century through the late-24th century.

title: Class F shuttlecraft
intro: The Class F shuttlecraft was the standard issue Starfleet shuttlecraft during the mid-23rd century.

title: Class III neutronic fuel carrier

infobox.caption: Forward view
infobox.name: Class III neutronic fuel carrier
infobox.mass:

97,000 metric tons (cargo capacity)

intro: A Class III neutronic fuel carrier or 3rd class neutronic fuel carrier was the designation used to classify a type of 23rd century fuel carrier capable of hauling several metric tons of neutronic fuel as well as several hundred passengers.

title: Class J starship
intro: The class J starship, or class J cargo ship or Class J training ship, was a small, antiquated starship design used by the Federation and independent traders alike well into the mid-23rd century. (; )

title: Class-5 intelligence drone
intro: A class-5 intelligence drone was a type of Federation sensor drone used for intelligence-gathering purposes.

title: Cleaning processor
intro: A cleaning processor was a piece of technology on Starfleet vessels used to clean articles of clothing.

title: Cleponji
intro: "That ship belongs in a museum. I'm afraid we're a little late; that call for help was probably initiated over a thousand years ago."

title: Climatology
intro: Climatology was a department aboard the .

title: Cochrane (2372)
intro: Cochrane was a Class 2 shuttle used aboard the during its journey through the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century. It was numbered "04" in order to register it as Voyagers fourth shuttlecraft, and was the shuttle used for Voyagers transwarp tests.

title: Cochrane (2374)

infobox.name: ''Cochrane ''
infobox.caption: The Cochrane attacked by the Hirogen

intro: The Cochrane was a Class 2 shuttle used aboard during its journey through the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century. It was the second ship to be identified as "Shuttle 4", replacing its predecessor destroyed earlier the same year.

title: Cochrane (shuttlepod)

infobox.caption: The Cochrane listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Cochrane''

intro: The Cochrane, named after the famous Zefram Cochrane, inventor of warp drive, was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 14.

infobox.caption: The Cochrane listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Cochrane''

intro: The Cochrane, named after the famous Zefram Cochrane, inventor of warp drive, was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 14.

title: Cockpit
intro: A cockpit was the forward section of an aircraft or spacecraft where the pilot and any additional crew were seated.

title: Coil bracket
intro: Coil brackets were a component used aboard Deep Space 9.

title: Collimator
intro: The collimator was a device used in Starfleet vessel navigational arrays.

title: Coloma
intro: The Coloma was a Federation mining vessel that was in service in the late 32nd century.

title: Colony Cestus III
intro: Colony Cestus III was a Federation colony on the planet Cestus III. This colony was located in the Beta Quadrant. It was an isolated and remote colony on the edge of Federation space and was established to be an observation outpost. The last commander of this colony was Commodore Travers.

title: Colony ship
intro: In starship classification, colony ships or colony transport ships were spacecraft, especially starships, designed to transport colonists and equipment to new worlds.

title: Coltrane
intro: The Coltrane was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft assigned to the .

title: Columbia
intro: Columbia (NX-02) was the second United Earth starship that was in service to Starfleet in the latter half of the 22nd century. Columbia was the second ship outfitted with a warp five engine.

title: Columbia (OV-102)
intro: Columbia (OV-102) was a 20th century NASA space shuttle orbiter operated by the United States of America on Earth. In April 1981, it became the first space shuttle launched into space. It was lost with all hands when the ship disintegrated on reentry in 2003. ()

title: Columbia dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of . ( set artwork)

title: Columbus
intro: The Columbus (NCC-1701⁄2) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the . ()

title: Combat cruiser
intro: Combat cruiser was a term applied to certain battle-oriented cruiser-type starships.

title: Combat information center
intro: A combat information center (CIC) was an auxiliary control area used to direct combat operations on military aircraft carriers, starships, and other facilities.

title: Command center
intro: The command center was a specialized section aboard the starship , in which dedicated data analysis and mission operations were performed.

title: Command console
intro: Senior Starfleet bridge officers used specialized command consoles to access and control many functions of the ship's critical computer systems. These consoles were designed in several different formats specific to each ship's bridge layout, but all were located near, and sometimes attached to, the command chair.

title: Command deck
intro: The command deck was an area aboard a starship. It included the ship's bridge. (; )

title: Command module
intro: The command module was a section of early 20th and 21st century spacecrafts. It contained the primary cockpit and control area, as well as scientific facilities, and engineering controls.

title: Communications panel
intro: A communications panel, or comm panel, was a console aboard a starship.

title: Communications section
intro: The communications section was a department aboard the .

title: Communications station
intro: The communications station or communications console was a console on the bridge of some Starfleet and other starships dedicated to managing all external transmissions. In the 22nd and 23rd centuries, the communications officer was a senior staff position. (; )

title: Compartment
intro: A compartment was a section of a spacecraft devoted to a particular purpose, such as storage or passenger seating.

title: Computer access room
intro: The computer access room was a facility aboard Federation starships that allowed easy access to the computer core.

title: Computer center
intro: The computer center, also known as the computer room, was a section of a facility or a starship that was responsible for the coordination of all information storage and transmission activity.

title: Computer core
intro: The computer core or memory core was the location of a starship's or space station's central computer.

title: Computer statistics
intro: Computer statistics was a facility located aboard starships of the mid-23rd century.

title: Confederation starships
intro: The Confederation of Earth operated numerous frigates and warships during this alternate 2401. ()

title: Conference room
intro: A conference room, also known as a conference suite or meeting room, was a location where meetings and similar gatherings were held.

title: Conrad

infobox.image: Air tram and Class F shuttle.jpg
infobox.name: ''Conrad''

intro: The Conrad was a Federation Class F shuttle operated by Starfleet in the late 23rd century. It was attached to Starbase 6.

title: Console station
intro: A console station, or simply, console or station, or control console was a physical device which one could use to interact with computer systems. They were usually used by crewmembers on the bridge of a starship or operations center of a space station.

title: Constellation class
intro: The Constellation-class starship was a type of Federation star cruiser employed by Starfleet from the late 23rd century through the late 24th century.

title: Constitution II class decks

title: Constitution class
intro: The Constitution-class was a Federation , Class I heavy cruiser that was utilized as premier exploratory Starfleet vessels during the mid-23rd century.

title: Constitution class (3067)
intro: The Constitution class was a Federation starship design operated by Starfleet during the early 31st century. ()

title: Constitution class (3069)
intro: The Constitution-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century and into the 33rd century. Like its predecessor Constitution-classes, it featured a saucer section and secondary hull with two warp nacelles connected by pylons.
