intro: The Constitution-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard starships.

title: Contra Costa
intro: The Contra Costa was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century.

title: Control booth
intro: A control booth was a small enclosure from which one controlled the activities taking place in a larger room, such as a shuttlebay or holodeck.

title: Control center
intro: A control center was a central location where the operations and personnel of a facility were coordinated.

title: Control junction
intro: On Deep Space 9, a control junction was a site containing control terminals for station systems.

title: Control room
intro: A control room was a room housing equipment used for monitoring and managing a ship or installation.

title: Converter assembly
intro: A converter assembly was a technology used aboard starships for power generation.

title: Coolant tank
intro: A coolant tank was a containment unit to store gases or liquids such as plasma coolant, used to cool parts of a starship or any vessel or base whose power generation units created extreme excess heat that could damage or destroy nearby components or structures.

title: Copenhagen Base

infobox.name: Copenhagen Base
infobox.imagecap: A cargo crate from Copenhagen Base

intro: Copenhagen Base was an outpost within Federation space in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. This outpost provided outposts like the Regula I research station with goods.

title: Copernicus (2269)
intro: The Copernicus (NCC-1701⁄12) was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to the . Copernicus was the second shuttle to be labeled with the registry NCC-1701⁄12 in 2269.

title: Copernicus (2287)
intro: The Copernicus was a Federation Type 4 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to the . It was Shuttle 3. ()

title: Copernicus (2364)
intro: The Copernicus was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was designated as Shuttle 03. ()

title: Coqqor's ship
intro: Coqqor's ship was a type of Chalnoth starship operated by Coqqor during the early 2380s.

title: Corazonia
intro: Corazonia was an ancient Dyson ring located in a bespoke star system. It was designed by an advanced alien species that evolved into fifth-dimensional energy beings some six million years ago. The megastructure subsequently became inhabited by the humanoid Corazonians, who were members of the Federation.

title: Cordry rock
intro: Cordry rocks were pebble-like objects installed in Starfleet vessels. Starfleet engineers, such as Andy Billups, considered cordry rocks essential since their non-centrosymmetry disrupted the charge leptons in the isolinear pathways of the main deflector, which caused other things to transpire. However, they could also be dangerous projectiles when damage occurred. Jack Ransom was not fond of them for this reason.

title: Coridan ship
intro: The Coridan ship was a class of starship in use by the Coridanites during the mid-22nd century.

title: Corridor
intro: A corridor or access corridor located within starships and space stations typically served as pathways or passageways to various stations or quarters, and as lengthy hallways through which one accessed various rooms. In buildings, there were also known as halls or hallways, and even passages.

title: Corsair (cargo ship)
intro: The Corsair was supposedly a cargo ship that sent a distress call to the Denobulan medical ship Barzai in 2154.

title: Corsair (type)
intro: A corsair was a type of starship used by the Fenris Rangers at the turn of the 25th century.

title: Corvallen freighter
intro: Corvallen freighters were types of warp-capable freighters utilized by Corvallen mercenaries during the 24th century. One type they used was the old-style Antares-class freighter.

title: Corvette
intro: A corvette was a type of starship were small warships used usually for escorting convoys.

title: Cosmic Duchess
intro: The Cosmic Duchess was an interstellar cruise ship in operation during the late 24th century.

title: Counselor's office
intro: The counselor's office is the workplace of a ship's counselor aboard Federation starships, which included the .

title: Courage class
intro: The Courage-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design featured a vertically-oriented diamond-shaped primary hull, with an engineering hull protruding aft from the middle.

title: Courier ship
intro: In starship classification, a courier ship or support courier was a type of vessel operated by dedicated couriers, or conducted transport courier missions, such as for rendezvousing with other ships in deep space or at space stations.

title: Cousteau (shuttlecraft)

infobox.caption: The Cousteau on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Cousteau''

intro: The Cousteau was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 10.

infobox.caption: The Cousteau on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Cousteau''

intro: The Cousteau was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 10.

title: Cousteau (shuttlepod)
intro: The Cousteau was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 20.

title: Cousteau (yacht)
intro: The Cousteau was a Federation captain's yacht that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to . Cousteau was a large auxiliary craft which normally docked on the ventral side of the saucer section, opposite the bridge, and immediately below the saucer torpedo launcher. When connected to the Enterprise, only the bottom side of the yacht was exposed to space; the top of the craft was concealed by the Enterprise and the warp nacelles were folded against the hull. Upon launch, the Cousteau nacelles folded downward and the entire ship dropped away from the Enterprise.

title: Cousteau dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of the , the 's captain's yacht. ( set artwork)

title: Covariant oscillator
intro: A covariant oscillator was a piece of technology found aboard Starfleet runabouts.

title: Coverian freighter
intro: Coverian freighters were a type of freighters operated by the Coverians.

title: Cowards Gulch
intro: Cowards Gulch was a ski slope on the Cosmic Duchess that was rated "smooth and easy" in terms of difficulty. The beginning of the slope was located near that of another on the same artificial mountain, Experts Demise.

title: Cravic ship
intro: The Cravic ship was a type of starship initially utilized by the Cravic, nearly identical to Pralor vessels.

title: Credence class
intro: The Credence class was a Federation starship design operated by Starfleet during the late 32nd century. Ships of this class had a dual-layered saucer section with multiple warp nacelles.

title: Crossfield class

infobox.name: ''Crossfield'' class
infobox.speed: 90 light years in 1.3 secs (655,000,000,000,000 km/s) (using [[spore drive]])

intro: The Crossfield class was a type of Federation starship in service during the mid-23rd century. Though officially designated as a science vessel, during the the class was re-classified as a warship. ()

title: Crossfield class decks
intro: The decks of a Federation starship. (, et al.)

title: Crossover bridge
intro: Crossover bridges were components of Cardassian space stations such as Deep Space 9. The bridges connected the central core of the station to the habitat ring, and further to the docking ring and its associated pylons. ()

title: Cruiser
intro: In starship classification, cruisers were a type of starship that served as the primary combat vessels in a fleet.

title: Cryptography
intro: Cryptography was a section aboard the , responsible for decoding enemy transmissions.

title: Cube 1184
intro: Cube 1184 was a Borg cube that was in service of the Borg Collective in the late 24th century. In early-2377, this cube was located in Grid 326.

title: Cube 461
intro: Cube 461 was a Borg cube that was in service in the late 24th century. In 2377, this cube was located in Grid 892.

title: Cube 630
intro: Cube 630 was a Borg cube that was in service in the late 24th century. In 2377, this cube had a crew complement of 64,000 drones.

title: Cube 858779
intro: Cube 858779 was a Borg cube that was in operation during the late 24th century.

title: Cube 90182
intro: Cube 90182 was a Borg cube that was in service in the late 24th century. ()

title: Cultivation bay

title: Debris
intro: Debris was a term for scattered materials, either natural or artificial, both in a habitable environment as in space, as in space debris or colloquially as "space junk" () or "space dust". () Spaceborne debris in particular might potentially be concentrated in a debris field or debris cloud. An asteroid field might be identified as "asteroidal debris", while cometary debris also existed. Debris might also be referred to as flotsam, rubble, or wreckage.

title: Defiant class
intro: The Defiant-class warship, officially an escort vessel, began development in 2366 as a small, highly powered, heavily armed warship intended to defend the against the Borg. The was the prototype of what was to be a new Federation battle fleet. However, the ship had numerous design problems that were made apparent during its shakedown cruise. These flaws, combined with the decreased urgency of the Borg threat, caused Starfleet to table its plans for a battle fleet and put the Defiant in storage. ()

The spheres, each one nineteen kilometers in diameter, generated massive amounts of gravimetric energy and were collectively responsible for the web of spatial anomalies which constituted the Expanse. Each sphere was surrounded by a cloaking barrier which kept it hidden from outside observers. According to the Xindi-Primate Degra, the Xindi knew of seventy-eight spheres, at last count. ()

The vessel was designed to handle environments that would be too hazardous for a standard shuttlecraft and to be slightly larger than the average shuttle, the crew having acknowledged that standard shuttles were of little use in the increasingly hostile and unexplored Delta Quadrant. The vessel was a blend of Starfleet and Borg technology, designed in collaboration between B'Elanna Torres, Tom Paris, Tuvok, Harry Kim, and Seven of Nine. It was conceived as incorporating a tetraburnium alloy hull with ultra-aerodynamic contours, retractable warp nacelles, parametallic

intro: Delta Vega was an icy class M planet orbiting the star 40 Eridani A in the Vulcan system. This planet was located inside Vulcan space in the Vulcan sector, Beta Quadrant, and was approximately 16 light years from Sol. Its orbit carried it near enough to that the other planet could be seen from Delta Vega's surface. There were at least two native, predatory species present on the planet: the drakoulias and the hengrauggi.

title: Delta class
intro: In 2266 of an alternate timeline, the Delta class was a type of fictional Starfleet "attack ship" invented by Captain Christopher Pike in an attempt to bluff against a Romulan fleet at the Neutral Zone. The ships were actually dozens of unarmed and unmanned robotic mining craft collected from the Earth Outpost Stations by Captain James T. Kirk. Kirk had reasoned that, since the Romulans had not contacted the Federation in a hundred years, they would not know what a Starfleet armada looked like. However, despite calling the drones "an act of unparalleled aggression", the Romulan praetor chose to attack regardless. ()

title: Denebian spaceship
intro: The Denebian spaceship was a type of spaceship used by the Denebians during the 2260s.

title: Denkir Orbital City
intro: Denkir Orbital City was an orbital space station in the Denkir system.

title: Denobulan medical ship
intro: The Denobulan medical ship was a type of warp-capable shuttle used by the Denobulans to transport medical supplies.

title: Denobulan shuttle
intro: The Denobulan shuttle was a type of warp-capable vessel used by the Denobulans during the mid-22nd century.

title: Department (starship section)
intro: Aboard Federation starships, ship duties among the Starfleet crew were delegated to individual departments, each headed by a department head. () These included science departments. (; ) Each department contained members of respective Starfleet divisions.

title: Descent stabilizer
intro: A descent stabilizer was an important part of a Federation starship's turbolift system.

title: Destroyer
intro: In starship classification, a destroyer was a type of warship with moderate capabilities. The term was originally used for naval vessels.

title: Devoras
intro: The Devoras was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the mid-24th century. In 2367, the Devoras was under the command of Admiral Mendak.

title: Devore scout ship
intro: The Devore scout ship or Devore shuttle was a type of warp-capable scout ship used by Devore military officers in the late 24th century. It was operated by a single person and was capable of landing. The ship was armed and had deflector shields.

title: Devore sensor array
intro: The Devore sensor array was an automated sensor drone used by the Devore Imperium in the late 24th century.

title: Devore warship
intro: The Devore warship was a type of warship used by the Devore Imperium to patrol their territory in the Delta Quadrant. They sometimes operated in squadrons.

title: Devos II
intro: Devos II was the inhabited second planet in the Devos system, Alpha Quadrant. During the 2370s, this planet was home to a Son'a outpost.

title: Diana
intro: The Diana was a Federation starship that was plundered, sometime prior to 2364, approximately twenty-five light years from where the was spacejacked.

title: Dilithium barge
intro: The dilithium barge was a Klingon cargo ship type in operation during the mid-22nd century.

title: Dilithium vault
intro: The dilithium vault was a restricted location aboard starships where dilithium was stored. It was guarded by security officers.

title: Dimassa 01
intro: The Dimassa 01 was a Federation military shuttle that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: Diplomatic vessel
intro: In starship classification, a diplomatic vessel was a starship whose primary purpose was diplomacy.

title: Directional control
intro: Directional control were computer memory banks that worked in concert with a Federation starship's helm functions. Aboard vessels, these controls could be accessed through either the library computer or the chief engineer's stations on the bridge. ()

title: Discovery (OV-103)
intro: Discovery (OV-103) was an American space shuttle orbiter that was operated by NASA from the 1980s to the 2000s. In 2011, it was retired along with the other surviving shuttles from the first generation of space shuttles. ()

title: Discovery dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of . ()

title: Disordered Ward
intro: The Disordered Ward was a medical section within the derelict Borg cube known as the . This area was located outside of the Gray zone. The disordered xBs, who were all Romulans, were kept under armed guard in the ward. In 2399, one of the ward's patients was Ramdha, who attempted to kill herself using the sidearm of one of the guards. ()

title: Dispersal node
intro: A dispersal node was a device designed to distribute a substance, either gas or energy, over a predetermined area. Dispersal nodes were components of starship environmental systems, responsible for the distribution of gaseous substances into the internal atmosphere of the ship.

title: Disposal tube
intro: The disposal tube, also known as an ejection chute, was very similar to a trash tube. It was designed to dispose of objects by ejecting them into space.

title: Dividices
intro: The Dividices was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the late 24th century. It saw action in the Dominion War as part of the Federation Alliance in 2375.

title: Dock control
intro: Dock control or docking control was an element of Yard Command maintained by the dockmaster of a dry dock.

title: Docking arm
intro: A docking arm was a large magnetic extension built into the launch bay of an starship. The arm was used in docking procedures, such as a landing or departure. Officers aboard the vessel were able to remotely deploy the docking arm from the starship's bridge. ()

title: Docking bay
intro: A docking bay was an area where starships could offload or receive personnel or cargo.

title: Docking clamp
intro: A docking clamp or mooring clamp was a mechanical device by which one object is held to another, such as a starship held in place while docked at space stations. Ships were unable to leave until the docking clamps were released. On starships, emergency docking clamps could be activated. ()

title: Docking corridor
intro: A docking corridor, also called a transport tube, a deep space transport tube, a docking tube, or a gangway, was a long tube that connected a starship either to a space station or to another starship. It allowed crew to pass back and forth without the use of transporters or environmental suits. It typically extended starting from one end and connected to a docking port on the ship at the other end. It was generally used for routine operations, but could also be deployed in an emergency. A docking corridor only permitted a small number of crew to pass through at a time, so for large-scale starship emergencies it was more suitable to deploy several evacuation corridors.

title: Docking latch
intro: A docking latch, or main latch, was a magnetic structural device found on starships. The latches served to create the bond between the saucer module and the stardrive section and kept the two separable components joined during standard flight. There were eighteen such latches, all located on the dorsal head of the stardrive section. Their matching ports were found in the docking cavity on the saucer module.

title: Docking port
intro: A docking port, or docking hatch, was located on the hull of a spacecraft and allowed the crew access between their ship and another vessel or space station. Typically a ship's docking port would connect either directly to a space station's docking port or to some form of docking corridor.

title: Doctari Alpha

infobox.name: Doctari Alpha
infobox.orbital: Doctari Alpha orbit - Vulcan skill dome.jpg
infobox.ocaption: Displayed (reversed) on a Vulcan learning sphere

intro: Doctari Alpha was an inhabited planet in the Beta Quadrant. This planet was located in a multiple star system with at least two suns and had at least one natural satellite. The planet surface was dark red in color (not unlike Mars). ()

title: Doctari Alpha Research Outpost
intro: The Doctari Alpha Research Outpost was a Vulcan colony located on Doctari Alpha.

title: Dol'drm colony ship
intro: The Dol'drm colony ship was a type of spacecraft used by the Dol'drm to colonize other planets 65 million years ago. The ship was powered by iridium fuel pods and held its crew within cryobeds.

title: Doorway
intro: A doorway was a door-shaped entrance into a house or a room.

title: Doppler compensator
intro: A doppler compensator was a component of Federation starships. Malfunctions of this component were audible.

title: Dorian
intro: The Dorian was an unarmed 24th century transport ship. In 2369, it was under the command of Captain Talmadge.

title: Douglas Station

infobox.name: Douglas Station
infobox.image2: USS Cerritos docked at Douglas Station.png

intro: Douglas Station was a Federation starbase that was administered by Starfleet under the command of Admiral Vassery. The base orbited a planet in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Dove (ship)
intro: The Dove was a Federation starship that operated during the late 24th century.

title: Dragon 2
intro: The Dragon 2 was a space capsule built and operated by the aerospace business SpaceX. This spacecraft was launched into space by the Falcon 9 rocket.

title: Drake (shuttlecraft)

infobox.caption: Systems display from interior of shuttlecraft Drake in 2372
infobox.name: ''Drake''

intro: The Drake was a Federation Type 8 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the .

title: Dralian vessel
intro: The Dralian vessel was a class of starship in use by the Dralian people in the late-24th century.

title: Dramen patrol ship

infobox.caption: A Dramen patrol ship
infobox.caption2: The cockpit of a Dramen patrol ship

intro: The Dramen patrol ship was a small one-man spacecraft designed for patrol duty in the Dramen star system. This type of craft was slightly larger than a Federation shuttlecraft.

title: Drayan shuttle
intro: A Drayan shuttle was a small, armed shuttle used by the Drayans. It was capable of space travel as well as maneuvering inside a planet's atmosphere. ()

title: Drayan starship
intro: A Drayan starship was a type of starship utilized by the Drayans during the 24th century.

title: Dreadnought
intro: In starship classification, a dreadnought was a type of heavily-armed starship.

intro: The Dreadnought-class was an experimental class of dreadnought warship designed by Section 31 of Starfleet with the help of . The only known vessel of this class, the , was launched from a secret facility orbiting Io in 2259. ()

title: Dream Alien ship
intro: The Dream Alien ship was a type of starship encountered in the communal dream experienced by the crew in 2374.

title: Dresselhaus type
intro: The Dresselhaus type was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century.

title: Drexler outpost
intro: The Drexler outpost was an outpost located in the Omega sector.

title: Drill platform
intro: The drill platform was a part of the Romulan mining ship Narada that could be lowered into the atmosphere of a planet or planetoid for mining operations. Comprised of a high-energy pulse device that emitted a signal that disrupted subspace communications and transporters, it fired an orange-yellow colored high-intensity energy beam capable of burning through a planetary crust to reach the core.

title: Drookmani ship
intro: The Drookmani ship was a type of starship used by Drookmani scavengers for their salvage operations during the late 24th century.

title: Drookmani shuttle
intro: The Drookmani shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by Drookmani scavengers in the late 24th century. Such a shuttle was stowed in a ventral bay on the command section of the Drookmani ship. It could land on a planetary surface and hold at least three occupants.

title: Duderstadt class
intro: The Duderstadt class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.

title: Dukat's battle cruiser
intro: Dukat's battle cruiser was a Jem'Hadar battle cruiser used by Dukat and Weyoun prior to, and during, the opening months of the Dominion War.

title: Dynametric tailfins
intro: Dynametric tailfins were a design feature which Tom Paris had hoped to add while designing the in 2375. According to him, they would add "sleekness and a sense of power" to the shuttlecraft.

title: ECS (prefix)
intro: ECS was a registry number prefix for both Earth and Federation starships.

title: ECS Constellation
intro: The ECS Constellation was an Earth freighter that was in service with the Earth Cargo Service in the mid-22nd century.

title: ECS Fortunate
intro: The ECS Fortunate (ECS-2801) was a United Earth cargo freighter that was in service with the Earth Cargo Service in the early to mid-22nd century. The vessel had a crew complement of twenty-three. In 2151, the Fortunate was commanded by Captain Keene. Matthew Ryan served as her first officer prior to 2151. ()

title: ECS Horizon
intro: The ECS Horizon was a freighter commissioned in 2102 in the Earth Cargo Service. By 2152, the Horizon was under the command of Captain Paul Mayweather.

title: ECS North Star
intro: The ECS North Star was a Earth Cargo Service freighter that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

title: Earth Outpost Station
intro: The Earth Outpost Stations were a series of outposts constructed on asteroids located in Sector Z-6 of the Beta Quadrant, and in neighboring sectors, along the Federation side of the Romulan Neutral Zone. They were established by a treaty after the Earth-Romulan War of the 2160s, which allowed United Earth, and subsequently the Federation, to monitor its side of the Neutral Zone. (; )

title: Earth satellite network
intro: The Earth satellite network was a group of communication satellites, spacedocks, and orbital habitats in orbit of Earth in the 2370s.

title: Earth science
intro: Earth science was a physical sciences department aboard Federation starships during the 2260s.

title: Earth spacedocks

infobox.name: ''Columbia'' spacedock
infobox.caption: Columbia under construction in spacedock in 2153

intro: A station in close orbit around Earth. The OV-165 space shuttle could dock and be fueled on this station. ( opening titles)

intro: A list of all Earth ship classes in service before the founding of the Federation in 2161.

title: Earth starships
intro: The following is a list of Earth starships.

title: Earth vessel (31st century)
intro: This Earth vessel was a small craft was first encountered by in 2152. The craft was approximately six meters long, but, due to the advanced application of an unknown spatial phenomenon, was actually bigger on the inside than on the outside.

title: Echelon class
intro: The Echelon class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.

title: Edison class
intro: The Edison-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century. It bore a strong resemblance to the 23rd century but featured components and technology from more recent designs.

title: Einstein (2267)
intro: The Einstein (NCC-1701⁄6) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the . ()

title: Einstein (2365)
intro: The Einstein was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the in the 2360s. It was shuttlecraft number 02.

title: Eisenberg class
intro: The Eisenberg class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century and into the 33rd century. Its primary hull had a tapered upward-sloping shape, with two disconnected warp nacelles.

title: Ekina
intro: The Ekina was a "cargo ship", caught in a plasma storm near Deep Space 9 in 2370. It sent a distress call to the station, stating that their engines had been severely damaged, and would, subsequently, be tractored into the station's outer docking ring. In reality, however, the Ekina was a ship used by Verad to hijack Deep Space 9 in order to steal the from Jadzia Dax. ()

title: Ekosian missile
intro: Ekosian missiles were thermonuclear missiles used by the Ekosians during their Nazi era. Even though the nuclear missiles were created on Ekos. One of the missiles was launched against the after it was detected approaching Ekos in 2268.

title: Ekosian ship
intro: The Ekosian ship was a type of spacecraft with interplanetary capability from the planet Ekos.

title: El-Baz
intro: The El-Baz was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 05, and was equipped with impulse drive only.

title: Elasian ship
intro: An Elasian ship was a type of sublight spacecraft utilized by the Elasians during the mid-23rd century.

infobox.location:
In [[orbit]] of [[Elba II]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Elba II Orbital Transit Station was an orbital transport hub at the planet Elba II.

title: Electrographic Analysis
intro: Electrographic Analysis was a facility located aboard starships of the mid-23rd century. This facility was responsible for analyzing pictures produced by electronic transmission. ()

title: Electromagnetic section
intro: Electromagnetic section was among one of the departmental subdivisions of the astrophysics lab utilized aboard Federation starships during the mid-23rd century.

title: Elkins type

infobox.image: Raging Queen, Elkins and two Klingon warships.jpg
infobox.caption: The Elkins, top center
infobox.name: ''Elkins'' type

intro: The Elkins type was a preliminary designation for a group of Federation starships in use during the Dominion War. ()

title: Ellison
intro: The Ellison was a late 24th century transport.

title: Elysian Kingdom (ship)
intro: The Elysian Kingdom was a starship that appeared as a "planet", or rather a flat disc of land possessing a breathable atmosphere, gravity, and lifeforms seemingly in defiance of the laws of physics. Its surface was a re-creation of the eponymous kingdom from the children's fantasy book The Kingdom of Elysian by Benny Russell, complete with faeries and magic. From the ground, it appeared to have a regular day-night cycle and a moon. The unusual composition of its atmosphere prevented detailed sensor readings of the ship, though it was observed to move under its own power.

title: Emergency Manual Override station
intro: Emergency Manual Override was one of the console stations on the bridge of Starfleet starships, used to take control of the ship's computer during emergency situations.

title: Emergency access conduit
intro: Emergency access conduits were short, narrow access corridors just large enough for an average humanoid to crawl through that were linked to Jefferies tubes in the interior of many Federation starships. The conduits were intended for use only in emergencies to evacuate damaged areas of the ship.

title: Emergency bulkhead
intro: Emergency bulkheads were barriers which could be engaged to contain areas on a starship which had suffered heavy damage and had decompressed. This had the effect of isolating the decompressed area from the rest of the ship. ()

title: Emergency disconnect explosive bolt
intro: The emergency disconnect explosive bolt was a technological device used aboard Federation ships. Rossium-K was one of the propellants used for this device. ()

title: Emergency drone
intro: The emergency drone was a type of drone used for emergencies aboard ships in the late 32nd century.

title: Emergency gyro
intro: Emergency gyros were a stabilization feature found aboard starships.

title: Emergency hatch
intro: The emergency hatch was a hatch found on the bridges of starships that was used to escape in the case of an emergency.

title: Emergency manual monitor
intro: The emergency manual monitor was a compartment located in the engineering section of starships. Overlooking the main engineering deck, entry to this area was gained by use of a gangway.

title: Emergency overload bypass
intro: The emergency overload bypass, or emergency bypass control, was an engineering component aboard starships which acted to prevent a catastrophic explosion in the event of loss of magnetic containment. It was accessed through the matter-antimatter integrator control, located just off the main engineering section.

title: Emergency stabilization control
intro: An emergency stabilization control was a safety precaution on Starfleet runabouts used to stabilize the ship when the plasma injectors encountered a leak.

title: Emergency turbolift
intro: The emergency turbolift was a special turbolift aboard starships. It was an express turbolift connecting the main bridge and the battle bridge.

title: Emerson
intro: The Emerson was a Federation Type 14 shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the early 25th century. It was attached to the .

title: Eminiar VII Starbase
intro: Eminiar VII Starbase was a Federation starbase on Eminiar VII in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Emitter relay
intro: Emitter relays were components of tractor beams utilized aboard Starfleet vessels in the 24th century.

title: Emmette type
intro: The Emmette type was a type of starship operated on Earth and by the Terran Empire before the of starships.

title: Empok Nor

infobox.caption: A Ferengi vessel approaches Empok Nor in 2374
infobox.docking: 6 large [[docking pylon]] ports; 3 medium docking ring ports; 9 small docking ring ports; 6 [[landing pad]]s

intro: Empok Nor was a Cardassian space station in the Trivas system, Alpha Quadrant. This station was almost identical to Terok Nor (later known as Deep Space 9), which was no more than three light years away from its sister station.

title: Endeavour (OV-105)
intro: Endeavour (OV-105) was an American space shuttle orbiter that was operated by NASA from the 1980s to the 2000s. In 2011, it was retired along with the other surviving shuttles from the first generation of space shuttles. ()

title: Energy convector chamber
intro: The energy convector chamber was a room on board the starships. Its location on Deck H was labeled in the ship's master systems display. ()

title: Engineering
intro: Engineering, main engineering, or the engine room (the reactor pit in Klingonese), was the location from which the ship's main power systems were controlled. Engineering was the primary assignment of engineers and chief engineers.

title: Engineering circuit bay
intro: The engineering circuit bay was a designation associated with certain Jefferies tubes in starships.

title: Engineering core
intro: The engineering core was a protected area in the center of main engineering aboard starships during the 23rd century. It was protected by the core hatch. ()

title: Engineering department
intro: The engineering department or engineering division was a major department aboard Starfleet starships.

title: Engineering laboratory
intro: The engineering laboratory was one of many science labs aboard a starship like the .

title: Engineering station
intro: Although most engineering functions were controlled from the engine room, engineering stations on the bridge of starships enabled monitoring and control by the chief engineer. These bridge stations were often identified as Engineering I and Engineering II. (, , , , )

title: Engineering test bay alpha
intro: Engineering test bay alpha was a section of engineering on the starship . A standard engineering workspace specially converted to accommodate the spore drive, it housed the reaction cube, mycelium spore storage canisters, and a secured passageway to an adjacent cultivation bay where Paul Stamets grew his spores. ()

title: Engle class
intro: The Engle-class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 2250s.

intro: Enolian patrol ships were a type of heavily armed patrol ships utilized by the Enolian Guard for patrol duty during the mid-22nd century.

title: Enolian prison transport
intro: The Enolian prison transport was a type of prison transport used by the Enolian Guard to move groups of people to prison colonies from Keto-Enol, as crime was rampant in their system.

title: Enolian shuttle
intro: The Enolian shuttle was a small shuttlecraft utilized by some Enolians, but not by the Enolian Guard. It was capable of warp speed and was equipped with fore and aft particle cannons. It was capable of holding at least sixteen occupants.

title: Enterprise (NX-01)
intro: One of the most important starships in interstellar history, Enterprise (NX-01), later redesignated the USS Enterprise, was the culmination of the NX Project. The NX-01 was the first starship, launched by the United Earth Starfleet in 2151. ()

intro: One of the most important starships in interstellar history, Enterprise (NX-01), later redesignated the USS Enterprise, was the culmination of the NX Project. The NX-01 was the first starship, launched by the United Earth Starfleet in 2151. ()

title: Enterprise (OV-101)
intro: Enterprise (OV-101) was an American space shuttle orbiter.

title: Environment station
intro: Aboard a Federation starship, an environment station was a console from which shipboard environmental operations were monitored and controlled.

title: Environmental control
intro: The environmental controls of a starship, space station, or even a colony were used to regulate atmospheric conditions including, but not limited to, the concentration of varying gases, lighting, temperature, humidity, and gravity.

title: Environmental engineering
intro: Environmental engineering (or life support center) was a section aboard starships where all activities on the ship were controlled and monitored. This section was located in the primary hull.

title: Epsilon-5
intro: In 2262, Carol Marcus and David Marcus, her and James T. Kirk's son, were due to spend a weekend with Kirk before they departed for Epsilon-5. However, Kirk postponed their meeting to attend a Future Federation Leaders retreat, and was subsequently delayed by the discovery of the . Carol then decided they would leave without him. ()

intro: The Erewon class was a type of Federation civilian personnel transport operated during the 24th century that could be used as a colony ship. The Erewon class was about four times larger than a runabout.

title: Erstwhile
intro: The Erstwhile was an interplanetary Class 9 cargo vessel owned and operated by Captain Thadiun Okona in the mid-24th century.

title: Escape pod
intro: In spacecraft classification, an escape pod (also known as an evacuation pod, evacuation shuttle, life boat, life craft, life pod, rescue capsule, or rescue pod) was a type of auxiliary space vessel found aboard most starships used in the event the crew needed to leave the ship, particularly in an emergency.

title: Escape shuttle
intro: An escape shuttle was a type of escape pod kept aboard the Regent's flagship of the mirror universe.

title: Escort vessel
intro: An escort vessel was a starship whose primary purpose was to accompany and protect other vessels.

title: Etanian starship
intro: The Etanian starship was a class of starship in use by the Etanians in the late-24th century.

title: Eternal Gallery and Archive
intro: The Eternal Gallery and Archive, usually simply called the Archive or the Eternal Archive, was an interstellar library and repository that operated from at least the 23rd to the 32nd centuries. It was located on a large space station that changed location approximately every fifty years.

title: Evacuation corridor
intro: Evacuation corridors were a set of long, foldable bridges in the "neck" of starships that could fold out and dock with another spacecraft. Once sealed with force fields, they allowed for rapid evacuation of the crew.

title: Evaluation laboratory
intro: The evaluation laboratory was a laboratory aboard . The laboratory was next to or very near to the ship's auxiliary control center. A wall-mounted piece of equipment was outside the main entrance to the laboratory, while down the corridor was the entrance to a vertical Jefferies tube as well as a wall-mounted communications panel.

title: Excelsior II class
intro: The Excelsior II class was a Federation starship class that was in service with Starfleet by the early 25th century.

title: Excelsior class

infobox.name: ''Excelsior''-class
infobox.t1caption2: Profile and overview of the Excelsior

intro: The Excelsior-class was a type of Federation starship used by Starfleet between the late 23rd and late 24th centuries. It was the backbone of Starfleet for over a century, making it one of the fleet's longest-serving and most recognizable starship designs.

title: Excelsior class decks
intro: Most features here are derived from the Enterprise-B master systems display (MSD) production art, depicting the internal arrangement of all the decks of an Excelsior-class starship with several locations labeled. The graphic was prominently featured in Star Trek Generations on the Enterprise-B bridge set. The legible version of the graphic was published in Star Trek: The Next Generation Sketchbook: The Movies. The MSD was a creation by Scenic Artist Doug Drexler, who recalled, "I enjoyed laying cross sections out, and was proud that [[Michael Okuda|Mike [Okuda]]] thought I was the guy for the job."

title: Executive class
intro: The Executive class was a class of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the 23rd and 24th centuries. This shuttle class was known to be used for orbital personnel transport. (; )

title: Exobiology department
intro: The exobiology department was a science found aboard Federation starships during the 24th century, that specialized in the studies of exobiology. During the 23rd century, this department was identified under the moniker astrobiology.

title: Exobiology department
intro: The exobiology department was a science found aboard Federation starships during the 24th century, that specialized in the studies of exobiology. During the 23rd century, this department was identified under the moniker astrobiology.

title: Exobiology lab
intro: The exobiology lab was a laboratory aboard the NX class that specialized in the study of exobiology.

title: Experimentation chamber
intro: An experimentation chamber was a piece of equipment available on Starfleet starships.

title: Experts Demise
intro: Experts Demise was a ski slope on the Cosmic Duchess of considerable difficulty; which, as the name implied, was considered dangerous even for expert skiers. The beginning of the slope was located near that of another on the same artificial mountain, Cowards Gulch, and the end of a cliff.

title: Exploration vessel
intro: In starship classification, an exploration vessel or exploratory vessel was a type of spacecraft designed for exploring unknown regions of space, operated by individuals who fancied themselves as explorers.

title: Exploratory outpost
intro: An exploratory outpost was a type of facility created by the Makers. Following the nova of their sun, only a few survived. ()

title: Explorer S-55
intro: Explorer S-55 was an artificial satellite, launched by NASA from the United States of America, and orbited Earth during the mid-20th century. An image of this satellite was stored in the library computer of the . This image was later retrieved by the Talosians during their survey of the library computer's contents in 2254. ()

title: Explosive override
intro: An explosive override was a manual control that triggered explosive bolts which forced the opening of cargo bay doors. The override, located in the bay, was accessible after a panel had been removed. The override was used when automatic controls on the doors failed to work. Klingon Birds-of-Prey were equipped with this feature.

title: External lighting
intro: External lighting referred to the exterior lighting devices of land vehicles and space vehicles.

title: Extra galactic probe
intro: The extra galactic probe was a probe sent to the Milky Way Galaxy from outside the galaxy. Sometime prior to 2364, the encountered the probe. The location of this incident was marked in viewscreen readouts aboard the on several occasions in 2364, in the form of star charts from the Enterprise library computer. ()

title: Eymorg starship
intro: The Eymorg starship was a highly advanced starship operated by the Eymorg of Sigma Draconis VI during the mid-23rd century.

title: F/A station
intro: The F/A station was a station aboard the Earth Cargo Service freighter . A sign on the wall of cargo module 4 indicated the location of this station. ()

title: FGC
intro: FGC was a prefix used by the Federation in the 23rd and 24th centuries as part of a naming system for stars and other celestial objects. (, ; ; )

title: FGMS
intro: FGMS was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: FGMS Gyt'aerat
intro: The FGMS Gyt'aerat was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: FMS
intro: FMS was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: FMS Geldonero
intro: The FMS Geldonero was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: Fairview
intro: The Fairview was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . ()

title: Falcon 9
intro: The Falcon 9 was a rocket type of the early 21st century.

title: Faraday
intro: The Faraday was a Type 18 Federation shuttlepod in service to Starfleet during the 24th century. It was attached to the . It was shuttlepod 01.

title: Farpoint Station

infobox.name: Farpoint Station
infobox.imagecap: Farpoint Station, as it first appeared

intro: Farpoint Station was a starbase built in an extremely short time on Deneb IV. The Bandi, a species inhabiting Deneb IV, offered this station to Starfleet. The Bandi were not a very advanced civilization and Starfleet was intrigued by this engineering performance.

title: Federation Headquarters

infobox.name: Federation Headquarters
infobox.caption: The Federation Headquarters aboard the USS Federation in the 3180s

intro: Federation Headquarters (Federation HQ or FHQ) was the administrative headquarters of the United Federation of Planets. Considered the Federation's home planet, Federation Headquarters was located on Earth until the 31st century. ()

title: Federation Medical Collection Station
intro: The Federation Medical Collection Station was an outpost that specialized in medicine. This type of outpost facilitated the retrieval and storage of samples of diseases, including plasma plagues. Because of the sensitive nature of the outpost's work, there were Starfleet personnel who worked at the post under the supervision of a ranking individual known as a medical trustee.

title: Federation attack fighter
intro: The Federation attack fighter was a type of small Federation starship utilized by civilians and Starfleet alike, as well as by Starfleet Academy, where they were used as Academy flight trainers. They were classified by Starfleet as an attack fighter, and were prominently featured during the Dominion War. ()

title: Federation cargo shuttle
intro: A Federation cargo shuttle was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in the 2250s and 2260s. Military shuttles used the same basic frame. (, )

title: Federation cargo vessel
intro: A Federation cargo vessel was a class of cargo vessel operated by the Federation during the mid-23rd century that was used for hauling radioactive ore. Due to the nature of its function, the ship's hull was transport resistant and was equipped with minimal .

title: Federation class

infobox.name: ''Federation'' class
infobox.caption: Display model of a Federation class starship

intro: The Federation-class was a type of 23rd century Federation dreadnought-type starship constructed by Starfleet.

title: Federation communications satellite
intro: Federation communications satellites were a type of artificial satellite used as part of Earth's satellite network.

title: Federation holoship

infobox.name: Federation holoship
infobox.caption: Forward view
infobox.caption2: Aft view, in tow behind Ru'afo's flagship

intro: The Federation holoship was a prototype Federation starship first launched in early 2375.

title: Federation mission scoutship
intro: The Federation mission scoutship was a type of Federation scout ship in operation by Starfleet during the late 24th century.

title: Federation scout ship
intro: A Federation scout ship was a type of small Federation-built one-man scout ship of common design, utilized during the latter half of the 23rd century by Federation citizens. The ships of this class were not capable of outrunning a Klingon battle cruiser for long periods of time.

title: Federation shuttle (2385)

infobox.name: Federation shuttle (2385)
infobox.caption: A shuttle departs a ground based facility at Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards

intro: The Federation shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type in use by Starfleet in 2385.

title: Federation shuttlecraft
intro: Multiple concept sketches of Federation shuttles designed for can be seen at Trekcore.

title: Federation starship classes
intro: The following is a list of starship classes operated by the Federation.

title: Federation starship decks
intro: Starships within the Federation, much like those found throughout the universe, were built with decks which served as the primary setting for all equipment, rooms, corridors, and personnel. The numbers for the deck count typically ran from top to bottom of a starship, beginning with deck 1. There was no set number of decks within Starfleet or Federation ships, as it varied from class to class.

title: Federation starships
intro: The Federation operated numerous varieties of starships. While the Prime Directive was observed aboard Starfleet vessels, this was not true of civilian ships. ()

title: Federation transport container
intro: The Federation transport container was a type of Federation spacecraft used by Starfleet in the 23rd and 24th centuries for transporting people and cargo. There were several variants of transport containers.

title: Federation tug (2374)

infobox.name: Federation tug
infobox.caption: Ship of the class towing Fredrickson

intro: A Federation tug was a class of small specialized tug starships used exclusively for towing damaged or disabled vessels. These ships were used by the Federation and operated by Starfleet in the 24th century.

title: Fenris Ranger vessel

infobox.name: Fenris Ranger vessel
infobox.image2: SS Eleos XII and two Fenris Ranger vessels.jpg
infobox.caption2: Two Fenris Ranger vessels approaching the {{SS|Eleos XII}}
infobox.caption: Profile of a Fenris Ranger vessel

intro: The Fenris Ranger vessel was a class of warp-capable vessel utilized by the Fenris Rangers during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. They were armed with directed energy weapons and flown with a single pilot. They had the capacity to carry cargo, but did not have transporter capabilities and were thus required to dock with other vessels in order to board them.

title: Ferengi cargo ship
intro: The Ferengi cargo ship was a was a generic term used to described any type of cargo ship used in the Ferengi Alliance during the mid-24th century.

title: Ferengi casino ship
intro: A Ferengi casino ship was a starship type operated by the Ferengi Alliance. It was a mobile gambling platform built to accommodate large numbers of passengers and featuring a variety of games and other entertainments such as dabo.

title: Ferengi garbage scow
intro: A Ferengi garbage scow was a type of garbage scow utilized by the Ferengi as a means of controlling their waste management.

title: Ferengi probe
intro: The Ferengi probe was a type of unmanned sensor drone utilized by the Ferengi during the late-24th century.

title: Ferengi shuttle

infobox.name:
Ferengi shuttle
{{small|(aka Ferengi pod)}}
infobox.caption: Vessel of the class, at warp

intro: The Ferengi shuttle, also sometimes referred to as a Ferengi pod or Ferengi ship was a warp-capable shuttlecraft used as an auxiliary vehicle and utilized by prominent businessmen in the Ferengi Alliance during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Ferengi starships
intro: The following is a list of starships used by the Ferengi and Ferengi Alliance:

title: Fermi
intro: The Fermi was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 16.

title: Fesarius
intro: The Fesarius was a starship built and operated by the First Federation, encountered in the mid-23rd century. It was described as the flagship by its captain and only crewmember, Commander Balok.

title: Feynman (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Feynman was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 05.

title: Feynman (shuttlepod)

infobox.caption: The Feynman listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Feynman''

intro: The Feynman was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 19.

title: Feynman (shuttlepod)

infobox.caption: The Feynman listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Feynman''

intro: The Feynman was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 19.

title: Fictional spacecraft
intro: Fictional spacecraft were those that existed only in fictional settings, such as artistic works, bluffs, and speculation. Further examples include illusory or holographic spacecraft.

title: Field coil
intro: The field coil was a form of technology designed to transmit subspace emissions, which functioned as key components in starship and space station operations, including the sensors, warp drive and communications systems. ()

title: Field stabilizer
intro: A field stabilizer was a stabilizing component of a starship controlled by the ship's engine room.

title: Fighter shuttle
intro: In starship classification, a fighter shuttle was a shuttlecraft intended for combat situations.

title: Filtration system
intro: The filtration system was a system aboard starships.

title: Fina Prime
intro: Fina Prime was the inhabited prime planet in its star system, in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Finibus VI
intro: Finibus VI was the sixth and outermost planet of the Finibus system, Beta Quadrant. It was class H and had two moon, one of which was an asteroid. In the mid-23rd century, a Federation science outpost was located on the planet.

title: First officer's position
intro: The first officer's position was a station on the bridge of several 24th century starships. Directly adjacent to the command chair, the first officer could easily discuss the mission with his or her commanding officer. Most versions of the first officer's position either had their own command console or shared one with the commanding officer, although some versions had none at all. In addition, some versions could swivel, allowing the occupant to face any other station on the bridge.

title: Flagship
intro: A flagship was a status given to a starship considered to be the premier ship of a fleet. Typically, a flagship was a vessel commanded by a flag officer (an admiral or similar rank). The term was also properly applied to the ship of whichever commanding officer was in charge of a grouping of ships. A third, more colloquial usage of the term could mean that the ship in question was considered an "exemplar" of the best capabilities and virtues of the force it represented.

title: Flaxian ship
intro: The Flaxian ship was a type of starship employed by Flaxian assassin Retaya. The ship had a magneton relay.

title: Fleming
intro: The Fleming was a 24th century Federation starship operated by Starfleet. This medical transport was constructed of such materials as duranium and polycomposites.

title: Flight control
intro: In 2259, when Lieutenant Erica Ortegas first noticed Ensign near a light on deck 14, a message was broadcast through the public address system for an individual with the rank of yeoman. This individual was ordered to report to flight control. ()

title: Floor (level)
intro: A floor was the level base of a room, or the finished floor level of a building.

title: Fluid conduit
intro: Fluid conduits were distributions components aboard starships, designed to deliver various liquids to different parts of the ship.

title: Fluidic converter
intro: The fluidic converter was a component aboard a starship.

title: Focal array
intro: A focal array was a component of the navigational deflector of Federation starships, used for the generation and projection of specific types of energy.

title: Force activator
intro: A force activator was a component of the tractor beam for Federation starships. The activator was controlled from the engine room. The beam generated could be used for pulling in or repulsing an object.

title: Force field generator
intro: The force field generator was a class of artificial satellite used by the United Earth Defense Force for shielding the planet Earth from attack in the late 32nd century. When activated, the force field consisted of networked generators located in Earth orbit. ()

title: Foresight
intro: The Foresight was a Federation civilian emergency transport that was in service in the late 32nd century.

title: Fraddock's transport ship
intro: Fraddock's transport ship was a type of small 22nd century transport ship operated by Captain Fraddock.

title: Free Spirit
intro: The Free Spirit was a small starship owned and operated by Petra Aberdeen, an independent archaeologist and former Starfleet officer.

title: Freedom 7
intro: Freedom 7 was an American space capsule operated by NASA for its Project Mercury. It was the agency's first manned mission.

title: Freedom class (22nd century)
intro: The Freedom class was a small starship design operated by Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. After the formation of the in 2161, the Freedom-class cruiser was in the .

title: Freedom class (24th century)

infobox.name: ''Freedom'' class
infobox.caption: Wreckage of the Freedom-class USS Firebrand

intro: The Freedom-class starship was a type of vessel in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century.

title: Freighter
intro: In starship classification, freighters, cargo ships, cargo carriers, or cargo vessels were starship types designed to carry cargo, in much the same way transports carried passengers. A bulk freighter was a ship that carried bulk dry goods, comparable to how a tanker carried bulk liquid or gas goods.

title: Friendship 1
intro: Friendship 1 (UESPA-1) was a deep space probe launched by the United Earth Space Probe Agency in 2067 with the purpose of finding other species. The probe contained a great deal of technological, scientific, and cultural information, such as translation matrices, data on computer chips, transceivers, warp drive, and Vivaldi's The Four Seasons. As only four years had passed since first contact, Humanity was keen to find other intelligent lifeforms, but they were aware that the lifeforms they intended to find may be unaware of how to create a means of contacting Humanity, so the probe was equipped to inform any lifeforms on how to design communication arrays.

title: Friendship 7
intro: Friendship 7 was an American space capsule operated by NASA for its Project Mercury. It was the agency's first manned orbital mission. The pilot on this flight was astronaut John Glenn. ()

title: Friendship class
intro: The Friendship class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design consisted solely of a saucer-shaped primary hull with an empty center, and two detached nacelles at the aft.

title: Frigate
intro: In starship classification, a frigate was a fast, medium-sized starship intended to protect other vessels.

title: Frunalian science vessel
intro: A Frunalian science vessel was a type of science vessel in operation during the 24th century.

title: Funny Face (shuttle)

infobox.caption: Funny Face departing the USS Discovery
infobox.name: ''Funny Face''

intro: Funny Face was a Federation Class C shuttle assigned to in the 33rd century. It was the last shuttle received by Discovery before its crew abandoned ship, and had never been flown or named.

title: GCA
intro: GCA was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: GCA Metlaok
intro: The GCA Metlaok was a starship in active service in the late 2360s.

title: GCS
intro: GCS was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: GCS Recio
intro: The GCS Recio was a 24th century starship registered for Federation travel.

title: GHD
intro: GHD was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: GHD Per'ot
intro: The GHD Per'ot was a 24th century starship registered for Federation travel. In 2370, the captain of this ship was R. Philbin. The starship's point of departure was Deneb XX. The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47566.8. The GHD Per'ot was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)

title: GS
intro: GS was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: GS 12
intro: GS 12 was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century. In 2370, the captain of this ship was H. Ellison. The starship's point of departure was Organia. The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47557.1. The GS 12 was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)

title: Gagarin IV
intro: Gagarin IV was the inhabited fourth planet of its system. The planet was located in the Gamma 7 sector, a spatial region in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Gagarin class
intro: The Gagarin class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Galactic starship design
intro: A galactic starship design was a starship design known to those in the Milky Way Galaxy.

title: Galador freighter
intro: Galador freighters were vessels utilized by the Galadorans during the 24th century.

title: Galaxy class

infobox.name: ''Galaxy'' class
infobox.caption: Forward ventral view
infobox.speed:
Warp 9.8 ''(theoretically achievable velocity, at extreme risk)''
Warp 9.6 ''(could be maintained for a few hours)''
Warp 6 ''(initial average [[cruise velocity]])''

intro: The Galaxy-class was a Starfleet heavy capital ship class first introduced in the mid 2360s. It was one of the largest and most powerful Federation starship classes of its time, with many serving in the Dominion War. Starfleet had previously operated another type of starship in the 2250s. ()

title: Galaxy class (23rd century)
intro: The Galaxy-class starship was a class of Starfleet vessel mentioned in the Treaty of Armens from 2255. It was stated in the treaty, that a UFP official from the Cultural Contact Office (Sol Sector) shall be on board a Galaxy-class Starfleet vessel at all times except during legal holidays.

title: Galileo (2259)
intro: The Galileo was a Stamets-type Federation shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. It was attached to the , with the number 7.

title: Galileo (2267)
intro: The Galileo (NCC-1701⁄7) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: Galileo (2267-2268)
intro: The Galileo (NCC-1701⁄7) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the . Galileo was the successor to a shuttle of the same name and hull number. ()

title: Galileo (2287)
intro: The Galileo was a Federation Type 4 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to the . It was shuttle 5.

title: Galileo (Type 6)

infobox.caption: Yar and Picard in the cockpit
infobox.caption2: Captain Picard and Tasha Yar disembarking the Galileo
infobox.name: ''Galileo''

intro: The Galileo was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle 07.

title: Galileo (Type 7)

infobox.caption: The first appearance of the Galileo
infobox.name: ''Galileo''

intro: The Galileo was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle 07.

title: Galileo (probe)
intro: The Galileo was a space probe operated by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the late 1990s. This probe was sent to study Jupiter and its many moons, including Europa. Images taken by the probe of this moon revealed "diverse details" of its surface.

title: Galileo II
intro: The Galileo II (NCC-1701⁄7) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the . Despite the name, there were at least three shuttles named Galileo attached to the Enterprise before this one.

title: Galipotan freighter
intro: Galipotan freighters were a class of freighter operated by the Galipotans during the late 24th century.

title: Galley
intro: A galley was a section located on a starship that provided facilities for preparation of food. On some starships, a chef operated the galley, preparing cuisine for the crew and guests. In essence a galley is the naval and Starfleet equivalent term of a kitchen. With the advent of replicator technology in the 24th century, use of a galley fell out of use on most Federation starships, with occasional exceptions.

title: Gallough
intro: The Gallough was a freighter similar to the Federation , in service during the 23rd century. It had been modified to carry passengers.

title: Galor class

infobox.name: ''Galor'' class
infobox.caption: Starboard quarter view
infobox.armament: 4 [[Galor class phaser bank|phaser banks]], large forward [[disruptor]]
infobox.image2: Trager hit near aft shield generator.jpg

intro: Galor-class cruisers were the primary class of warship used by the Cardassian military during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Gamma 7 outpost
intro: The Gamma 7 outpost was an outpost in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Gamma pulse generator
intro: Gamma pulse generators were a technology carried aboard starships, part of the electromagnetic scanners.

title: Garbage scow
intro: A garbage scow, also called garbage barge, was a type of starship designed to carry various unstable waste products, or in general, garbage.

title: Garment reprocessor
intro: A garment reprocessor was where soiled garments were deposited in the 24th century aboard Federation starships.

title: Gasko
intro: The Gasko was a Romulan starship that was in service for the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of 24th century.

title: Gatherer outpost
intro: A Gatherer outpost was a small encampment of Gatherers, the nomadic marauders who hailed from the planet Acamar III. The first of these outposts was established in 2266. Since then, these outposts have moved location, from star system to star system, making them difficult for Acamarians and Starfleet alike to find them. In 2366, a Gatherer outpost was discovered on the planet Gamma Hromi II by the Federation starship .

title: Gav'Nor

infobox.caption: The black box of the Gav'Nor (right)
infobox.name: ''Gav'Nor''

intro: The Gav'Nor was a 31st century starship destroyed by the Burn circa 3069.

title: Gavarian ship
intro: A Gavarian ship was a type of starship utilized during the mid-22nd century.

title: Gedana post
intro: The Gedana post was a outpost where Arjin's father was a pilot instructor for forty years during the 24th century. ()

title: Gelnon's attack ship
intro: Gelnon's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship commanded by Gelnon in 2374. Its Jem'Hadar crew included Kudak'Etan, Ixtana'Rax, Lamat'Ukan and Duran'Adar.

title: Gelrakian boarding pod
intro: Gelrakian boarding pods were auxiliary craft integrated into Gelrakian ships that were used for transporting Gelrakian boarding parties onto enemy vessels.

title: Gelrakian ship
intro: A Gelrakian ship was a type of starship of Gelrakian origin utilized during the late 24th century.

title: Gem's starship
intro: Gem's starship was a small multi-deck Ferengi starship operated by .

title: Gemini 8
intro: Gemini 8 was an early manned mission. This mission was part of NASA's Gemini program. This program was sandwiched between the earlier Mercury and later Apollo programs of manned space flight. One of the milestones of this program was achieved by Gemini 8 on March 16, 1966.

title: Gemini capsule

infobox.name: Gemini capsule
infobox.caption: A model of the Gemini capsule

intro: The Gemini capsule was a mid-20th century space capsule used by NASA for the Gemini Project, the second manned program in the space agency's history.

title: Generational ship
intro: A generational ship, or generation ship, was a starship in which, over an extended period of time, the operations of the ship were passed down to successive generations of the crew's descendants. They were typically used by races who did not have access to warp drive technology for lengthy travel across space.

title: Genorex
intro: The Genorex was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the late 24th century.

title: Geo-terraforming vessel
intro: A geo-terraforming vessel was a type of Federation starship.

title: Geological research
intro: Geological research was a science department section on starships that specialized in geology.

title: Geomagnetic compensator
intro: A geomagnetic compensator was a type of artificial satellite developed by the Alshain to compensate for the shifting of Alshain IV's magnetic poles, which began in the late 29th century and would have otherwise impaired the Alshain's ability to navigate during flight. The satellites used dilithium to stabilize their power supply.

title: Geophysics
intro: Geophysics was the branch of planetary sciences that studied the physics of a planet's atmosphere and geology. A scientist who studied geophysics was known as a geophysicist.

title: Geoplastics
intro: Geoplastics was section aboard Regula I during the late 23rd century. It was located across from gravitronics.

title: Georgiou's transport
intro: Georgiou's transport was a shuttlecraft used for ferrying Emperor to the in 2255.

title: Geoterraforming vessel
intro: A geoterraforming vessel was a type of starship.

title: Geronimo
intro: The Geronimo (NCC-7901), also identified as "shuttlecraft 12648", was a 23rd century Federation shuttlecraft that was in service in the 2250s. This type of shuttlecraft had a large aft section with dorsal mounted nacelles. This type of shuttle was protected by blast shields.

title: Geronimo
intro: The Geronimo (NCC-7901), also identified as "shuttlecraft 12648", was a 23rd century Federation shuttlecraft that was in service in the 2250s. This type of shuttlecraft had a large aft section with dorsal mounted nacelles. This type of shuttle was protected by blast shields.

title: Gillespie (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Gillespie was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .

title: Gilliam
intro: The Gilliam was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: Goddard
intro: The Goddard was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 15, replacing the shuttlecraft Magellan lost in 2368.

title: Golorian trading vessel
intro: A Golorian trading vessel was a type of freighter employed in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.

title: Gomtuu

infobox.caption: Gomtuu in orbit of Beta Stromgren (2366)

intro: Gomtuu was a sentient spaceborne organic creature that functioned as a space vessel, and lived for several millennia up through the 24th century. It survived a near-extinction of its race and may have been the last of its kind. It seemed to have been "born" far from Federation space, possibly in another galaxy. Upon its discovery by the and the Romulan Star Empire, it was dubbed "Tin Man" and the "Star Creature", respectively.

title: Gorkon (shuttle)
intro: The Gorkon was a Federation Type 14 shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the early 25th century. It was attached to the .

title: Gorn attack ship
intro: The Gorn attack ship was a type of attack ship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.

title: Gorn destroyer
intro: The Gorn destroyer was a type of massive warship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.

title: Gorn hunter ship
intro: The Gorn hunter ship was a type of small warship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.

title: Gorn trading vessel
intro: A Gorn trading vessel was a type of raider utilized by the Gorn Hegemony during the mid-23rd century for conducting raids. The Gorn ship was designed with four nacelles, and its class configuration was unfamiliar to the Federation prior to the late 2260s. ()

title: Gorn warship
intro: The Gorn warship was a type of warship utilized by the Gorn of the mirror universe during the 22nd century.

title: Goroth's starship type
intro: Goroth's starship-type was a transport ship utilized by the Klingon Empire from at least the 2150's through the 2380's.

title: Grain ship
intro: A grain ship was a type of freighter specifically used to carry loads of grain. The s' NCC-G1465 and NCC-61465 were examples of this kind of vessel. ()

title: Gral class
intro: The Gral-class was a class of starship operated by Starfleet during the mid-23rd century, named for the 22nd century Tellarite diplomat Gral. ()

title: Graphenated corridor joist
intro: A graphenated corridor joist was a structural element used in the corridors of starships.

title: Grappler
intro: The grappler was a metal cable with an effector on the end that could be launched by a starship to grapple objects in space. The grapplers utilized a magnetic lock device to clamp to objects.

title: Gravimetric microprobe
intro: A gravimetric microprobe was a Starfleet device used aboard Deep Space 9.

title: Graviton catapult
intro: A graviton catapult was a unique form of technology, designed by an alien named Tash, that was created to propel a spacecraft across interstellar space.

title: Graviton field generator
intro: A graviton field generator, or simply graviton generator, was a piece of equipment utilized in such technologies as tractor beams, shields, and warp drives.

title: Graviton stabilizer
intro: A graviton stabilizer was a component in the artificial gravity generator. This stabilizer modulated the level of gravity produced, and if it failed, it could pull too hard and make a person feel ten kilograms heavier.

title: Gravitronics
intro: Gravitronics was section aboard Regula I during the late 23rd century. It was located across from geoplastics.

title: Gravity plate
intro: A gravity plate, also referred to as grav-plating, artificial gravity plating, or gravity net, was used to provide artificial gravity on starships. Gravity plating could be lined along a ship's exterior hull, or across the interior deck plates. It was created using an artificial gravity generator.

title: Gravity-control computer
intro: A gravity-control computer was a computer that maintained artificial gravity on starships.

title: Gray zone
intro: The gray zone was a section of the derelict Borg cube known as the . This zone, which housed former Borg Collective drones, was divided into research areas. The zone was accessed through a checkpoint.

title: Green sector
intro: Green sector was a section aboard scout ships.

title: Greenery storage
intro: Greenery storage was a section on the transport Kallisko.

title: Groumall
intro: The Groumall was a freighter that was in service with the Cardassian military in the late 24th century. Gul Dukat was assigned command of the Groumall after he was demoted for bringing his illegitimate daughter, Tora Ziyal, back to Cardassia Prime. Glinn Damar also served on board as the first officer.

title: Groumall type
intro: The Groumall type was a type of starship utilized throughout the Cardassian Union during the late 24th century.

title: Guidance and navigation relay
intro: The guidance and navigation relay, or G and N relay, was a component of a runabout which was connected to the autopilot.

title: Guidance system
intro: The guidance system was a set of devices that was used to navigate a starship or other self-propelled device. On 23rd century starships the guidance system was also known as guidance computers.

title: Gymnasium
intro: A gymnasium was an area of a starship which was dedicated to physical fitness and exercise. The gymnasium on board an starship was located on C Deck. It usually featured a number of items that could be used for the fitness of the crew, including exercise bikes, treadmills, and weights. ()

title: Gyromagnetic stabilizer
intro: A gyromagnetic stabilizer was a type of stabilizer found on starships.

title: H
intro: H was a one-letter prefix for Federation-registered evacuation pods used on in the late 24th century. ()

intro: The H-46 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was the first in a chain of pods that ended with H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod and H-48 were the first and second pods to be launched in their chain.

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

intro: The H-48 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, H-46 and this pod were the first and second pods to be launched in their chain.

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

title: H-925

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

intro: The H-925 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod was the seventh and final to be launched in its chain.

title: H-926

infobox.caption: H-46 and other ''Sovereign''-type escape pods
infobox.class: [[Sovereign type escape pod|''Sovereign'' type escape pod]]

intro: The H-926 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was the end point of a chain of pods that began with H-46 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod was the fifth to be launched in its chain.

title: HMS
intro: HMS was a registry prefix that was used both in historical Earth naval ships and in starships.
