intro: The "HMS Bounty" was the name given to the Klingon Bird-of-Prey commandeered by James T. Kirk and his command crew in 2285. The name was originally suggested by Dr. Leonard McCoy as an ironic joke, in reference to the famous sea-going vessel of the same name which was taken over by mutineers in the 18th century. The vessel's new name was painted on the hull in large, orange letters. ()

title: HMS Lord Nelson

infobox.caption: The HMS Lord Nelson listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: HMS ''Lord Nelson''

intro: HMS Lord Nelson was a Terran DY-500-B (sub)class starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.

title: HMS New Zealand

infobox.caption: The HMS New Zealand listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: HMS ''New Zealand''

intro: HMS New Zealand was a Terran [[DY-732|DY-732 [N]-class]] starship that was in service in the early 22nd century. New Zealand was under the command of Captain Bob Lederman.

title: Haakona
intro: The Haakona was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the mid-24th century.

title: Haakonian shuttle
intro: A Haakonian shuttle was an interstellar vessel used by the Haakonians. The vessel was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.

title: Hand hold
intro: Hand holds were part of a starship's interior that personnel could grasp to brace or stabilize themselves.

title: Hangar
intro: A hangar was a facility for storing aircraft in the 20th century. Such facilities were also used for storing shuttlecraft and starships in the 23rd and 24th centuries.

title: Hangar 1 (Enterprise-D)
intro: Hangar 1 was a shuttlecraft storage facility aboard the .

title: Hangar 2
intro: File:Type 7 shuttlecraft LCARS.jpg|Hangar 2 listed on a LCARS display

title: Hangar 3
intro: Hangar 3 was a shuttlecraft storage facility aboard the .

title: Hangar 4
intro: Hangar 4 was a shuttlepod storage facility aboard the .

title: Hangar 5
intro: Hangar 5 was a shuttlepod storage facility aboard the .

title: Hangar 7
intro: In 2259, and boarded the Vengeance through the 101A cargo door airlock in this hangar. ()

title: Haru outposts
intro: The Haru outposts were Cardassian military outposts during the Cardassian Occupation of Bajor.

title: Hatch
intro: A hatch, also known as an access hatch, access panel, access plate, or trapdoor, was a type of access point used to enter or exit one area to another, in many cases for maintenance purposes. It could be opened manually or by remote.

title: Havana (starship)
intro: The Havana was a 24th century Federation starship.

title: Hawking (2367)
intro: The Hawking was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .

title: Hawking (Type 6C)
intro: The Hawking was a Federation Type 6C shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . It was the second shuttle named for Stephen Hawking aboard the Enterprise-D, and it was shuttle 15.

title: Hazari shuttle
intro: The Hazari shuttle was an advanced shuttle used by Hazari bounty hunters. This two person craft was equipped with advanced directed energy weapons, and was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.

title: Hazari vessel

infobox.name: Hazari vessel
infobox.caption: Vessel of the class, in debris field

intro: The Hazari vessel was a heavily armed starship used by Hazari bounty hunters, equipped with advanced directed energy weapons, spatial charges, and a tractor beam.

title: Hearing room
intro: A hearing room was a room aboard a starship where a was held.

title: Heat-dissipation unit
intro: Heat-dissipation units were among the systems of the starships of the 23rd century. They permitted the ship to dispose of excess , presumably by transferring it to deep space. They were active systems that required power to operate.

title: Heavy cruiser
intro: In starship classification, a heavy cruiser was a large multi-purpose starship.

title: Heavy long range warp shuttle
intro: A heavy long range warp shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft in the mid-to-late 24th century.

title: Heinlein

infobox.caption: The Heinlein listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Heinlein''

intro: The Heinlein was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod number 08.

title: Hekaran starship
intro: A Hekaran starship was a type of starship employed by the Hekarans during the late 24th century. These ships were equipped with transporter systems, and could be operated by a single crewmember.

title: Helios class

infobox.name: ''Helios'' class
infobox.caption: A tug in drydock in 2385
infobox.caption2: Two tugs tow the Enterprise in the 2250s

intro: The Helios class was a type of tug used by the Federation Starfleet during the 23rd and 24th centuries. They were equipped with tractor beams for towing starships.

title: Helm
intro: Helm (or helm control) was a term derived from old Earth navy parlance used to describe the person either steering or commanding a sailing vessel. By the age of spaceflight, the term was used to describe the flight control operations on board a starship or shuttlecraft, located on the bridge. ()

title: Hemshir
intro: The Hemshir was a cargo cruiser in operation during the late 32nd century.

title: Hermes (shuttle)
intro: The Hermes was a Federation Type 14 shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the early 25th century.

title: Hermes class
intro: The Hermes-class was a type of 23rd century Federation scout ship operated by Starfleet.

title: Heva VII refueling port
intro: The Heva VII refueling port was a space station located at Heva VII which provided fuel to spacecraft.

title: Hiawatha type
intro: The Hiawatha type was a Federation medical frigate operated by Starfleet during the 2250s and 2260s.

intro: The Hierarchy survey vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Overlookers.

intro: A Hirogen ship or Hirogen vessel was a type of small, heavily-armed hunting vessel used by Hirogen s during the 2370s as they hunted prey throughout the Delta Quadrant.

title: Hirogen training facility
intro: The Hirogen training facility was a space station built by the Hirogen incorporating holographic technology from the Federation starship, .

title: Holding vessel
intro: A holding vessel was a starship which could be used for storage of goods.

title: Holodeck
intro: A holographic environment simulator, re-creation room or holodeck was a holographic simulation room designed and used by the Federation Starfleet which ran holographic programs. They were installed aboard starships, space stations, and at Starfleet institutions during the mid-24th century for use in entertainment, training, and investigative purposes, after decades of improvements prompted by a failed experiment in 2261. (; )

title: Holograms' ship
intro: The holograms' ship was Hirogen starship that was commandeered by Iden and a number of Hirogen-created holograms in 2377. It was the vehicle used to drive Iden's Rebellion. ()

title: Holographic lab
intro: A holographic lab, or hololab, was a facility were holograms would go for maintenance.

title: Holographic research lab
intro: A holographic research lab was a science laboratory equipped with holoemitters that allowed holographic testing of scientific hypotheses, ship designs, and other investigations. It appeared the same as a holodeck, with the exception of a control console in the center of the room. was equipped with such a facility.

title: Hoover class
intro: The Hoover class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: Horizon (starship)
intro: The Horizon was an early Federation starship that was in service during the mid-22nd century.

title: Hou-Yi class
intro: The Hou-Yi class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.

title: Housing area
intro: The housing area was an area reserved for quarters aboard the starships. This area partially occupied sections from nine decks of the ship. The area's location in the was labeled in the ship's master systems display. ()

title: Hubble Deep Space Station
intro: Hubble Deep Space Station was a deep space station.

title: Hubble Space Telescope
intro: Hubble Space Telescope was a manned space telescope.

title: Hull
intro: The term hull refers to the body or frame of a ship or starship. Warp-worthy vessels must have a hull able to withstand extreme accelerations. The hull of a Starfleet vessel was usually separated into two parts: the primary and secondary hulls. Hull plating was an external armor component of a starship's or shuttle's hull. Hull resiliency was a measurement of how well a hull could withstand damage.

title: Hull plating
intro: Hull plating was an external armor component of a starship's or shuttle's hull which allowed for greater resistance against space debris and enemy weapons fire. They were capable of conducting electricity.

title: Hull plating relay
intro: Hull plating relays were a technology integral to polarizing the hull plating of 22nd century Starfleet starships.

title: Hull pressure compartment
intro: A hull pressure compartment was a notable section of a Federation starship.

title: Hunhau drone
intro: The Hunhau drone was a small, flying device used by the Emerald Chain at the salvage yard on Hunhau. It had the capability of identifying materials through analysis.

title: Hunters' ship
intro: The Hunters' ship was a type of starship utilized by the Gamma Quadrant species, known simply as the Hunters, during the late-24th century. It was equipped with an emitter that could fire an unusual type of radiation at a target, with the effect of reversing the polarity of their shields allowing for transporters to penetrate. When in motion, the ship's engines also gave off detectable ionized L-band emissions, identical to that of the Tosk's ship.

title: Hunting vessel
intro: In starship classification, a hunting vessel was a designation given by the Hirogen to describe their two-person vessels, as well as their larger ships. ()

title: Huron type
intro: The Huron-type was a small 23rd century Federation starship identified as a freighter.

title: Husnock warship
intro: Husnock warships were large starships operated by the Husnock prior to 2366. This type of vessel was much larger than a starship, capable of being seen from the surface while in orbit, and capable of destroying all life on a planet.

title: Hydraulic manifold
intro: A hydraulic manifold was a hydraulics component of both the port and starboard nacelle pylons aboard the NX-Alpha and NX-Beta.

title: Hydraulic probe
intro: A hydraulic probe was a probe used for terraforming.

title: Hydro vent
intro: A hydro vent was a type of technology located on refitted vessels.

title: Hydroponics bay
intro: A hydroponic(s) bay, hydroponic(s) garden, hydroponic greenhouse, or hydroponic pod was the area of a starship, starbase, or planet devoted to hydroponics: the growing of plants in a non-soil medium. Due to their nature, it was not unheard of for them to create swamps in spaces beneath the floor.

title: Hydroponics laboratory
intro: A hydroponics laboratory was a laboratory aboard a starship or starbase devoted to the study of hydroponics.

intro: The Hypatia was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 03, replacing the shuttlecraft lost in 2370.

title: IKS Hegh'ta

intro: The IKS M'Char was a Klingon Bird-of-Prey that was in service with the Klingon Defense Force in the late 24th century.

title: IKS Maht-H'a

intro: The IKS Malpara was a Klingon Bird-of-Prey that was in service with the Klingon Defense Force during the late 24th century.

title: IKS P'Rang

title: IKS Pagh

title: ISS
intro: ISS, short for Imperial Star Ship, was the prefix designation given to space-faring ships in the Terran Empire registry and in the Terran Resistance Forces in the mirror universe. ()

title: ISS Avenger
intro: The ISS Avenger (NX-09) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-22nd century. Avenger had fought for the Terran Empire in their war against rebels in the 2150s, and was one of several vessels destroyed by the starship during 's power struggle for the throne of the Empire.

title: ISS Buran
intro: The ISS Buran (NCC-1422) was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century. The ship's commanding officer was . ()

title: ISS Cerritos
intro: The ISS Cerritos was the mirror universe counterpart of the . In comparison to the Prime Cerritos, the ISS Cerritos carried more weaponry, including a pair of prominent weapons pods on top of the saucer, additional phaser banks, and two mission pods on rollbar structure, one above the main saucer and one above the secondary hull.

title: ISS Charon
intro: The ISS Charon was a starship that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century. Its captain was Maddox. Along with serving as the flagship of the Terran fleet, this vessel housed the palace of the Terran emperor, .

title: ISS Cooper
intro: The ISS Cooper was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century. The ship's commanding officer was Captain Spoeneman.

intro: The ISS Defiant (NX-74205) was a warship that was in service to the Terran Resistance Forces in the latter half of the 24th century. The Defiant was constructed and launched in 2372 by the Rebellion at , in orbit of the planet . The design of the Defiant was based on specifications of its counterpart the which were "acquired" from Deep Space 9 in 2371. This warship proved of crucial importance in fighting the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance at the Battle of Terok Nor, and represented an important boost to the Terrans' fighting power during the Terran Rebellion.

title: ISS Discovery
intro: The ISS Discovery (NCC-1031) was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century.

title: ISS Enterprise (NCC-1701)
intro: The ISS Enterprise (NCC-1701) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-23rd century.

title: ISS Enterprise (NX-01)
intro: The ISS Enterprise (NX-01) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-22nd century.

title: ISS Shenzhou
intro: The ISS Shenzhou (NCC-1227) was a starship that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century.

title: ISS Voyager (NCC-74656-A)
intro: The ISS Voyager (ISS-74656-A)/(NCC-74656-A) was a starship that was in service to in the late-24th century. The ship's commanding officer was Admiral .

title: ITA
intro: ITA was a identifying prefix used as part of the name for starships in the 24th century.

title: ITA Elmira
intro: The ITA Elmira was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: Iconian probe
intro: An Iconian probe was a spherical blue orb with energy tendrils arcing at random and which was employed by the ancient, powerful, and extinct Iconian race to download an operating system into a ship's computer core, presumably in order to facilitate communication. However, if the operating system of the ship is too different from the Iconian one, they will clash, causing the vessel and its systems to malfunction and possibly suffer catastrophic consequences. Once the ground-based computer detected an incoming vessel into orbit of Iconia, an automated sequence would begin launching one probe per vessel. The probes were housed in a launch bay in the planet's surface. If many were released at on

intro: The Ilia probe was an avatar of V'ger, a sophisticated android with the memories of Lieutenant Ilia, whom V'ger had previously abducted from the . The probe was designed to interact and inspect the carbon units it saw as infesting Enterprise.

title: Illusory spacecraft
intro: The following is a list of fictional spacecraft of an illusory nature, namely vessels created by some form of mental illusion.

title: Illyrian starship
intro: The Illyrian starship was a class of starship utilized by the Illyrians during the mid-22nd century. This class of vessel was equipped with a minimal armament of particle weapons and was tactically inferior to an starship. This class was also notable for having its primary warp coil, which was tied into the ship's injector system, protected by a force field.

title: Imhotep ship
intro: The Imhotep ship was a vessel used by the Imhotep species of the Delta Quadrant.

title: Impulse deck
intro: The impulse deck was an area on starships which housed the impulse engines.

title: Impulse ship
intro: An impulse ship was a spacecraft limited to impulse propulsion.

title: Indiana Jones

infobox.caption: The Indiana Jones on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Indiana Jones''

intro: The Indiana Jones was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 08.

title: Induction modulator
intro: An induction modulator was a piece of equipment used on starships and on Starbases.

title: Induction stabilizer
intro: The induction stabilizer was a stabilizer which was a part of a starship's deflector system. They were used by both the Federation and the Dominion.

title: Industrial fabrication facility
intro: An industrial fabrication facility was a large-scale replication establishment.

title: Inertial guidance system
intro: The inertial guidance system was a technological component of a starship that measured the distance traveled and automatically adjusted the course of a ship. When the system malfunctioned, the course adjustments were done manually.

title: Infinity (ship)
intro: The Infinity was an experimental Federation support courier that was specially designed and built for a rescue mission fifty-two years into the future.

title: Infinity Room
intro: The Infinity Room was a highly secure location apparently within Federation Headquarters. It was a featureless white space accessible only by transporter, which required possession of a device in the shape of an infinity symbol, small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand.

title: Infirmary
intro: An infirmary was a medical facility aboard a starbase, quite equal to that of a starship's sickbay.

title: Inquiry class
intro: The Inquiry class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. ()

title: Insectoid starship
intro: The insectoid starship was a derelict starship discovered by the during a 2269 starcharting mission. Once operated by ancient insectoids, it was not a recorded galactic starship design. ()

title: Inside Straight
intro: The Inside Straight was a starship owned by Captain Rupert Crandall.

title: Inspection pod
intro: An inspection pod was a type of auxiliary craft used by Starfleet in the 22nd century.

title: Intake manifold
intro: Intake manifolds were components on starships and s.

title: Interceptor
intro: In starship classification, an interceptor was a type of armed starship designed to intercept incoming or hostile craft. To this end, interceptors typically have powerful warp or impulse engines. () High-speed jet-aircraft specifically designed to intercept and destroy enemy aircraft were also known as Interceptors. ()

title: Interceptor One
intro: Interceptor One was the call sign of a Bajoran interceptor in service during the 2370s.

title: Intercooler matrix
intro: An intercooler matrix was a feature of Jem'Hadar fighters.

title: Interface probe
intro: An interface probe was a type of Federation probe designed to be controlled remotely via direct connection to a person's brain and respond to the movements that the person intended to make. The person controlling the probe wore an interface suit which provided tactile sensations in order to feel as if he or she was experiencing the same environment as the probe. The probe was configured with both tractor beams and phasers and transmitted information via a focused particle beam. It could also sense quantum fluctuations and subspace anomalies not perceptible by other types of sensors.

title: Interlock servo
intro: An interlock servo was an integral component found in Cardassian airlocks.

title: Intermediate room
intro: The intermediate room was a room on the starships.

title: Internal chronometer
intro: The internal chronometer was a part of a Soong-type android's construction. It functioned as a timekeeping device and could be switched off. () The starship also had internal chronometers. ()

intro: The International Space Station was a space station and one of Earth's first internationally combined efforts in exploring space. The station was jointly serviced by American space shuttle orbiters and Russian Soyuz and Progress spacecraft.

title: Interrogation room
intro: An interrogation room is a room generally used for interrogations. The has two rooms that are known to have been used for interrogations.

title: Intrepid
intro: The Intrepid was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. The ship's motto was "In Mare In Cælo" ("Into the Sea In the Sky").

title: Intrepid class decks
intro: The fifteen decks (with 257 rooms, including the holodeck) of an Federation starship. ()

title: Intrepid type
intro: The Intrepid type was a starship type in service with the United Earth Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. The class was armed with phase cannons and two torpedo launchers. ()

title: Intrepid type escape pod
intro: The Intrepid-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard and starships in the late 24th century. In the event of a ship-wide catastrophe, the pods could be launched as a last resort to save the crew. Once deployed, the pods were vulnerable to attack or becoming engulfed in the destruction of the parent ship. As in other types of Starfleet escape craft, the pods were equipped with thrusters, providing some chance of fleeing the field of combat. However, without warp drive, survivors were reliant on larger ships for ultimate rescue.

title: Io Facility

infobox.name: Io Facility
infobox.caption: The Io Facility dwarfed by Jupiter and Io

intro: The Io Facility was a top secret Starfleet Section 31 construction hangar located in orbit of the Jovian moon Io, at coordinates 23.17.46.11 in the Sol system. Shuttlecraft could enter the interior bay of the large enclosed drydock when panel sections on the side of the dock were rotated and moved out of the way. These craft ferried parts for a starship to at least one of twelve loading docks.

title: Ion exchange rod
intro: An ion exchange rod was a device used on a starship in the 2370s.

title: Ion plate
intro: An ion plate was a component of starships related to ion pods.

title: Ion pod
intro: The ion pod was an independent sensory component of starships. It was berthed in a ventral chamber on the secondary hull.

title: Irina's ship
intro: Irina's ship was a ship which took part in the first Antarian Trans-stellar Rally in 2377. It was co-piloted by Irina and Joxom. The ship was more maneuverable than the , though it still lost to the Flyer in an impromptu race.

title: Isolation door
intro: An isolation door was a special reinforced door designed to separate a hazardous area from the rest of a starship or space station. Isolation doors were often employed in main engineering, specifically to seal off the warp core and dangerous antimatter reactants in the event of a warp core breach or loss of antimatter containment.

title: Isolation ward
intro: An isolation ward was a special section for medical purposes to isolate a sickness for treatment.

title: Isomagnetic conduit
intro: An isomagnetic conduit was an energy-distribution component aboard some starships.

title: Iyaaran shuttle
intro: An Iyaaran shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft, capable of impulse speeds, in use by the Iyaarans in 2370. ()

title: J class
intro: The J-class was a starship design of Earth origin utilized by the Earth Cargo Service as a freighter. They were operated by captains with an Earth Cargo Authority license. These vessels had a history dating back to the early 22nd century, with one of the ships of the class, the , commissioned in 2102. ()

title: J'naii shuttle
intro: J'naii shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft, not capable of interstellar travel, in use by the J'naii in 2368. These J'naii shuttles carry plestorene-based backup systems. ()

title: JBK sensors synthostasis
intro: JBK sensors synthostasis were a type of technology used on Federation space stations in the 23rd century.

title: Jaradan probe
intro: The Jaradan probe was a long-range probe that was sent by the insect-like Jarada.

title: Jefferies tube
intro: A Jefferies tube, also known as a service crawlway or service duct was a type of access tunnel or internal maintenance conduit that was used to provide crew access to various ship's systems. In emergencies, they were also used for moving around the ship if turbolifts are not functional. Doors within the Jefferies tubes could be sealed for safety or security reasons.

title: Jein class
intro: The Jein class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.

title: Jelinian freighter
intro: The Jelinian freighter was a type of cargo ship in use by the Jelinians in the late-24th century.

title: Jellyfish (ship)
intro: The Jellyfish was a late 24th century starship commissioned by the Vulcan Science Academy for the transport of red matter. It was described as being "[their] fastest ship", and featured a rotating tail section.

title: Jem'Hadar battleship
intro: The Jem'Hadar or Dominion battleship was a type of warship introduced in the Alpha Quadrant in 2374, shortly after the outbreak of the Dominion War.

title: Jem'Hadar fighter
intro: A Jem'Hadar fighter, or Jem'Hadar attack ship, was a small type of warship that formed the bulk of the Dominion fleet. These versatile starships were also known to perform the roles of patrol ships and scout ships.

title: Jib
intro: In 2371, Jake Sisko reported that Sisko's lightship had lost its jib and port mainsail. ()

title: Jovis
intro: The Jovis was a Zibalian freighter that was in service in the mid-24th century. This ship was commanded by the unscrupulous trader and collector Kivas Fajo.

title: Jovis
intro: The Jovis was a Zibalian freighter that was in service in the mid-24th century. This ship was commanded by the unscrupulous trader and collector Kivas Fajo.

title: Ju'day class

title: Juhryan freighter
intro: Juhryan freighters were a type of 24th century freighter hailing from Juhraya.

title: Juice bar
intro: A juice bar was an establishment where juices were sold.

title: Jumpship
intro: A jumpship was a type of small atmospheric shuttlecraft that could be operated by a single pilot. Jumpships were used by Starfleet as emergency evacuation craft in the late 2250s of the .

title: Junction
intro: A junction was a crossing of maintenance shafts aboard a starship.

title: Junction room
intro: A junction room was a section both in 22nd century buildings and 24th century starships.

In the cockpit, the pilot's console was at the front, with the engineering console to the left and the communications console to the right. The ship had no offensive capabilities.

title: K't'inga class
intro: The K't'inga-class battle cruiser was a primary class of warship in service with the Klingon Imperial Fleet in the 23rd century, and with the Klingon Defense Force in the mid-to-late 24th century.

title: K'toch class
intro: K'toch class was a type of one-man Klingon scout ship in service during the mid-22nd century.

title: Kago's starship
intro: Kago's starship was a mid-22nd century vessel operated by the bounty hunter Kago.

title: Kalandan outpost
intro: The Kalandan outpost was an artificial planet located in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. This world was created by the Kalandans around the 1st millennium BC. It was approximately the same size as Luna but had a mass and atmosphere similar to that found on Earth. It was initially dubbed a ghost planet by James T. Kirk, as it seemed to fit no known planetary categorizations.

title: Kalandan supply ship
intro: A Kalandan supply ship was a type of supply ship operated by the Kalandans during the 1st millennium BC.

title: Kalara's ship
intro: Kalara's ship was part of an elaborate ruse that Kalara told members of the Federation, in an attempt to lure the to the planet Altamid, in order for Krall to obtain a piece of the Abronath.

title: Kallisko

title: Kantare escape pod

intro: The Karemma ship was a type of vessel utilized by the Karemma during the late 24th century.

title: Karemma transport

title: Karla Five's vessel

The vessel was capable of operating with only a single pilot and was capable of transporting only a few passengers. Its maximum warp was warp 36, and it was equipped with enough positive matter armament to ignite a dead star into life.

title: Kartelan freighter
intro: A Kartelan freighter was a type of freighter in service during the late 24th century.

title: Kataan probe

title: Kazon raider

title: Kazon ship

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (2280s)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (2280s)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (2280s)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (2280s)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (2280s)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.

title: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (32nd century)
intro: The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingon diaspora during the 32nd century.

title: Klingon civilian transport ship
intro: A Klingon civilian transport ship was a type of civilian transport, utilized in the Klingon Empire during the late 24th century.

title: Klingon cleave ship
intro: The Klingon cleave ship was a type of Klingon warship in service during the 23rd century. Massive in size, it mounted a large vertical blade on its bow that enabled it to ram and destroy opposing starships.

title: Klingon escape pod (22nd century)
intro: The Klingon escape pod was a type of emergency escape craft installed aboard warships in the Klingon Imperial Fleet during the mid-22nd century. Some Klingon vessel types, such as the scout ships, were not equipped with escape pods. ()

title: Klingon heavy cargo carrier
intro: A Klingon heavy cargo carrier was a cargo carrier design used by the Klingon Empire in the 32nd century.

title: Klingon raider
intro: The Klingon raider was a small starship used by the Klingons in the mid-23rd century. It was often carried aboard larger Klingon ships as an auxiliary craft. The ship was equipped with an antimatter power supply and were capable of achieving warp speeds. Its cockpit had seating for two, though it could be operated by only one individual. () It was classified as a shuttle. The craft's blade-like "wings" would flutter during atmospheric flight. ()

title: Klingon shuttlecraft
intro: The Klingon shuttlecraft was a type of small craft in use by the Klingons during early 22nd century.

title: Klingon starships
intro: The following is a list of starships of Klingon origin:

title: Klingon transport
intro: The Klingon transport was a type of small transport utilized within the Klingon Empire during the mid-22nd century. This type of vessel was characterized by a long fuselage section capped by a small, conical cockpit on its forward section and two typical warp nacelles aft. The ship was green in color, similar to other Klingon ships of that era.

title: Klingon warbird
intro: The Klingon warbird was a warbird class used by the Klingon Empire in the mid-22nd century.

title: Kobali shuttle
intro: The Kobali shuttle was a shuttlecraft employed by the Kobali during the 2370s.

title: Kobali starship
intro: The Kobali starship was a type of starship utilized by the Kobali species in the Delta Quadrant. One ship could be overpowered by an starship. ()

title: Kobayashi Maru
intro: The Kobayashi Maru (NCC-S3700) was a Federation Class III neutronic fuel carrier operated by Starfleet. It was an asset of the , a no-win scenario created by Starfleet Academy.

title: Kobheerian freighter
intro: A Kobheerian freighter was a freighter operated by the Kobheerians in the 24th century.

title: Kobliad transport
intro: The Kobliad transport ship was a type of transport ship utilized by the Kobliad in the late-24th century.

title: Koranak
intro: The Koranak was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Obsidian Order in the late 24th century.

title: Korma
intro: Korma was an inhabited planet in the Korma system, Alpha Quadrant.

title: Kornaire
intro: The Kornaire was a Cardassian warship that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century.

title: Korolev class

infobox.caption: USS Goddard listed as a Korolev-class starship
infobox.name: ''Korolev'' class

intro: The Korolev-class starship was a type of vessel in service with Starfleet during the 24th century. ()

title: Kostolain starship

infobox.name: Kostolain starship
infobox.caption: A Kostolain starship meets with the ''Enterprise''

intro: The Kostolain starship was a class of starship in use by the Kostolain natives in the late-24th century.

title: Kosygin Base

infobox.name: Kosygin Base
infobox.imagecap: A cargo crate from Kosygin Base

intro: Kosygin Base was an outpost within Federation space in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. This outpost provided outposts like the Regula I research station with goods.

title: Kotakian ship
intro: A Kotakian starship was a type of starship operated during the late 24th century.

title: Kotoi
intro: The Kotoi was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 07.

title: Kovaalan starship
intro: The Kovaalan starship was a type of armed starship used by the Kovaalans during the 22nd century.

title: Kovin's ship
intro: Kovin's ship was a vessel utilized by the Entharan arms merchant named Kovin. The vessel was equipped with various offensive and defensive armaments, including photon pulse weapons, and photonic pulse emitters.

title: Krall's command ship
intro: Krall's command ship was a ship piloted through Yorktown by Krall in 2263 of the . ()

title: Krasner outpost
intro: The Krasner outpost was an outpost that was involved in a military conflict involving the Federation before 2367. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Kraxon
intro: The Kraxon was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the late 24th century. In 2371, the Kraxon was under the command of Gul Ranor.

title: Kraylor medical transport
intro: The Kraylor medical transport was a class of warp-capable starship in use by the Kraylor in the late-24th century. They had few decks and their armament consisted of simple phasers. The Annari referred to this class vessel as a Kraylor warship. This class of vessel had multiple decks, warp 7+ capacity, was armed with phasers, and shields. The ship was also equipped with multiple escape pods and a shuttlebay large enough to carry the .

title: Krayton
intro: The Krayton was a Ferengi starship that was in service in the mid-24th century. Krayton was commanded by DaiMon Tog. Among Kraytons crew were Doctors Farek and Nibor.

title: Kreechta
intro: The Kreechta was a Ferengi marauder that was in service in the mid-24th century. Kreechta was commanded by DaiMon Bractor.

title: Kreetassan ship
intro: A Kreetassan starship was a type of starship utilized by the Kreetassans during the mid-22nd century. These vessels had warp capability and were about 100 meters long.

title: Krenim patrol ship
intro: A Krenim patrol ship was a starship used by the Krenim in the Delta Quadrant in 2374.

title: Krenim warship

infobox.name: Krenim warship
infobox.caption2: Vessel of the class, firing chroniton torpedo

intro: The Krenim warship was a type of warship utilized by the Krenim during the 24th century. These vessels were larger and more powerful than an starship, due to, in part, their complement of chroniton torpedoes.

title: Krenim weapon ship
intro: In several alternate timelines, the Krenim weapon ship was a warship of the Krenim Imperium capable of erasing civilizations from history. Its design and construction was spearheaded by Annorax, a military temporal scientist.

title: Kressari freighter

infobox.name: Kressari freighter
infobox.caption: The Kressari freighter ''Calondon''
infobox.caption2: The cargo bay of a Kressari freighter

intro: A Kressari freighter was a type of freighter used by the Kressari during the 24th century to haul mainly botanical DNA.

title: Krios Battlecruiser
intro: The Krios Battlecruiser was a type of battle cruiser used by the Kriosians during the mid-22nd century. Along with protecting Krios space, the Krios battlecruiser was also assigned the duty of protecting the First Monarch and the Kriosian royal family, which was known across hundreds of worlds.

title: Kriosian ship
intro: A Kriosian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Kriosians during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Kriosian transport
intro: The Kriosian transport was a type of starship used by the Kriosian Sovereign Guard during the mid-22nd century.

title: Kronos One
intro: Kronos One was a Klingon battle cruiser that was in service with the Klingon Imperial Fleet in the late 23rd century. Kronos One was the flagship of the Chancellor of the Klingon High Council.

title: Ktarian vessel

infobox.name: Ktarian vessel
infobox.caption: A Ktarian starship caught in a tractor beam

intro: Ktarian starships were small vessels used by the Ktarians during the 2360s. Their armaments were significantly inferior to the standard armaments found aboard a Federation starship. ()

title: Kukulkan's probe
intro: Kukulkan's probe was a "mysterious alien space probe" that was sent out by Kukulkan. It possessed a highly advanced propulsion system.

title: Kukulkan's ship
intro: Kukulkan's ship was a highly advanced starship controlled by the winged serpent creature Kukulkan.

title: Kumari
intro: The Kumari was an Andorian battle cruiser that was in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the mid-22nd century. It was named after the first ice-cutter to circumnavigate Andoria, and was the first starship of her class.

title: Kynk's shuttle
intro: Kynk's shuttle was a Ferengi shuttle owned by Kynk.

title: Kyrian fighter ship
intro: A Kyrian fighter ship was a type of attack fighter used by the Kyrians in the 2370s.

title: Kzinti police vessel

infobox.name: Kzinti police vessel
infobox.caption: A refitted Kzinti police vessel
infobox.caption2: Interior of a Kzinti police vessel

intro: The Kzinti police vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Kzinti. Following the Kzinti Wars, and in accordance to the Treaty of Sirius, Kzinti police vessels were the only type of military craft the Kzinti were allowed to possess.

title: L5 Test Station
intro: The L5 Test Station was an installation associated with the NX Project. Its assignment patch, along with a number of others, was on display in a case at the 602 Club. ()

title: LD sleeping quarters
intro: The LD sleeping quarters were bunk beds integrated in the corridors of the lower decks of a starship. These barracks-style group crew quarters were designated for junior officers and were located on Deck 11. Differing duty shifts each had their own sleeping quarters to live in. ()

title: LN2 exhaust conduit
intro: An LN2 exhaust conduit was a piece of technology used on vessels, used to vent exhaust from a ship.

title: LaSalle
intro: The LaSalle was a 24th century Federation starship.

title: Lab 4005
intro: Lab 4005 was a lab aboard the that contained plants.

title: Lab 4006
intro: While performing anomaly consolidation duty in 2381, Ensigns Beckett Mariner, Sam Rutherford, and D'Vana Tendi went into Lab 4006. ()

title: Lab 4007
intro: While performing anomaly consolidation duty in 2381, Ensigns Beckett Mariner, Sam Rutherford, and D'Vana Tendi went into Lab 4007. ()

title: Ladyjane
intro: The Ladyjane was a shuttlecraft owned by Mister .

title: Laika
intro: Laika was a Federation long range shuttle that was in service in the late 23rd century.
