intro: The Lamarr class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet as a "special-class science vessel" during the late 24th century. ()

title: Lancelot class

infobox.name: ''Lancelot'' class
infobox.speed: 300,000 [[kilometer per second|kilometers per second]] in level flight

intro: The Lancelot class was a type of Federation starship in service during the late 23rd and early 24th centuries. It was based on the "venerable" design. ( display placard)

title: Landing pod
intro: A landing pod or lander pod was a small utility craft in use by the Federation in the mid-23rd century. The pod comprised a spherical cockpit connected to an aft section containing four extendable stabilizing vanes, which could rotate freely around the cockpit to maintain position and attitude. Pods were equipped with both ejection and auto-navigation systems, though the navigation computers were susceptible to magnetic fields.

title: Landing strut
intro: Landing strut or landing gear was a component of some spacecraft which were capable of entering a planet's atmosphere and landing on the surface. Before the introduction of spacecraft, landing gear was used for aircraft. Normally inside the ship, the landing struts were exposed by moving panels when needed. The landing gear served to steady and support the starship upon landing. It was possible for a starship's landing gear to become stuck on a planet's surface. ()

title: Laneth's starship
intro: Laneth's starship was a type of small warship in the service of the Klingon Empire under the command of a Klingon Augment, Lieutenant Laneth. It was armed with disruptors.

title: Laser pulse system
intro: A laser pulse system was a modification that enabled a laser beam to be fired through a starship's weapons array. This modification to a starship's weapons system allowed for simulated phaser and photon torpedo operation and performance, but with no potential for actual damage. The system was used to record hits in Starfleet battle simulations without risking damage to the ships involved.

title: Launch bay
intro: A launch bay is a location from which vehicles, be they spaceborne or otherwise, are dispatched. On a starship, a launch bay is the area from which shuttlecraft and other small craft may be launched, and where they are docked when not in use. The term was in common use in the 22nd century but by the 23rd century, the term shuttlebay was more common.

title: Launch sequencer
intro: A launch sequencer is a critical component of a projectile launching system.

title: Lazarus' spaceship

infobox.name: Lazarus' spaceship
infobox.caption: Lazarus' spaceship
infobox.caption2: The power panels on Lazarus' ship

intro: Lazarus' spaceship was a domed, single-person ship operated by Lazarus and his antimatter universe counterpart, described as a timeship. ()

title: Leader circuit
intro: A leader circuit was an engineering component of the starships.

title: Ledosian patrol ship
intro: The Ledosian patrol ship was a type of starship class in use by the Ledosians in the late-24th century.

title: Ley
intro: The Ley, or Shuttle 09, was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .

title: Library
intro: A library was a location where information, usually in books or electronically, was stored and accessible to others. Librarians worked in libraries to assist those with information needs.

title: Life deck
intro: A life deck was a designated area aboard Federation starships that housed essential life services, escape pods, or other escape craft to be utilized in the event of an emergency onboard ship.

title: Life sciences department
intro: The life sciences department was a science aboard some starships, such as the and the . One section within this department was the botany section. ()

title: Life support control
intro: Life support control was the section of where the life support system was regulated.

title: Lifeboat station
intro: The lifeboat station was an emergency section aboard a starship housing a lifeboat.

title: Light cruiser
intro: A light cruiser was a type of cruiser utilized by Starfleet, capable of sustained independent operation like other cruiser types, but more lightly-armed and not necessarily intended for front-line combat.

title: Ligon orbital control station

infobox.name: Ligon orbital control station
infobox.location:
In [[orbit]] of [[Ligon II]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: The Ligon orbital control station was a space station in orbit of Ligon II which acted as a liaison between starships and the planetary government.

title: Lindberg

infobox.caption: The Lindberg listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Lindberg''

intro: The Lindberg was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 09.

title: Lissepian cargo ship
intro: A Lissepian cargo ship was a starship operated by the Lissepians.

title: Lissepian supply ship
intro: A Lissepian supply ship was a starship type operated by the Lissepians.

title: Lissepian transport
intro: A Lissepian transport was a type of transport operated by the Lissepians.

title: Loading dock
intro: A loading dock or loading bay was an area of a building where goods were loaded and unloaded. They were commonly found on commercial and industrial buildings, and warehouses in particular.

title: Lobby
intro: A lobby or foyer was a large open area, usually on the first floor of a structure, that lead to other areas such as elevators and doors.

title: Locator beam
intro: A locator beam was a device installed on Federation shuttlecraft, designed to aid starships in locating wayward shuttles. The locator beam, however, needed to be activated from within the shuttle.

title: Locker room
intro: The locker room was an area aboard starships where Starfleet away teams could dress and undress.

title: Logic sciences
intro: Logic sciences was a research department with a dedicated science laboratory aboard the , led by Brianna. Meditation was a component of their work.

title: Lokirrim patrol ship
intro: The Lokirrim patrol ship was a type of medium-sized starship used by the Lokirrim to patrol their territory. The ship was equipped with a tractor beam and a photonic disruptor, which could be used to remotely decompile holograms. It was tactically outmatched by the starship.

title: Lokirrim warship
intro: The Lokirrim warship was a class of medium-sized starship utilized by the Lokirrim in their conflict with photonic insurgents. The ship was equipped with phasers and a photonic disruptor that could remotely decompile holograms, though it was no match for a Federation starship.

title: Loknar class
intro: The Loknar class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Loknar class
intro: The Loknar class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Long range sensor scan (room)
intro: The long range sensor scan was a room on board the starships.

title: Long range shuttle
intro: A long range shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft operated by the Federation in the 23rd and 24th centuries. Some of these ships were used as couriers. ()

title: Long-range impact probe
intro: The long-range impact probe was a type of Federation probe in service in the mid-24th century. This probe was fueled by 0.2 kilogram Blitmanite or Hutzelite 27 charges. This probe would be fired into a celestial body, which would eject underground soil from the impact site. An orbiting ship would then analyzed this soil for its composition. ()

title: Loonkerian outpost
intro: The Loonkerian outpost was an outpost located on the planet Klendth. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Lorca's menagerie
intro: Lorca's menagerie was a room aboard the Federation starship in 2256 that was used primarily by Captain . This room had a collection of items, most of which were weapons, in addition to a collection of biological specimens. () Lorca called it his own “private research area", though the official name was his "menagerie." ()

title: Lotus Flower class

infobox.name: ''Lotus Flower'' class
infobox.caption: Two ajoining ships of this class

intro: The Lotus Flower class was a classification of starship used by the Federation.

title: Loval
intro: Loval was an inhabited planet in the Loval system, Alpha Quadrant. The planet and the Amleth system were located in the same sector as this world.

title: Low gravity suite
intro: A low gravity suite or low grav suite was a type of environment available to travelers as special accommodations on transport ships.

title: Low-gravity gymnasium
intro: A low-gravity gymnasium was a type of gymnasium where the gravity settings were lower than that of the rest of a starship.

title: Lucas
intro: The Lucas was a small 23rd century Federation class J cargo ship that was utilized as a cadet training ship by Starfleet in 2266.

title: Luna class
intro: The Luna-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th century.

title: Lunar One Colony
intro: Lunar One Colony was the largest Human outpost on Luna, Earth's moon, in the 22nd century.

title: Lunar Receiving
intro: In 2370, Lunar Receiving was listed on the Deep Space 9 arrival roster as the point of departure for the C-57-D. (, production art)

title: Lunar V base
intro: The Lunar V base was a small resistance camp located on Jeraddo.

title: Lutani scout ship
intro: The Lutani scout ship was a type of one-person scout ship employed by the Lutani during the mid-23rd century. It was armed with directed energy weapons.

title: Lutani warship
intro: The Lutani warship was a type of military vessel employed by the Lutani during the mid-23rd century.

title: Lya III
intro: Lya III was the inhabited third planet in its star system. This system, in Sector 30/489, was located near the Giles Belt and the Nel Bato system. This planet was home to a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. Subspace messages sent from this starbase to ships positioned near the outpost Sierra VI, which was located on the Federation side of the Federation-Romulan border, had a delay time of two hours and twenty-two minutes.

title: Lya IV
intro: Lya IV was the inhabited fourth planet in its star system. This planet, in Sector 30/489, was located near the Giles Belt and the Nel Bato system.

title: Lya Station Alpha

infobox.name: Lya Station Alpha
infobox.image: USS Enterprise-D approaches Lya Station Alpha.jpg

intro: Lya Station Alpha was a Federation space station orbiting a planet in the Alpha Quadrant, near Merak, Kressari, Tagra, and Capella. It had been in service with Starfleet since at least the mid-23rd century. ()

title: Lysian Central Command

infobox.name: Lysian Central Command
infobox.caption: Lysian Central Command compared to a Galaxy-class starship
infobox.caption2: Schematic of the Lysian Central Command

intro: The Lysian Central Command was a large space station in the Lysian system that served as the headquarters for the Lysian Alliance military.

title: Lysian destroyer
intro: Lysian destroyers were short-range attack vessels, utilized by the Lysian Alliance during the late 24th century, that had a standard crew complement of fifty-three.

title: M-Zed-5
intro: M-Zed-5, also known as Outpost MZ-5, was an outpost in the Beta Quadrant. ()

title: MMR
intro: The MMR or Main Machinery Room was next to the reactor compartment which contained the nuclear fission reactor used to large naval vessels, such as the .

title: Machine shop
intro: The machine shop was a section aboard the cargo freighter .

title: Magee class
intro: The Magee class was a type of 23rd century Federation science vessel in use during the 2250s. At least two ships of this class remained in service through the 2380s.

title: Magellan
intro: The Magellan was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft number 15.

title: Magellan probe
intro: A Magellan probe was a type of space probe used in the .

title: Magnetic bottle
intro: A magnetic bottle was technology in use aboard starships in the 23rd century. Rupture of this device could pose a threat to the ship. ()

title: Magnetic communication satellite
intro: A magnetic communication satellite was a piece of technology familiar to Lazarus.

title: Magnetic fuel line
intro: Magnetic fuel line was a technological component of starships.

title: Magnetic spindle bearing
intro: A magnetic spindle bearing was a component of the reaction control assembly on Federation starships such as the .

title: Magnetic storage bay
intro: A magnetic storage bay was a containment device for unstable materials by holding then together or keeping them apart in order to prevent a negative reaction.

title: Magneton relay
intro: A magneton relay was a component of starships in the 24th century, including Flaxian ships. It was not easily accessible while the ship was underway.

title: Main computer
intro: The main computer (or central computer) was the primary computer aboard a starbase, starship, or other installation. The main computer was typically located inside a computer core.

title: Main shuttlebay
intro: The main shuttlebay, also known as the main bay or Shuttlebay 01, was the largest of three shuttlebay facilities aboard starships, located across Decks 3 and 4 of the saucer section. The shuttlebay was enormous and accessed by one roll-up door. Decompressing the main shuttlebay would provide enough thrust to move the entire ship. () It was also sufficiently large enough to house three runabouts. ()

title: Main stage flux chamber
intro: The main stage flux chamber was a component used aboard Federation starships during the late 23rd century, located on both the port and starboard side of a vessel.

title: Mainsail
intro: A mainsail was a sail on a Bajoran lightship.

title: Maintenance bay
intro: A maintenance bay was an area of a starship, space station, or planetary base where larger vehicles such as shuttlecraft were repaired or serviced.

title: Maintenance conduit
intro: A maintenance conduit was a narrow passageway which contained infrastructure components for a space station or other facility. ()

title: Maintenance hatch
intro: A maintenance hatch was a type of door that provided access to restricted areas, such as those used to perform maintenance on a starship's systems.

title: Maintenance locker
intro: A maintenance locker was a storage unit aboard the .

title: Maintenance shaft
intro: A maintenance shaft was an area in a starship where access to the ship's internal systems and computer terminals was possible.

title: Majalan combat cruiser
intro: The Majalan combat cruiser was a type of small warship fielded by the dissident Majalan colony on Prospect VII in the 23rd century. ()

title: Majalan shuttle
intro: The Majalan shuttle was a type of small spacecraft used by the Majalans in the 23rd century. It had capacity for one pilot and at least two passengers, and was capable of atmospheric flight and landing.

title: Makar
intro: The Makar was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Tal Shiar in the late 24th century. The Makars cloaking device was modified to prevent detection by Dominion sensors at speeds under warp 6.

title: Malachowski class
intro: The Malachowski class was a type of 23rd century Federation starship that was in service during the 2250s.

title: Malcorian warp ship

infobox.name: Malcorian warp ship
infobox.caption: A model of the Malcorian warp ship

intro: The Malcorian warp ship was the prototype of the Malcorian Space Bureau's first Malcorian warp driven starship that was scheduled for launch in the late 2360s. Its first planned destination according to Malcor III's Space Administrator Mirasta Yale was to be the nearby Garth system.

title: Maldorian station
intro: The Maldorian station was a space station based in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Malon escape pod
intro: The Malon escape pod was a type of small escape pod used on some types of Malon export vessels.

title: Malon export vessel
intro: The Malon export vessel was a large freighter operated by the waste export industry of the Malon they were nothing more than a garbage scow. The waste export vessel was designed for long range haulage and dumping of theta radioactive antimatter waste and other mixed industrial byproducts produced by the Malon civilization.

title: Malon export vessel, eleventh gradient
intro: A Malon export vessel, eleventh gradient was a freighter-type vessel operated by the waste export industry of the Malon like most ships owned by the Malon it is classed as a garbage scow. They operated with a crew of nine.

title: Malon shuttle
intro: The Malon shuttle was a shuttle created by the Malon in 2375 to withstand the pressure of a gas giant, so that the Malon ship could steal a multi-spatial probe.

title: Malon transport ship
intro: The Malon transport ship was a type of ship in use by the Malon in the late-24th century.

title: Malosian cargo shuttle
intro: The Malosian cargo shuttle was a cargo shuttle, supposedly of Malosian origin, used by the crew of to trick Degra into revealing information regarding the Xindi primary weapon. () The shuttle was similar in size, if slightly smaller, to a from Enterprise. (, et al.)

title: Malurian shuttle

infobox.name: Malurian shuttle
infobox.caption: A Malurian shuttle tractoring cargo aboard

intro: A Malurian shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft utilized by the Malurians in the 2150s. These vessels were capable of atmospheric entrance and were equipped with a cargo bay and a tractor beam system.

title: Malurian vessel
intro: A Malurian vessel or Malurian ship was a type of armed starship utilized by the Malurians during the mid-22nd century. These large vessels were equipped with multiple weapon platforms which could fire ten powerful charges simultaneously. They were also able to generate defensive energy shields.

title: Manual release room
intro: The manual release room was an area aboard a starship from where saucer separation of the ship could be manually initiated.

title: Manual steering column
intro: The manual steering column, also known as a joystick or control stick, was a flight control option used aboard aircraft and some spacecraft that was capable of providing fine manual piloting control in situations where the normal helm controls were not precise enough, or in some cases, preferred by the pilot over conventional push button or touch interfaces. ()

title: Maquis fighter

infobox.name: Maquis fighter
infobox.caption: Forward port quarter
infobox.image3: Maquis fighter in combat, ventral view.jpg

intro: The Maquis fighter was a type of small and maneuverable shuttle used by the Federation and later commonly utilized by the Maquis as a fighter craft in their battle against the Cardassians.

title: Maquis freighter
intro: A Maquis freighter was a type of ship used by the Maquis.

title: Maranga IV

infobox.name: Maranga IV
infobox.scaption: The Klingon outpost on Maranga IV (2370)

intro: Maranga IV was the inhabited fourth planet in its star system. This was the location of a Klingon outpost. Maranga IV was near the border of the Federation, from which it was located on the far side of the Vodrey Nebula.

title: Marauder class
intro: The Marauder-class attack cruiser was a fictional starship class devised by Nog during an interrogation by Wainwright in 1947.

title: Marayna's space station

infobox.caption: Control area of Marayna's space station

intro: Marayna's space station was a space station hidden in an inversion nebula in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Mariner 2
intro: Mariner 2 was an American Mariner program space probe that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. A schematic of this spacecraft was stored in the 's library computer database. This database was accessed by the Talosians in 2254.

title: Mariner 2
intro: Mariner 2 was an American Mariner program space probe that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. A schematic of this spacecraft was stored in the 's library computer database. This database was accessed by the Talosians in 2254.

title: Mariner 2
intro: Mariner 2 was an American Mariner program space probe that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. A schematic of this spacecraft was stored in the 's library computer database. This database was accessed by the Talosians in 2254.

title: Mark II Nova Flyer

infobox.name: Mark II Nova Flyer
infobox.image: Trio of Mark II Nova Flyers.jpg
infobox.caption: A trio of Nova Flyers

intro: The Mark II Nova Flyer was a training vessel used by Nova Squadron during the 2380s. It was redesigned at some point by Lieutenant Tom Paris. Federation crews referred to them as "shuttles", while the Vau N'Akat referred to them as "enemy fighters". ()

title: Mark IV liferaft
intro: The Mark IV liferaft was a type of 23rd century Federation escape pod.

title: Markonian outpost
intro: The Markonian outpost was an outpost located in the Delta Quadrant. A station manager worked on this outpost.

title: Marpole
intro: The Marpole was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . ()

title: Mars

infobox.name: Mars
infobox.class:
[[Class M|M]] {{small|([[distant past]])}}
[[Class K planet|K]] {{small|(following orbital shift due to destruction of {{dis|Dol'drm|planet}})}}

intro: Mars, also known as Sol IV, was the inhabited fourth planet of the Sol system. It was the outermost planet in the inner system and was near to the which acted as a natural barrier between the inner and outer system. The planet was located within Sector 001 of the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Mars Orbital Facility
intro: The Mars Orbital Facility was a space station located in orbit of the planet Mars.

title: Mars Station
intro: Mars Station was a Federation space station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This facility, in orbit above Mars, was attached to the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards. In the 2360s, this facility, especially drafting room 5, was actively involved with the work associated with the Starship Development Project.

title: Mars class
intro: The Mars class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century into the 33rd century. It featured a diamond-shaped primary hull, with detached chevron-shaped nacelles each to the lower port and starboard.

title: Martian ship
intro: This Martian ship, also called Martian warship or Martian vessel; was a warship used by the Martians. It was equipped with technology that was similar to a tractor beam that was described as "energy tendril" known as tethers. They were useful for salvaging ships for their war efforts against the Dol'drm.

title: Martuk
intro: The Martuk was a Lissepian transport that the posed as while under the command of Major Kira and Chief O'Brien when they were hailed by an officer assigned to Post 24 near Cardassia IV. They were able to pull the ruse off by being outside the range for visual communications and by disguising the runabout's power signature. ()

title: Mat'Aaran ship
intro: The Mat'Aaran ship was a type of spacecraft used by the Mat'Aarans in the 23rd century.

title: Maternity ward
intro: A maternity ward was a section of a hospital that provided obstetrical and newborn care.

title: Matter-antimatter integrator control
intro: The matter-antimatter integrator control was a component aboard starships which allowed crewmembers to monitor and modify the power-generation activities in the warp core. Located just off the main engineering section, it also contained the emergency overload bypass, which activated almost immediately in the event of an overload.

title: Mawasi cruiser
intro: A Mawasi cruiser was a type of cruiser utilized by the Mawasi species during the late 24th century.

title: Mayflower type
intro: The Mayflower type was a starship class in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This design had two nacelles connected to the underside of the primary hull by swept pylons.

title: Maymora class
intro: The Maymora-class was a type of Vulcan starship.

title: Mazarite ship

infobox.name: Mazarite ship
infobox.caption: Vessels of the class, dropping out of warp
infobox.caption2: Vessels of the class, under fire from the Sh'Raan

intro: Mazarite ships were a type of starship utilized by the Mazarite High Council's government, which was highly corrupt, during the mid-22nd century. Because the Mazarites of the 2150s were technologically far less advanced than the Vulcans of the same era, several Mazarite ships could easily be outmatched and disabled by a single Vulcan combat cruiser.

title: Mazarite shuttle
intro: A Mazarite shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft stowed aboard Mazarite ships.

title: McAuliffe

infobox.caption: The McAuliffe on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''McAuliffe''

intro: The McAuliffe was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 21.

title: McAuliffe

infobox.caption: The McAuliffe on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''McAuliffe''

intro: The McAuliffe was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 21.

title: McKinley Station

infobox.name: McKinley Station
infobox.caption: USS Enterprise-D docked at Earth Station McKinley
infobox.caption2: View of Earth from McKinley Station

intro: The McKinley Station, also known as Earth Station McKinley, was a Federation spacedock that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century. This docking facility was located in Earth's orbit, and was designed for starship construction, refitting and maintenance layovers. (; )

title: McNair Starbase
intro: McNair Starbase was a Federation starbase in service during the 23rd century. The base was located at coordinates 3001.7850.

title: Medical department
intro: The medical department or medical division was a science aboard the incorporating doctors, nurses, and medics.

title: Medical drone
intro: The medical drone was a type of flying drone used for medical care aboard ships in the late 32nd century.

title: Medical lab
intro: The medical lab was a section aboard starships where medical research and experiments were performed.

title: Medical record library
intro: The medical record library was a section on the where medical records were stored.

title: Medical ship
intro: A medical ship was a starship whose primary function was to be used for medical purposes. Because of this, they were typically not well armed with weapons or other defensive systems. This could include vessels described as hospital ships, medical transports, or medical frigates.

title: Medical shuttle
intro: A medical shuttle was a shuttlecraft, equipped with specialized technology and equipment designed to deal with possible medical emergencies, carried aboard Federation starships in the early 23rd century.

title: Medical shuttle 37
intro: Medical shuttle 37 was a Kelvin-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet, assigned to the in 2233.

title: Medical ward
intro: The medical ward was the medical facility aboard a Klingon Bird-of-Prey, similar to the Federation's sickbay.

title: Medusan vessel
intro: The Medusan vessel was a type of starship in operation during the 23rd and 24th centuries. Sharing some commonalities with Federation starship design, the vessel functioned under the authority of the Medusans. It was capable of landing on a planetary surface. ()

title: Memory Alpha

infobox.name: Memory Alpha
infobox.ocaption: The Enterprise arrives at Memory Alpha

intro: Memory Alpha (also called The Memory Planet) was an inhabited planetoid and the home for a Federation central library. It was located in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Menos' ship
intro: Menos' ship was a small transport operated by the rogue Vulcan, Menos in the 22nd century.

title: Mercantile drone
intro: The Mercantile drone was a type of small flying device used by the personnel of the Mercantile, a marketplace in Requiem, Hima, for various tasks in the 32nd century. A drone had three detached appendages surrounding a central body, which contained a camera. Drones were programmed with the ability of passing through force fields.

title: Merced class
intro: The Merced-class starship was a type of vessel in service with Starfleet during the 24th century. ()

title: Merchantman

infobox.caption: The Merchantman
infobox.name: ''Merchantman''
infobox.caption2: The Merchantman is destroyed by Kruge's Bird-of-Prey

intro: The Merchantman was a small civilian freighter in service during the late 23rd century.

title: Merchantman type

infobox.name: ''Merchantman'' type
infobox.speed: [[Warp power]]; some variants are powered only by [[impulse power]]

intro: The Merchantman-type of spacecraft was a highly modifiable, upgradeable, and versatile vessel used in the Alpha Quadrant, Beta Quadrant, and Delta Quadrant by governments, military, and civilians. All ships of this type had the same basic configuration; however, there were variations in the size of the ships, with some being considerably larger than others. These ships were either warp powered or impulse powered and were equipped with lasers or phasers. The crew complement aboard these ships could be as low as two and as high as 78.

title: Mercury capsule
intro: The Mercury capsule was a type of American space capsule operated by NASA for its Project Mercury from 1961 to 1963. This was the first manned spacecraft of the agency. Each ship was given a name ending with a 7 by their pilots. The capsule was launched into space by the Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle.

title: Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle
intro: The Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle was an American expendable rocket that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century.

title: Merian class
intro: The Merian class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design featured a flat primary hull with four disconnected nacelles.

title: Mess hall
intro: A mess hall or mess room was a location on Federation and Klingon starships or starbases where crewmembers could relax and enjoy a meal or a quick snack in a social setting. It was an old Earth nautical terms for the mass dining room for ships' crew.

title: Microgravity lab
intro: The microgravity lab was a section aboard a Vissian starship.

title: Microprobe
intro: A microprobe was a type of small probe carried aboard Federation starships that was used in cases where conventional probes were too large to be effective.

title: Mid-range phase adjuster
intro: A mid-range phase adjuster was a piece of technology invented by Geordi La Forge for the and installed in power transfer conduits aboard the ship.

title: Midos V Satellite City Spaceport

infobox.name: Midos V Satellite City Spaceport
infobox.location:
In [[orbit]] of [[Midos V]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Midos V Satellite City Spaceport was an orbital spaceport at the planet Midos V.

title: Milan (starship)
intro: The Milan was a 24th century Federation transport ship.

title: Military shuttle
intro: The military shuttle was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in the 2250s. Federation cargo shuttles used the same basic frame. (; )

title: Military vessel
intro: A military vessel or military ship was any type of starship dedicated for military use.

title: Minara II

infobox.name: Minara II
infobox.location:
[[Minarian star system|Minarian]] [[star system|system]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Minara II was the uninhabited second planet of the Minarian system. This planet was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant and was destroyed when its primary went supernova in 2268.

title: Mining shuttle
intro: A mining shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft used in mining.

title: Mining vessel
intro: In starship classification, a mining vessel or mining ship was a starship designed to conduct mining operations in space. Such vessels were equipped with technology and personnel to recover and process desired materials.

title: Mir
intro: The space station Mir (Russian for peace), a product of the Russian Space Agency, was a research facility in orbit around Earth in the late 20th century.

title: Miranda class
intro: The Miranda-class starship was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 23rd and the 24th century.

title: Miranda type escape pod
intro: The Miranda type escape pod was a type of emergency escape vehicle used on starships.

title: Mirror universe starships
intro: de:Liste von Schiffen im Spiegeluniversum

title: Mislenite freighter
intro: The Mislenite freighter was a type of cargo ship used by the Mislenites in the late-24th century.

title: Mission operations station
intro: Mission operations, also known as mission ops, was one of the bridge stations aboard Starfleet starships.

title: Mithran class
intro: The Mithran-class was a fighter under development in 2374, said to be more advanced than any other warship in the quadrant.

title: Model HB-88
intro: The Model HB-88 was a 29th century Federation timeship.

title: Molecular biology
intro: Molecular biology was an area of a starship dedicated to the study of biology at a molecular level. The field overlapped with other areas of biology and chemistry, particularly genetics and biochemistry.

title: Monaveen
intro: The Monaveen was a Hysperian cruiser used by Queen Paolana.

title: Monaveen type
intro: The Monaveen-type was a class of cruiser utilized by the Hysperians during the late 24th century.

title: Mondor
intro: The Mondor was a sub-light Pakled ship that was in service during the mid-24th century, under the command of Grebnedlog; the ship's chief engineer was his friend Reginod.

title: Mondor type
intro: The Mondor type was a class of spacecraft utilized by the Pakleds during the mid- to late 24th century. By 2380, some had been augmented with random components stolen or salvaged from non-Pakled vessels, turning them into Pakled Clumpships.

title: Monean research vessel
intro: A Monean research vessel was a type of spacecraft used by the Moneans during the 24th century. It was armed and capable of travel through both space and water, to depths up to a hundred kilometers. They posed no threat to an starship and could be easily destroyed.

title: Monitor post
intro: A monitor post was an unmanned outpost for observations by the Federation.

title: Monk (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Monk was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .

title: Moon shuttle
intro: A moon shuttle was an unsophisticated type of shuttlecraft that was used from the 22nd to the 24th century.

title: Moore (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Moore was a Federation Moore-type shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: Moore type shuttlecraft
intro: The Moore-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in 2258.

title: Morgue
intro: A morgue was a facility or specific area used to store the bodily remains of the recently deceased for purposes of identification of the body, autopsy, and other postmortem activities.

title: Morska
intro: Morska was an inhabited planet in the Morska system, Beta Quadrant. In the 32nd century, this system was in the Klingon Zone.

title: Mother ship
intro: A mother ship was a large spacecraft on which a smaller ship was carried, maintained, and launched.

title: Mudd

infobox.name: Mudd
infobox.ocaption: The Enterprise in orbit of Mudd

intro: The planet "Mudd", so named by Harcourt Fenton Mudd, also known as the robot planet, according to James T. Kirk, was an uninhabited K type planet located in uncharted space in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. This planet had a ring system and was populated by a species of androids. (; )

title: Multi-spatial probe
intro: A multi-spatial probe was an advanced probe carried by . Apart from incorporating multi-spatial technology, it was equipped with unimatrix shielding designed by Lieutenant Commander Tuvok. Other features were a telemetry link, and the ability to emit a polaron burst.

title: Multispectral emitter
intro: A multispectral emitter was a Romulan technology used on some ships to create wave outputs at or about the frequency of light.

title: Mulzirak transport
intro: A Mulzirak transport was a type of transport ship used during the 24th century.

title: Museum ship
intro: A museum ship was a ship that was preserved and turned into a museum.

title: Music academy
intro: A music academy or music school was an educational institution where music skills were nurtured, such as the training of composers and other musicians. The Aldebaran Music Academy was one notable music school. ()

title: Mutara Interdimensional Deep Space Array System
intro: The Mutara Interdimensional Deep Space Array System, or MIDAS array for short, was a Federation communications array that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century. Starfleet worked with Vulcans in deploying this array. The array was also referred to as the Mutara Interdimensional Deep-Space-Transponder Array System by Lieutenant Reginald Barclay of the Pathfinder Project.

title: Mycelial transport vessel
intro: A mycelial transport vessel was a type of unmanned agri-transport vessel and part of the mycelial ejection protocol.

title: NA
intro: Prior to 2143, this prefix was used by Tycho Base (NA-01), which was a fixed installation in the Sol system. ()

title: NAR
intro: NAR was a type and registry prefix used by the United Nations, the United Federation of Planets, and Pentarus V. (; )

title: NAR-30974
intro: NAR-30974 was a Federation dry dock that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century. This facility was located in orbit above Earth.

title: NAR18834
intro: The NAR18834 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. They were in use in diplomatic missions as early as 2120. (, okudagram)

title: NBT
intro: NBT was a registry number prefix for civilian Federation starships.

title: NC
intro: In 2153, this registry prefix was for United Earth Starfleet auxiliary craft. An example was NC-05. ()

title: NC-05
intro: NC-05 was a United Earth that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century, attached to Starfleet Command. It had blue and silver streamlines.

title: NCC
intro: NCC was a registry number prefix used on starships in service with the Federation Starfleet. () Vessels using this prefix were listed in the Starfleet Registry. ()

title: NCC-1279 type
intro: The NCC-1279 type was a Federation starship in service during the mid-23rd century. ( season 3 and season 4 opening credits; )

title: NCC-1701/12
intro: NCC-1701⁄12 was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701/12 (2262)
intro: NCC-1701⁄12 was a Federation Stamets-type shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701/3
intro: NCC-1701⁄3 was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701/3 type shuttlecraft
intro: The NCC-1701/3 type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type used by Starfleet in 2269.

title: NCC-1701/4
intro: NCC-1701⁄4 was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701/4
intro: NCC-1701⁄4 was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701/9
intro: NCC-1701⁄9 was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: NCC-1701\5A
intro: NCC-1701\5A was the registry of a Starfleet aqua-shuttle that was attached to the Federation starship during the mid-23rd century.

title: NCC-31720
intro: The NCC-31720 was a 24th century Federation starship operated by Starfleet.

title: NCC-K7
intro: NCC-K7 was the registry of a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to Deep Space Station K-7.

title: NCIA
intro: NCIA was a registry number prefix for Federation starships operated by Section 31 in the 23rd century.

title: NCIA-93 type
intro: The NCIA-93 type was a class of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.

title: NCV
intro: NCV was a three-letter prefix for Federation timeship registry numbers in the 29th century, similar to the NCC prefix commonly found on Federation ships in previous centuries.

title: NES
intro: NES was a registry number prefix for civilian Federation starships.

title: NES-1701
intro: NES-1701 was the registry number of a 23rd century Federation starship.

title: NFT
intro: NFT was a registry prefix for El-Aurian registered transports.

title: NGC
intro: NGC (standing for New General Catalogue) was a prefix used when assigning numerical designations to stars, stellar clusters, and nebulae. (; )

title: NI
intro: NI was a registry number prefix for Federation starships operated by Section 31 in the 23rd century.

title: NSP
intro: NSP was a registry prefix for Vulcan merchant ships.

title: NSS
intro: NSS was a three-letter abbreviation that was used as a prefix for Ni'Var starships in the late 32nd century.

title: NSS T'Pau
intro: The NSS T'Pau was a starship operated by the Ni'Var Government during the late 32nd century.

title: NX
intro: NX was a two-letter prefix first used by the United Earth Starfleet for their starships in the mid-22nd century. () After the founding of the in 2161, this prefix was used for experimental and prototype starship designs. () In the mirror universe, this prefix was used by the Terran Empire for their NX-class starships. () Two centuries later, this prefix was used by the Terran Resistance Forces for their starship. () Ships that used the NCC and the NX prefix were listed in the Starfleet Registry. ()

intro: The NX-class was a type of United Earth starship in Starfleet service during the mid-22nd century. The class is notable for having been the first to be constructed with the warp five engine, allowing Humanity to explore beyond neighboring star systems. The lead ship of the class, , was launched in 2151, weeks ahead of schedule, while the second, , was launched in 2154, after lengthy delays in drydock. ()

title: NX class decks
intro: A master systems display style cross-section of the NX-class appeared in the Propworx auction catalog.

title: NX type escape pod

infobox.name: NX type escape pod
infobox.image: NX type escape pods fleeing the ISS Enterprise.jpg
infobox.caption: Escape pods fleeing the ISS ''Enterprise''

intro: The NX type escape pod was a type of emergency escape craft installed aboard NX class starships in the 22nd century.

title: NX-Alpha
intro: NX-Alpha was one of three test vehicles used in Starfleet's NX Project, along with the NX-Beta and the NX-Delta, and the first Human vessel to travel at warp 2 under pilot A.G. Robinson.

title: NX-Beta

infobox.caption: NX-Beta in its launch bay
infobox.name: NX-Beta
infobox.caption2: The NX-Beta on an unauthorized flight in 2143

intro: The NX-Beta was one of three test vehicles, along with the NX-Alpha and NX-Delta, used by Starfleet's NX Project to test and refine the warp 5 engine designed by Henry Archer.

title: NX-Delta
intro: The NX-Delta was a prototype vessel used in the NX Project in an effort to test and refine Henry Archer's warp 5 engine design.

title: Nacelle housing
intro: A nacelle housing was an external support component of a warp nacelle.

title: Nacelle pylon
intro: A nacelle pylon, also known as a warp pylon or a nacelle strut, was a large support structure that connected a warp nacelle to the hull of a starship. A nacelle pylon housed the systems that directly linked a warp nacelle to a starship's warp core.

title: Nacelle tube
intro: The nacelle tube was a space found within a Federation starship warp nacelle used in the maintenance and monitoring of the system's operation.

title: Nanut
intro: The Nanut was a Tygarian freighter that was in service in the late 24th century. Its executive officer in the 2370s was Romah Doek.

title: Narada

infobox.caption: The Narada drilling into Vulcan (2258)
infobox.name: ''Narada''
infobox.caption2: The Narada appears out of a black hole (2233)

intro: The Narada was a Romulan mining vessel that was in service in the late 24th century.

title: Narendra III

infobox.name: Narendra III
infobox.ocaption: Earth starship NX-01 Enterprise in orbit of Narendra III in 2152
infobox.location:
[[Narendra]] [[star system|system]]
[[Unnamed Alpha and Beta Quadrant sectors#Sector containing Narendra III|Unnamed sector]]
[[Beta Quadrant]]
infobox.scaption: A Klingon colony on Narendra III

intro: Narendra III was the inhabited third planet in the Narendra system. This planet was located in a sector of the Beta Quadrant. (; )

title: Narj's Miraculous Menagerarium
intro: Narj's Miraculous Menagerarium was a menagerie owned by Narj in the late 24th century. Located in a space station above a planet, it was once voted one of the top thousand menageries in the quadrant. The menagerie housed an extensive collection of dangerous lifeforms, of which the Pyrithian swamp gobblers were the most lucrative attractions. Despite the dangers its exhibits posed if they were to escape, the station operated under a strict no weapons policy.

title: Nausicaan cargo station
intro: The Nausicaan cargo station was a facility built into one side of a small asteroid. It had multiple docking arms for vessels to use.

title: Nausicaan ship

infobox.name: Nausicaan ship
infobox.caption: Dorsal view
infobox.caption2: Vessel of the class, firing forward plasma cannons

intro: Nausicaan ships were fighters employed by Nausicaan pirates during the mid-22nd century for raiding freighter trade routes.

title: Navigation console
intro: The navigation console was a console located on the bridge of a starship. The console contained the flight control interface, which was designed to monitor and project a vessel's course and velocity. The console also included sensors to determine the position, speed, and trajectory of other objects and ships.

title: Navigational control
intro: Navigational control was a section aboard the Federation starship .

title: Navigational control post
intro: Navigational control posts were stations within a particular area of space which guided and managed vessels through that area.

title: Navigational control satellite
intro: A navigational control satellite, or NavCon satellite, was a type of artificial satellite used by the Federation. These satellites kept logs in the form of NavCon files.

title: Navigational deflector
intro: The navigational deflector, also known just as the deflector, the deflector array, the deflector dish, the main deflector, the nav deflector, the parabolic dish, the main sensor, was a component of many starships that was used to deflect space debris, asteroids, microscopic particles, and other objects that might have collided with the ship. At warp speed, the deflector was virtually indispensable for most starships as even the most minute particle could cause serious damage to a ship when it was traveling at superluminal velocities. ()

title: Nebula class

infobox.name: ''Nebula'' class
infobox.caption: Forward ventral view
infobox.image3: USS Prometheus at warp, Second Sight.jpg

intro: The Nebula class was a type of Federation starship that was in service in Starfleet during the second half of the 24th century.

title: Negh'Var class
intro: The Negh'Var-class was the largest class of cruiser known to operate in the Klingon Empire during the late 24th century.

title: Nenebek
intro: The Nenebek (NAR-21166) was a Nenebek-type sublight mining shuttle that was in service in the independent Pentarus system in the mid-24th century. Constructed sometime in the mid-23rd century, this shuttle was used for ferrying people. Nenebek was the property of Captain Dirgo, who had logged almost 10,000 hours in this shuttle, and had modified the maneuvering thrusters into an unusual configuration.

title: Neptune class
intro: The Neptune-class starship was a class of United Earth survey ships that were in service with Starfleet around 2141.

title: Nerada
intro: The Nerada was a Nasari starship that was in service in the late 24th century. This vessel was commanded by Alben.

title: Nerada type
intro: The Nerada-type was a class of starship used by the Nasari during the late-24th century. They carried weapons which gave off a distinct tetryon signature when charging.

title: New Orleans class

infobox.name: ''New Orleans'' class
infobox.caption: Wreckage of the New Orleans-class USS Kyushu

intro: The New Orleans-class frigate was a Federation starship class that was in service during the mid-24th century. ()

title: New Paris Colony Starbase
intro: The New Paris Colony Starbase was a Federation starbase associated with New Paris.

title: Newton type
intro: The Newton type was a type of starship used by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

title: Ni'Var (starship)

intro: The Night Alien ship was a type of starship operated by the Night Aliens of the Delta Quadrant. Thousands of these ships resided in the region of space dubbed "" by the crew.

title: Nightingale (medical transport)
intro: The Nightingale was the name given by Ensign Harry Kim to the Kraylor starship Medical Transport 136, previously under the command of Captain Brell. The Nightingale differed from other Kraylor medical transports in that it was used on a secret mission by a research team to transport a cloaking device developed for their fleet.

title: Nightingale (transport)
intro: The Nightingale was a Federation transport.

title: Nihydron warship
intro: A Nihydron warship was a type of warship utilized by the Nihydron species during the late 24th century.

title: Nimbus 1
intro: Nimbus 1 was an American Nimbus Program weather satellite that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. This satellite was equipped with high-resolution cameras which were used to photograph the surface of the Earth. An image of the Nimbus 1 satellite in Earth's polar orbit was stored in the library computer of the . This image was later retrieved by the Talosians during their survey of the library computer's contents in 2254.

title: Nimitz class
intro: The Nimitz class was a type of 23rd century Federation capital ship in use during the 2250s and 2260s. (, )

title: Nimitz type escape pod
intro: The Nimitz-type escape pod was a type of emergency evacuation craft carried aboard , , and Federation starships in the mid-23rd century. (; )

title: Nimrod class
intro: The Nimrod class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.

title: Nokaro
intro: The Nokaro was a colony ship carrying nearly three thousand people, mostly families.

title: Nomad
intro: The Nomad MK-15c (NSSDC ID: 2002-045b) space probe was a Nomad Program spacecraft that was in service in the early 21st century. Dr. Jackson Roykirk designed the probe with two goals in mind: to create a probe that could function as a perfect thinking machine capable of independent logic and that could seek out new lifeforms in interstellar space.

title: Norkan outposts
intro: The Norkan outposts were a grouping of outposts in the Norkan system, Beta Quadrant. These outposts were approximately 101 light years from Sol.

title: Norkova
intro: The Norkova was a 24th century Federation freighter.

title: Norway class
intro: The Norway class was a type of Federation starship in service with Starfleet during the 2370s.

title: Nova One
intro: The Nova One was a small independent starship designed and operated by Nick Locarno during the early 2380s.

intro: The Nova class was a type of Federation starship designed for short-term planetary research missions. It was placed in service starting in the late 24th century.

title: Nova class decks
intro: The following deck listing is for the starship. The class had eight decks. ()

title: Nuclear electronics lab
intro: The nuclear electronics lab was a section aboard the .

title: Null-G ward
intro: The Null-G ward was a section of the sickbay.

title: Numiri patrol vessel
intro: The Numiri patrol ship was a small, standard vessel of the Numiri fleet. They were armed with directed-energy weapons comparable to an starship. They were also equipped with regenerative shields and tractor beams.

title: Nursery
intro: The nursery was one section aboard Federation starships, such as the . In the decades of the past, such as the 19th century, the word was used as the term for a room or suite of rooms at the top of the house made to quarter a family's children (the nurse, or nanny as she would later be known, would be quartered in an adjacent room to be within earshot of the sleeping children during the night); by the 21st century, it became known as the term for an infant's room.

title: Nuu'Bari mining vessel
intro: The Nuu'Bari mining vessel was a warp-capable 24th century starship operated by the Nuu'Bari.

title: Nyberrite Alliance cruiser
intro: A Nyberrite Alliance cruiser was a type of starship used by the Nyberrite Alliance.

title: Nygean prison ship
intro: A Nygean prison ship was a starship operated by the Nygean Detention Force to transport prisoners from one planet to another, sometimes for execution. Nygean prison ships were capable of warp 8.2 and equipped with escape pods.

title: Nygean starship
intro: A Nygean starship was a class of vessel utilized by the Nygeans during the late 24th century.

title: Nyran
intro: The Nyran was a Vulcan starship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. It was under the command of Captain Tavek.

title: Nyrian biosphere vessel
intro: The Nyrian biosphere vessel, also described as a habitat vessel, was a vast starship utilized by the Nyrians of the Delta Quadrant. It contained at least four decks, and corridors containing control terminals, and at least one more extensive control center (or what appeared like it).

title: O2 cylinder
intro: A O2 cylinder was a component of 22nd century shuttlepods.

title: OV
intro: OV was a two-letter prefix for space shuttle orbiters.

title: OV-165
intro: OV-165 was an American space shuttle orbiter operated by NASA in the 2010s and 2020s. This ship belonged to the second generation of space shuttle orbiters, which was intended to be the successor to the -type shuttles. It was designed as a single stage-to-orbit (SSTO) vehicle. The ship was used for launching commercial and scientific satellites, as well as bringing components to interplanetary vehicles such as the Shango X-1. ( opening credits; )

title: Obena class
intro: The Obena class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th century to the early 25th century.

title: Oberth class
intro: The Oberth class was a small Federation starship used primarily by Starfleet and civilian scientists alike, as a scout class and science vessel, from the late-23rd to the late-24th century.

title: Observation deck
intro: The observation deck was an area of some starships. On ships, the observation deck overlooked the flight deck.

title: Observation lounge
intro: The observation lounge or conference lounge was a special designation referring to the briefing room on Excelsior-, Galaxy-, , , and starships as well as on the Reman warbird Scimitar. It included an expansive view of space on one side of the room. (; ; )

title: Odin
intro: The Odin was a 24th century Federation freighter.

title: Odyssey class
intro: The Odyssey class was a class of Federation starship that had entered service by the late 24th century. ()

title: Officers' lounge
intro: The officers' lounge was a recreational area aboard Federation starships and installations. It was also used for official functions such as receptions and dinners. ()

title: Officers' mess
intro: The officers' mess was a mess hall for officers located on a starship.

title: Officers' quarters
intro: Officers' quarters was the designation given to the staterooms on starships that were reserved for the officers. A typical quarter was segregated into a sleeping and working area. Directional signs gave information as to where the officers' quarters were located, along with the room numbers. In post-refit Constitution-class starships, sonic showers were added to the rooms. These quarters were located on Deck 5. (; )

title: Oh's warbird
intro: Oh's warbird was a large warbird that served as General Oh's flagship as she led a fleet of 217 warbirds to Coppelius in 2399. ()

title: Ohniaka III

intro: Ohniaka III was the third planet in the Ohniaka system. It was the home of a Federation research station and was located in the same sector as the MS system and New Berlin Colony.

title: Ohniaka III Research Station
intro: The Ohniaka III Research Station or Ohniaka III Outpost was a Federation science station without strategic importance on the planet Ohniaka III. The outpost was staffed by 274 Starfleet personnel.

title: Olympic class
intro: The Olympic class was a class of starship in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century.

intro: The Omicron Theta Colony, also known as the Omicron Theta Outpost, was a Federation colony located on the planet Omicron Theta in the remote Omicron Theta star system. It was established before 2328 as a completely self-sufficient colony with a primacy focus on the sciences, although there were also farms. Of the 411 colonists who lived at the colony before its destruction, Dr. Noonien Soong remains the best known.

title: Onizuka
intro: The Onizuka was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . During its service it was labeled as both shuttlepod 05 and 07.

title: Onquanii's ship
intro: Onquanii's ship was a type of starship utilized by Onquanii in the late 24th century.

title: Operations station
intro: The operations station, also known as ops station, ops position, or simply "ops", was a console station on Starfleet bridges of the 24th century that was manned by the operations officer. (; ) The ops station included internal systems control, communications, and sensor system usage as part of its purview. ()

title: Optical nanoprocessor
intro: The optical nanoprocessor was a part of the hardware of the .

title: Orbital 1
intro: Orbital 1 was a space capsule launched by the Central Protectorate on Gotana. It was launched on top of a three-stage rocket, and carried two astronauts, the pilot, Gotana-Retz, and the commander, Terrina.

title: Orbital 6
intro: Orbital 6 was an United Earth inspection pod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. It was attached to Shipyard Ops of the Orbital Drydock Facility.

title: Orbital Drydock Facility
intro: The Orbital Drydock Facility was a Starfleet spacedock where the first warp five starship, , was constructed in the mid-22nd century.

intro: The Federation orbital shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft utilized in and around Earth and the Spacedock One.

title: Orbiting Geophysical Observatory
intro: The Orbiting Geophysical Observatory, or OGO, was a 20th century series of artificial satellites used by NASA for studying the Earth's magnetosphere.

title: Orbiting Solar Observatory
intro: The Orbiting Solar Observatory, or OSO, was a 20th century series of artificial satellites used by NASA for studying the physical properties of the Sun.

title: Orion Pirate Outpost
intro: The Orion Pirate Outpost was an Orion Syndicate base used for piracy and other criminal activities such as art forgery. It was populated solely by Orions, with aliens killed on sight.

title: Orion Sector Tactical Command
intro: Orion Sector Tactical Command was a Federation outpost in the Beta Quadrant that was associated with Starfleet's Tactical Command. Located in Sector 001, this command was tasked with the responsibility of conducting tactical operational missions in the Orion sector.

title: Orion barge
intro: An Orion barge was an Orion starship that was in service from the 2150s to the 2380s.

title: Orion destroyer
intro: The Orion destroyer was a class of warship used by the Orion Syndicate. Also described as a battleship, these vessels were massive in size and mounted considerable firepower, though they were considered antiquated by the late 24th century.

title: Orion embassy outpost
intro: The Orion embassy outpost was an embassy outpost on Qo'noS, operated by the Orions on land given to them by the Klingons sometime prior to 2257. It was built over the ruins of a shrine to the tyrant Molor, which was situated atop one of the vents leading to the planet's underground volcano system.

title: Pakled Clumpship
intro: A Pakled Clumpship was an enhanced starship utilized by Pakled rebels during the 2380s, with the assistance of the rogue Klingon officer Captain Dorg. () These vessels began as craft, but were heavily fortified with new stolen or salvaged components. (, et al.)

title: Pakled battle harpy
intro: The Pakled battle harpy was a type of attack fighter operated by the Pakleds in the late 24th century. They were warp-capable, and armed with twin directed energy weapons.

title: Pakled shuttle
intro: The Pakled shuttle was a small auxiliary craft used by Pakleds in the late 24th century. It was capable of landing on a planetary surface, and was accessible through a large rear hatch.

title: Pakled trade ship
intro: A Pakled trade ship was a type of freighter utilized by the Pakleds during the mid-24th century.

title: Pakled transport
intro: A Pakled transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Pakleds during the mid-24th century.

title: Palace
intro: A palace was a name for an ornate and lavish residence, typically one home to some kind of dignitary.

title: Pantry
intro: A pantry was a place used to store food and other items before being taken to a kitchen and prepared for a meal.

title: Par Lenor's shuttle
intro: Par Lenor's shuttle was a Ferengi shuttle.

title: Par'tok type
intro: The Par'tok type was a cargo vessel design utilized by the Klingon Empire from the 24th to the 32nd centuries. Unlike most Klingon starships, these freighters did not possess cloaking devices.

intro: The Parliament class was a class of Federation starship that was in service during the late 24th century.

title: Particle emitter
intro: A particle emitter was a component of Starfleet vessels, located in the middle of the navigational deflector. It was used notably on starships.

title: Particle matrix
intro: The particle matrix was a component on Starfleet vessels whose function fed into the shields.

title: Pathfinder class
intro: The Pathfinder class was a type of Federation starship that had entered service by the early 25th century. ()

title: Patrol ship
intro: A patrol ship or patrol vessel was a small to mid-sized starship that was usually well armed, and typically found patrolling or policeing territorial boundaries.

title: Pax class
intro: The Pax class was a class of Federation starship that could also be configured as a space station operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century and into the 33rd century. It featured a central trunk, that could also blossom outward in a series of spiral arms.

title: Pelian escort vessel
intro: A Pelian escort vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Pelians during the 2360s.

title: Penk's starship
intro: Penk's starship was a starship operated by an individual named Penk in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century. The starship was used as a main base of Tsunkatse matches, which took place on the ship but were transmitted live to millions of viewers over the sector. This vessel weighed about five million metric tons, and had reinforced hull plating protected by tetryon-based covariant shielding to prevent sensor penetration, with multiphasic force fields preventing the use of transporters. The ship was heavily armed with neutronic weaponry and a tetryon-based dampening field used to disable the engines, weapons, transporters and shields of ships in close proximity.

title: Peregrine class
intro: The Peregrine class was a type of courier ship appropriated by the Maquis as interceptors during the early 2370s. In some cases, the Maquis modified these vessels to include improved engine capability and light armaments. These vessels were commonly used during their insurrection against the Cardassian Union. ()

title: Personnel shuttle
intro: Personnel shuttles were specialized shuttle used by Starfleet to transport large numbers of personnel from one location to another.

title: Phase compensator
intro: A phase compensator can refer to an engineering tool or a component on Federation starships such as the . They were also used by the Klingon Empire.

title: Phase regulator
intro: A phase regulator was a component of vessels, specifically located in plasma injectors.

title: Phaser control room
intro: The phaser control room was a section aboard starships responsible for the coordination and maintenance of the ship's phaser weapons. While the actual firing was usually triggered by the helmsman/navigator or from the tactical stations on the main bridge, battle bridge or auxiliary control center, the phaser control rooms were capable of firing phasers independently without bridge control. These rooms were manned by phaser gun crews who were a part of the command division and trained in space combat. They controlled the phasers from a phaser station. (; )

title: Phaser range
intro: The phaser range was a facility aboard some starships that allowed Starfleet personnel to practice aiming and firing their phasers. It consisted of a circular stage set in a large empty area. The area around the stage was illuminated, but every other area of the room was dark. Flashing spheres of light of different colors and moving at various speeds served as the targets. Two people could be accommodated in the range at any one time. () By 2381, the phaser range on at least one ship featured drones as the targets, rather than light-based spheres. ()

title: Phaser station
intro: The phaser station was a control panel for the phasers in the phaser control room. A phaser gun crew would use this console for checking the status of and, with direction from the bridge, for firing the phasers. The readiness of the phaser stations was monitored from the bridge; a green light indicated readiness.

title: Phoenix
intro: The Phoenix warp ship was the first man-made, manned spacecraft to achieve light speed using warp drive. Constructed during the mid-21st century and launched in 2063, the Phoenix was remembered as the ship that instigated Earth's First Contact with Vulcans.

title: Phoenix (replica)
intro: The Phoenix was any of five functioning replicas of the Phoenix, Doctor Zefram Cochrane's prototype warp ship, attached to the Ride the Phoenix attraction at the Historical Bozeman theme park in the late 24th century. They were each individually housed in missile silos nestled against the cliffside at the edge of the park.

title: Photographic section
intro: The photographic section was a section aboard the .

title: Photon burst
intro: A photon burst was a type of starship-mounted form of technology used by Starfleet.

title: Photon torpedo
intro: Photon torpedoes were warp-capable tactical matter/antimatter weapons commonly deployed aboard starships and starbases by various organizations. Photon torpedoes, often abbreviated as "photons", were called Pu'DaH dak cha in Klingonese. (, etc.; )

intro: Phylosian ships were a type of interstellar space ship utilized by the Phylosians.

title: Pi (starship)
intro: The Pi was a Romulan scout ship that was in service with the Romulan military in the mid-24th century.

title: Picasso
intro: The Picasso (SB11-1201⁄1) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to Starbase 11 in the 2260s.

title: Pikaru

[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Pikaru, also referred to as Pikaru Settlement, was a Federation outpost operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century. It was located on the surface of a planet that experienced level-3 sandstorms.

title: Pike (shuttlepod)
intro: The Pike was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod number 12.

title: Piller

infobox.image: Berman and Piller in Enterprise-D main shuttlebay.jpg
infobox.name: ''Piller''

intro: The Piller was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .

title: Pilot vessel
intro: A pilot vessel was a type of spacecraft used for guiding a larger ship to a location, such as a planet.

title: Pinnacles
intro: The Pinnacles was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. It was attached to the

title: Pioneer 10
intro: Pioneer 10 was an American Pioneer Program deep space probe that was in service with NASA in the late 20th century.

title: Pioneer 11
intro: Pioneer 11 was an American Pioneer Program deep space probe that was in service with NASA in the late 20th century. The probe surveyed the planets Jupiter and Saturn.

title: Pioneer 5
intro: Pioneer 5 was an American Pioneer Program space probe that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. A record of Pioneer 5 was available in the Enterprise library computer. This data was flashed on a viewscreen when the Talosians scanned the computer in 2254. ()

title: Pioneer class
intro: The Pioneer class was a class of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet sometime in the 23rd century.

title: Plague ship
intro: Plague ship was a term for a craft whose occupants were beset with illness.

title: Planet Q orbit station
intro: Planet Q orbit station was an orbiting space station at Planet Q.

title: Planetary science
intro: Planetary science, also referred to as geoscience, was the study of non-stellar celestial bodies, such as planets, planetoids, asteroids and moons.

title: Plant biology lab
intro: The plant biology lab was a laboratory on where botany was studied.

title: Plasma circuit
intro: A plasma circuit was a closed electrical network of a computer system that ran on electro-plasma.

title: Plasma junction
intro: A plasma junction or EPS junction was a component of the electro-plasma system on 22nd century . It was a major flaw in the ship's design, as it was exposed along the nape of the ship's neck and primary hull, vulnerable to enemy fire.

title: Plasma reactor
intro: A plasma reactor was a type of power generator that could be fueled by deuterium.

title: Plasma recoiler
intro: A plasma recoiler was a piece of technology used by the Cardassians in the 24th century.

title: Plasma regulator
intro: A plasma regulator or an EPS regulator was a component used to regulate plasma in the electro-plasma system of a starship or starbase.

title: Plasma relay room
intro: On a Federation starship, the plasma relay room was an area where electro-plasma from the MARA of the warp core could be routed to different areas and systems of the vessel to increase or decrease power to these areas and systems as necessary. In short, it was an area used to control power transfers.

title: Plasma wave probe
intro: A plasma wave probe was a type of probe used by Starfleet to study plasma waves.

title: Play area
intro: A play area was a room or part of a room where children could .

title: Plestorene
intro: Plestorene was a type of technology used in the backup systems of J'naii shuttlecraft during the late-24th century.

title: Pod jettison system
intro: The antimatter pod jettison system was an emergency system found on board starships that used explosive separator charges to blast the antimatter pods clear of the ship in the event that the ship's magnetic bottle was to rupture. The system could be directly activated from helm station.

title: Polarity coil generator
intro: A polarity coil generator was a type of tool utilized by the Tamarians in the 24th century.

title: Polarity maximizer
intro: A polarity maximizer was a piece of technology used by the Cardassians in the 24th century.

title: Polarized hull plating
intro: Polarized hull plating was a defensive armored hull technology used on shuttles and starships. Before the development of deflector shielding, hull polarization was the primary defensive measure for starships against enemy weaponry.

title: Polaron matrix
intro: The polaron matrix was a component of the prototype cloaking device mounted on the Kraylor Medical Transport 136, later dubbed "".

title: Police vessel
intro: In starship classification, a police vessel, or police ship, was a spacecraft used for police activities.

title: Pollux IV Orbital Station

infobox.name: Pollux IV Orbital Station
infobox.location:
In [[orbit]] of [[Pollux IV]]
