[[Alpha Quadrant]]

intro: Pollux IV Orbital Station, also called Pollux IV Orbital City, was an space station orbiting the planet Pollux IV.

title: Porthole
intro: A porthole was an opening in a hull or bulkhead of a sailing vessel, or such spacecraft as a Bajoran lightship.

title: Positronic relay
intro: A positronic relay was technology on board Starfleet vessels in the 24th century, used to power some parts of a ship. It was also used in Soong-type androids.

title: Prakesh
intro: The Prakesh was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military during the mid-to-late 24th century. From 2369 to 2372, this ship was commanded by Gul Dukat of the Second Order, following the loss of his post aboard Terok Nor and as Prefect of Bajor. (, et al.)

title: Pralor vessel
intro: The Pralor vessel was a type of starship initially utilized by the Pralor and were nearly identical to Cravic ships. They were crewed by Automated Personnel Units in the 2370s.

title: Pre-K
intro: A pre-K was a facility where students at an educational level below kindergarten were taught.

title: Predator class
intro: The Predator-class warship was a type of massive 24th century carrier vessel of Trabe origin.

title: President of United Earth's shuttle

infobox.caption: President's shuttle, starboard view
infobox.caption2: Diplomatic delegation wait for the President to disembark

intro: The President of United Earth's shuttle was a United Earth vessel in the 32nd century.

title: Prestage flux chamber
intro: The prestage flux chamber was a component used aboard Federation starships during the late 23rd century, located on both the port and starboard side of a vessel.

title: Primary hull
intro: The primary hull, also known as the main section, saucer section or saucer module on some classes, was a major component of the overall hull structure of most Federation starships. The primary hull was generally located above and to the front of the secondary hull. ()

title: Prison ship
intro: A prison ship or penal deportation vessel was a type of transport ship that acted as a penal facility. Most of these vessels were used to ferry criminals from one prison or detention facility to another to serve out their sentence, though in some cases the ships themselves serve that role.

title: Prison shuttle
intro: In starship classification, a prison shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft employed for the transferring of prisoners between prison facilities.

title: Probe
intro: A probe, space probe, or interstellar probe was an automated spacecraft used to gather information. Probes were often used for tasks or environments that were not well suited for manned-missions.

title: Probe A
intro: Probe A was one of three probes launched from the when it was scanning an unnamed star system in the Gamma Quadrant for the missing . The probe was equipped with a differential magnetomer, so it could pick up a fluctuation in the hysteresis curve. This curve, caused by the interaction of the magnetic field with metallic composites in the hull, would be used to find the Yangtze Kiang in the system.

title: Probe B
intro: Probe B was one of three probes launched from the when it was scanning an unnamed star system in the Gamma Quadrant for the missing . The probe was equipped with a differential magnetomer, so it could pick up a fluctuation in the hysteresis curve. This curve, caused by the interaction of the magnetic field with metallic composites in the hull, would be used to find the Yangtze Kiang in the system.

title: Probe C
intro: Probe C was one of three probes launched from the in 2369 when it was scanning an unnamed star system in the Gamma Quadrant for the missing . The probe was equipped with a differential magnetomer, so it could pick up a fluctuation in the hysteresis curve. This curve, caused by the interaction of the magnetic field with metallic composites in the hull, would be used to find the Yangtze Kiang in the system.

title: Probe casing
intro: A probe casing was the outer shell of a probe.

title: Promellian battle cruiser
intro: The Promellian battle cruiser was a class of battle cruiser utilized by the Promellian military.

title: Prometheus class
intro: The Prometheus class was a highly classified Federation starship designed for deep space tactical assignments. It was one of the most advanced Starfleet vessels in operation during the later half of the 24th century, as well as later use in the 25th century, and in an alternate timeline of the 26th century.

title: Propulsion Systems station
intro: Propulsion Systems was one of the console stations on the bridges of Starfleet starships, used to control and monitor the various propulsion systems aboard ship.

title: Protostar class
intro: The Protostar class was a small starship class launched by Starfleet during the late 24th century that was later approved for full production in 2384 after the destruction of the prototype and namesake vessel, the . ()

title: Protostar type aquashuttle
intro: The Protostar type aquashuttle was a type of small shuttlecraft designed for traveling underwater and used on Federation starships.

title: Protostar type escape pod

infobox.name: ''Protostar'' type escape pod
infobox.caption: An escape pod in its berth

intro: The Protostar type escape pod was a type of emergency escape vehicle used on Federation starships to evacuate a ship during an emergency.

title: Protostar type shuttlecraft
intro: The Protostar type shuttlecraft was a type of small shuttlecraft used on Federation starships. In the construction of these ships, a vehicle replicator in the starship's shuttlebay might be utilized and the shuttle could be constructed in quick order. ()

title: Provider class

infobox.name: ''Provider'' class
infobox.caption: Two adjoining ships of this class

intro: The Provider class was a classification of starship used by the Federation.

title: Ptolemy class
intro: The Ptolemy class was a type of Federation transport/tug utilized by Starfleet during the latter half of the 23rd century.

title: Pup
intro: "Pup", as it was dubbed by Miles O'Brien, was an alien program believed to be a non-biological lifeform that came from an unknown location in the Gamma Quadrant.

title: Pyris VII

infobox.name: Pyris VII
infobox.location:
[[Unnamed Alpha and Beta Quadrant star systems#Pyris VII system|Unnamed system]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Pyris VII was the inhabited seventh planet of an unnamed system. The planet was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. Prior to stardate 3018, several mapping expeditions had revealed no indigenous lifeforms on the planet.

title: Q'Maire
intro: The Q'Maire was a Talarian warship under the command of Captain Endar in 2367 when it encountered the .

title: QSR
intro: QSR was a prefix used when assigning numerical designations to stars and stellar bodies. QSR 390021 was among the stars that had designations of this sort. ()

title: Qaw' class

infobox.name: ''Qaw''' class
infobox.image: Qaw' at the Battle of the Binary Stars.png
infobox.caption: Port view

intro: The Qaw class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

title: QeHpu' class
intro: The QeHpu class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon diaspora during the 32nd century.

title: Qoj class

infobox.name: ''Qoj'' class
infobox.caption: A Qoj class firing weapons
infobox.image2: Qoj at the Battle of the Binary Stars.png

intro: The Qoj class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century. It was similar to, but shorter than the .

title: Qomar starships
intro: Qomar starships were a series of classes of vessels that were operated by the Qomar Planetary Alliance, usually staying within their system for xenophobic reasons. ()

title: Qomar transport
intro: The Qomar transport was a small starship used by the extremely xenophobic Qomar. They were designed to be used primarily within the Qomar system, but are occasionally used outside the system.

title: Qu'Vat Colony
intro: The Qu'Vat Colony was a Klingon outpost located on the planet Qu'Vat in the Beta Quadrant. As of the mid-22nd century, the colony consisted of three population centers: one on the northern continent and two in the southern hemisphere. The population was estimated by Starfleet to be several million, mostly in the southern hemisphere.

title: Quadrant 904 Central Station
intro: Quadrant 904 Central Station was a space station in Quadrant 904.

title: Quadros-1 probe
intro: The Quadros-1 probe was a deep space probe that charted stars of the Gamma Quadrant in the 22nd century, including the Idran system. Findings of the probe were stored in the computers of Federation starships, such as the .

title: Quantometer probe
intro: In 2370, Jadzia Dax asked Deep Space 9's computer to activate a quantometer probe. ()

title: Quantum mechanics (department)
intro: Quantum mechanics was a aboard the Starfleet ships and , dealing with quantum mechanics.

title: Quarantine anteroom
intro: The quarantine anteroom was a room on the where quarantined patients were kept behind a quarantine field so they could have visitors.

title: Quark's Treasure
intro: Quark's Treasure was a Ferengi shuttle that was in service during the late 24th century. This shuttle was presented to Quark by his cousin in 2372, as repayment for a loan of latinum which Quark gave to Gaila to start up a munitions consortium. According to Quark's brother Rom, it was able to outrun a Romulan interceptor, and could go half-way across the galaxy before requiring a maintenance check.

title: Quarren coyote ship
intro: A Quarren coyote ship was a type of well-armed starship used by a band of criminals to abduct the crews of other starships and sell them into labor on Quarra. These ships used subspace mines to disable their target vessels, and were equipped with tractor beams.

title: Quarren patrol ship
intro: A Quarren patrol ship was a type of 24th century patrol ship used by the for patrolling Quarra. ()

title: Quarters
intro: The term quarters referred to accommodations on board spacecraft and space stations and also to accommodations in a building. Quarters could be found all over mobile and stationary facilities, varying in size and detail. An individual room was called a cabin. One form of discipline was being confined to quarters.

title: Queencell
intro: The queencell was a chamber present on Borg cubes, though it was not where the Borg Queen lived. It could be hidden behind moving bulkheads.

title: Qugh class

infobox.name: ''Qugh'' class
infobox.caption: Aft dorsal view
infobox.image2: Qugh at the Battle of the Binary Stars.png

intro: The Qugh class was a type of destroyer used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

title: R'ongovian solar sailship
intro: The R'ongovian solar sailship was a type of solar sail-propelled starship employed by the R'ongovian Protectorate. In the mid-23rd century, the R'ongovian flagship was an antiquated solar sailship that was only used for ceremonial occasions. Per R'ongovian custom, after a treaty signing, the ship would fly the flag of their new allies as a tribute.

title: RM-2
intro: The RM-2 was a design of civilian cargo vessel, considered antiquated by the mid-23rd century. It was rather slow, with a speed described as "barely above sublight."

title: RT-2203
intro: The RT-2203 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. In use as early as 2119, mission profiles included deep space exploration. ( okudagram)

title: Rabol
intro: The Rabol was a Cardassian transport that was in service during the late 24th century.

title: Racing ship
intro: A racing ship was a type of starship built to compete in races.

title: Radar control
intro: Radar control was a room on board the starships. It's location on Deck C was labeled in the ship's master systems display. ()

title: Radiant class
intro: The Radiant class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This class was equipped with four nacelles, similar to the later and .

title: Radioactive disposal vent
intro: starships had at least two radioactive disposal vents for cleaning out built-up radiation. This clean-up process was known as an AID cleanup. During this process, the engines could not be used.

title: Radiometric converter
intro: Radiometric converters were technological components utilized aboard Federation starships in the 24th century, for the purpose of absorbing toxic theta radiation, produced as a byproduct of antimatter waste, and recycling the energy to power various ship systems, such as and replicators.

title: Raging Queen

infobox.image: Raging Queen, Elkins and two Klingon warships.jpg
infobox.caption: Left-most ship
infobox.name: ''Raging Queen''

intro: The Raging Queen (NCC-42284) was a 24th century Federation starship operated by Starfleet. It fought in the Dominion War.

title: Raider
intro: In starship classification, a raider was any type of vessel designed for, or specialized in, conducting raids on other starships or planets. () The term pirate vessel also aptly applies to raiders.

title: Rak-Miunis
intro: The Rak-Miunis was a Kobheerian freighter, registered for travel in Federation space, commanded by Captain Viterian in 2369. That same year, the Rak-Miunis carried the passenger Aamin Marritza to Deep Space 9 from Kora II so that he could set forth his plan to force Cardassia to acknowledge its guilt over the Bajoran Occupation. ()

title: Rakhari shuttlecraft
intro: The Rakhari shuttlecraft was a type of shuttle used by the Rakhari species.

title: Rakosa One
intro: Rakosa One was the lead fighter of a group of fifteen Rakosan fighters that attempted to defend their homeworld from the Cardassian-built missile . The pilot of Rakosa One refused to break off his attack when Captain Kathryn Janeway requested she be allowed more time to rescue B'Elanna Torres from aboard the missile.

title: Rakosan fighter
intro: The Rakosan fighter was a type of small piloted fighter used by the Rakosans. It was armed with a single directed energy weapon.

title: Ramuran vessel
intro: The Ramuran vessel was a type of starship used by Ramuran tracers in the late 24th century.

title: Ranger 5
intro: Ranger 5 was an American Ranger Block II space probe that was in service with NASA during the mid-20th century.

title: Ranger 7
intro: Ranger 7 was an American Ranger Block III space probe that was in service with NASA during the mid-20th century.

title: Ranger program
intro: The Ranger program was a pioneering NASA space probe mission launched by NASA that was flown by the Earth's United States of America during the early 1960s.

title: Ranger program
intro: The Ranger program was a pioneering NASA space probe mission launched by NASA that was flown by the Earth's United States of America during the early 1960s.

title: Ranger program
intro: The Ranger program was a pioneering NASA space probe mission launched by NASA that was flown by the Earth's United States of America during the early 1960s.

title: Ranger program
intro: The Ranger program was a pioneering NASA space probe mission launched by NASA that was flown by the Earth's United States of America during the early 1960s.

title: Raptor class
intro: The Raptor-class scout vessel was a small battle cruiser utilized by the Klingon Empire during the mid-22nd century.

title: Raven type
intro: Raven-type starships were small, modular long-range Federation exploration vessels used in the mid-24th century.

title: Ravinok
intro: The Ravinok was a Cardassian starship that was in service with the Cardassian military, under the general command of Gul Dukat.

title: Ravinok type
intro: The Ravinok type was a Cardassian ship design utilized by the Cardassian Union and operated by the Central Command during the mid-24th century.

title: Razor (ship)
intro: The Razor was a class of small starship used by the inhabitants of Ni'Var in the late 32nd century.

title: Reaction cube
intro: The reaction cube, also called the spore cube, was a test chamber aboard starships. On the it was located in the engineering test bay alpha. ()

title: Reactor room
intro: The reactor room was a location responsible for controlling and monitoring reactors, such as warp reactors on starships.

title: Reconnaissance probe
intro: A reconnaissance probe or scouting probe was a type of probe that was used by Starfleet ships in the late-24th century.

title: Reconnaissance ship
intro: A reconnaissance ship was a type of starship used for reconnaissance.

title: Reconstruction bay
intro: The reconstruction bay was the area aboard Pralor vessels where Automated Personnel Units were repaired.

title: Recreation deck
intro: The recreation deck was a location on Federation starships where crewmembers could go to relax when off duty. The area included a number of games and other recreational activities.

title: Recreation room
intro: The recreation room, often abbreviated to rec room, and also known as a crew or crewman's lounge, was an area of a starship where crewmembers could go to enjoy games and other activities when off duty. They typically contained food synthesizers.

title: Red Lady (ship)
intro: Red Lady was a Romulan warbird that was in service in the early 25th century.

title: Red Lady type
intro: The Red Lady type was a class of Romulan warbird used by the Romulan Free State and the Tal Shiar during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. These ships were decorated on the ventral hull with a painted bird-of-prey.

title: Red Wood

infobox.caption: The Red Wood in the shuttlebay
infobox.name: ''Red Wood''

intro: The Red Wood was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the starship NCC-77567.

title: Red sector
intro: Red sector was a section aboard scout ships.

title: Red's
intro: Red's was the hub of social activity aboard the . It was a lounge with a bar and a central fireplace where crewmembers could socialize and have meals. ()

title: Redwood
intro: The Redwood was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the .

title: Regenerative mode emulsifier
intro: A regenerative mode emulsifier was a technological component found in the 21st century Earth space probe Nomad. ()

title: Registry
intro: A registry was a place to store or register information, similar to a database.

title: Regula I
intro: Regula I was a Federation scientific research laboratory orbiting the D-class planetoid Regula during the late 23rd century.

title: Rekag battle cruiser
intro: Rekag battle cruisers were a type of battle cruiser used by the Rekags during the mid-24th century.

title: Rekag shuttle
intro: Rekag shuttles were small craft utilized by the Rekags during the mid-24th century.

title: Reklar
intro: The Reklar was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century.

title: Relaxation area
intro: The relaxation area was a room on board the starships. Its location on Deck C was labeled in the ship's master systems display. ()

title: Relay 87 A
intro: Relay 87 A was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century.

title: Relay Station 001

infobox.caption: Relay Station 001 is listed on a relay log
infobox.name: Relay Station 001

intro: Relay Station 001 was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

infobox.name: Relay Station 102-A

intro: Relay Station 102-A was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Relay Station 194
intro: Relay Station 194 was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Relay Station 452

infobox.name: Relay Station 452

intro: Relay Station 452 was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Relay Station 47
intro: Relay Station 47, also known as Subspace Network Relay Station 047, was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet during the mid-24th century. This station was located in Sector Ipai, in close proximity to Starbase 212, Relay Station 194, along the Federation-Klingon border.

title: Relay Station 6110

infobox.caption: Relay Station 6110 is listed on a relay log
infobox.name: Relay Station 6110

intro: Relay Station 6110 was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

infobox.name: Relay Station 67

intro: Relay Station 67 was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

infobox.name: Relay Station 902N

intro: Relay Station 902N was a Federation communication relay station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Reliant class
intro: The Reliant class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Remmler Array
intro: The Remmler Array was a space station in orbit of Arkaria and under the command of Starfleet. The station was controlled from the planetside Arkaria Base and was designed to conduct baryon sweeps on docked starships.

title: Renaissance class

infobox.image: Starfleet Mission Status, observation lounge version.svg
infobox.caption: USS Aries listed as a Renaissance-class starship
infobox.name: ''Renaissance'' class

intro: The Renaissance class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the 24th century.

title: Repair bay
intro: A repair bay was an area of a starship dedicated to the repair and maintenance of equipment.

title: Repair ship
intro: In starship classification, a repair ship was a type of vessel which provided repair and maintenance.

title: Replicating center
intro: The replicating center was a facility aboard starships where crewmembers could replicate large goods, in contrast to the individual food replicators found in crew quarters, where mostly food and beverages were replicated.

title: Reptohumanoid vessel
intro: A reptohumanoid vessel was a starship utilized by a reptohumanoid species in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Republic (starship)
intro: The Republic was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. This ship was commanded by Captain Jennings.

title: Rescue material capsule
intro: The rescue material capsule was a spacecraft component used by the starships. It's location on Deck F was labeled in the ship's master systems display. ()

title: Rescue shuttle
intro: A rescue shuttle was a specialized shuttle used by Starfleet for evacuating the starships.

title: Research Station 75
intro: Research Station 75 was a planetary research station located on the fringes of Federation space, approximately two weeks by scout ship from Romulan territory.

title: Residential deck
intro: The residential decks were decks aboard where crew quarters were located.

title: Resonator array
intro: The resonator array was a component of 23rd and 24th century starships.

title: Retellian escape pod
intro: The Retellian escape pod was a type of small escape pod used in the 22nd century to safely evacuate Retellian freighters in the case of an emergency. Two escape pods were directly accessible from a particular section aboard the Retellian freighter. They were not entirely visible from inside the freighter, where merely an access hatch leading to each of the two utility craft was visible.

title: Retellian freighter

infobox.name: Retellian freighter
infobox.caption2: Aft view, thrusters firing full power

intro: A Retellian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Retellians from the 22nd to the 24th centuries.

title: Retribution (starship)
intro: The Retribution was an Orion destroyer that belonged to House Tendi during the late 24th century. By 2381, it was in such a state of disrepair that most, if not all, systems had failed either on their own or due to dependencies, leaving it derelict and non-functional.

title: Retrofitted dorsal carrier
intro: The retrofitted dorsal carrier was a type of starship built in the future. The design number XRT-55D was connected to this carrier, with at least one commissioned in the year 3125.

title: Retrothruster
intro: A retrothruster was a feature of Klingon Bird-of-Prey ships in the late 23rd century.

title: Rev-1
intro: The Rev-1 was a Vau N'Akat warship constructed at Asencia's command, after she usurped control of Solum in 2384. It was the first of an advanced new class of vessels that incorporated temporal technologies obtained via thoughts forcibly extracted from Wesley Crusher. The vessel was completed in a very short time within a temporal accelerant vault. ()

title: Rev-1 type
intro: The Rev-1 type was a class of Vau N'Akat starship, intended by Asencia for waging war of annihilation against the Federation in 2385. ()

title: Rev-12
intro: The Rev-12 was the massive personal fortress and starship of The Diviner. It was normally docked on the upper level of the Tars Lamora prison colony. ()

title: Rev-12 type
intro: The Rev-12 type was a type of starship used by the Vau N'Akat of Solum in the 25th century. ()

title: Reyab
intro: The Reyab was a Kobliad transport that was in service during the 2360s. It carried a crew of only two officers.

title: Rigel VII Lagrange colony

infobox.name: Rigel VII Lagrange colony
infobox.location:
Located at a [[Lagrange point]] near [[Rigel VII]]
[[Rigel system]]
[[Alpha Quadrant]]

intro: Rigel VII Lagrange colony was a space station colony located at a Lagrange point near Rigel VII.

title: Rigel class
intro: Rigel-class was the original intended starship class of the , as it was listed in an okudagram in , before the ship was seen in as an heavy cruiser. After a second appearance of the ship list in , the okudagram was corrected. A later version of the graphic listed the Zhukov correctly as an Ambassador-class starship.

title: Rigelian freighter (22nd century)
intro: The Rigelian freighter was a type of freighter that was operated by Rigelians during the 22nd century.

title: Rigelian freighter (24th century)
intro: The Rigelian freighter was a type of freighter operated by the Rigelians during the late 24th century.

title: Rigelian scoutship
intro: The Rigelian scoutship was a heavily-armed starship used under the authority of the Rigelian Trade Commission during the mid-22nd century. As scouts, these starships had small crew complements of around seventeen.

title: Robot ship
intro: A robot ship or automated ship was a starship that used automation to reduce or eliminate the need for a crew.

title: Rocket
intro: A rocket was a form of spacecraft propulsion, usually used when a society began the early stages of space flight. It was relatively simple, and could be constructed from easily available materials. Rocket engines could also be used in a wide range of other applications, from fireworks to weapons. The study of rockets was known as rocketry. ()

title: Rocket ship
intro: A rocket ship was an orbital or interplanetary spacecraft propelled by a rocket that featured in many 20th century science fiction stories. In The Adventures of Captain Proton, the rocket engine was described as a space drive.

title: Rockwell X-30
intro: The Rockwell X-30 was a type of early Earth space shuttle.

title: Rodaxian starship
intro: The Rodaxian starship was a type of warp-capable spacecraft used by the Rodaxians during the mid-23rd century.

title: Roglay Outpost
intro: Roglay Outpost was an Angosian military outpost.

title: Rogue Changeling starship
intro: The Rogue Changeling starship was a type of starship utilized by rogue Changelings affiliated with Vadic in early 2401.

title: Romulan Bird-of-Prey

infobox.name: Romulan Bird-of-Prey
infobox.caption: Forward view of a Bird of Prey in 2399
infobox.caption3: Aft view of a late 2260s Bird of Prey

intro: The Romulan Bird-of-Prey was a type of space vessel that was in service with the military of the Romulan Star Empire during the late 23rd century. Surviving ships of the class continued to appear in various capacities through the 24th century.

title: Romulan Bird-of-Prey (22nd century)
intro: The Romulan Bird-of-Prey was a type of starship used by the Romulan Star Empire in the 22nd century. Green in color, these crafts were so named because they were designed to appear as birds-of-prey. They were equipped with disruptor banks, as well as advanced cloaking technology. ()

title: Romulan drone ship

infobox.name: Romulan drone ship
infobox.caption: Port quarter view of a deactivated drone ship

intro: The Romulan drone ship was an advanced experimental starship described as a marauder and developed by the Romulans in the 2150s. At the time, this ship class was identified as a marauder ship by Starfleet.

title: Romulan flagship
intro: The Praetor's flagship was a type of warship that was in service with the military of the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of the 23rd century under personal command of the Romulan Praetor.

title: Romulan interceptor
intro: A Romulan interceptor was a type of starship used by the Romulan Star Empire in the 2370s.

title: Romulan science ship
intro: The Romulan science ship was a type of science ship in service during the mid-to-late 24th century which was used to conduct standard and experimental research for the Romulan Star Empire.

title: Romulan scout ship
intro: The Romulan scout ship was a small scout ship used by the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of the 24th century. This class of vessel rarely ventured out as far as the Romulan Neutral Zone. ()

title: Romulan shuttle

infobox.name: Romulan shuttle
infobox.caption: Vessel of the class, at Deep Space 9

intro: The Romulan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Romulan Star Empire in the 2370s.

title: Romulan warbird (22nd century)
intro: The Romulan warbird was one of the starships the Romulan Empire used in the 22nd century.

title: Romulan warbird (2340s)
intro: The Romulan warbird was a type of warbird operated by the Romulan military in the 2340s. They were known to be less maneuverable than Starfleet's starships.

title: Romulan warbird (2399)
intro: The Romulan starship was a type of starship used by the Romulan Free State and the Tal Shiar during the late 24th century.

title: Romulan workbee
intro: A Romulan workbee was a small auxiliary craft used by the Romulans in the late 24th century. They featured a central forward external lighting, two control arms, and a large window for the pilot.

title: Room
intro: A room or chamber was an area in a building or spaceship enclosed by walls, a ceiling, and a floor that could normally be entered via a door or other opening.

title: Ross class
intro: The Ross class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Ru'afo's flagship
intro: Ru'afo's flagship was a medium-sized starship utilized by the Son'a during the late-24th century.

title: Rubber ducky room
intro: The rubber ducky room was a room aboard the that was considered off-limits.

title: Rukani vessel
intro: The Rukani vessel was a type of starship in use by the Rukani in the late-24th century.

title: Runabout
intro: In Federation starship classification, a runabout was the designation of a type of vessel smaller than a starship but larger than a shuttlecraft. Runabouts were equipped with limited weapons and drive systems, but offered additional living space and the ability to be configured to mission-specific cargo capacities. They had a larger operational range and better weapons capability compared to shuttles, and were capable of speeds of up to warp 5. Runabouts were typically assigned to space stations or starships as auxiliary craft. (; )

title: Rutian archaeological vessel
intro: The Rutian archaeological vessel was a type of specialized starship used by the Rutians for conducting archaeology missions.

title: S class shuttle
intro: An S-class shuttle was a type of small spacecraft used in the Federation, considered "old" by the late 24th century. It had two seats, no warp drive, and manual helm controls.

title: SATCOM 47
intro: SATCOM 47 was a communications satellite in Earth orbit in the late 20th century. Owned and operated by Chronowerx Industries, it was augmented with technology which Henry Starling, Chronowerx's CEO, had cannibalized from the 29th century timeship Aeon. Activating the satellite involved an array of bar-like elements spreading open like an umbrella.

title: SB4-0377/5
intro: The SB4-0377⁄5 was a Federation Stamets type shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to Starbase 4. ()

title: SC-4
intro: SC-4 was the designation of a Starfleet Command shuttlecraft during the early 25th century.

title: SC-4
intro: SC-4 was the designation of a Starfleet Command shuttlecraft during the early 25th century.

title: SD-103
intro: SD-103 (NAR-25820) was a Federation transport that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to Starfleet Command.

title: SHN 03
intro: SHN 03 was an Class C shuttlecraft attached to the as of 2239.

title: SHNZ 03
intro: The SHNZ 03 was a Class C shuttlecraft attached to the .

title: SMT 05
intro: SMT 05 was a 23rd century Federation Class C shuttle assigned to Starbase 5. Used as a medical transport, this vessel, bearing the symbol of Starfleet Medical, had a gray-and-white color scheme.

title: SNC
intro: SNC was a prefix used when assigning numerical designations to stars and stellar bodies. SNC 461206 was among the stars that had designations of this sort. ()

title: SNR
intro: SNR was a prefix used when assigning numerical designations to stars and stellar bodies. SNR 093120 was among the stars that had designations of this sort. ()

title: SPT 21
intro: SPT 21 was the registry number of a Federation Class C prison shuttle operated by Starfleet in 2256.

title: SS (registry)
intro: SS was a identifying prefix before a starship name for some vessels in the Earth and Federation registries.

title: SS Artemis
intro: The SS Artemis was a 23rd century Federation colony ship.

title: SS Augyn
intro: The SS Augyn (NGA-24858) was a 24th century Federation commercial transport.

title: SS Beagle
intro: The SS Beagle was a 23rd century Federation class 4 survey vessel operated by the Merchant Service. The Beagle had a crew of forty-seven and was commanded by Captain R.M. Merik; his flight officer was William B. Harrison.

title: SS Birdseye
intro: The SS Birdseye was a space module constructed during the late 20th century that was designed to carry deceased, but cryonically preserved, Humans into Earth's orbit.

title: SS Botany Bay

infobox.name: SS ''Botany Bay''
infobox.caption: SS Botany Bay
infobox.datestatus: 2258{{bracket right}}, {{bracket left}}Narada incursion reality{{!}}''Narada'' incursion reality
infobox.image2: USS Enterprise alongside the Botany Bay (remastered).jpg
infobox.caption2: The USS Enterprise alongside the SS Botany Bay

intro: The SS Botany Bay was a sleeper ship built on Earth in the late 20th century. The Botany Bay was launched from Earth during the Eugenics Wars under the command of Khan Noonien Singh. The Botany Bay was used by a group of genetically-enhanced Humans known as Augments, led by Khan Noonien Singh, in an attempt to escape from Earth after being defeated by non-Augments.

title: SS Buckaroo Banzai

infobox.caption: The SS Buckaroo Banzai listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Buckaroo Banzai''

intro: The SS Buckaroo Banzai was a Terran BBI-993-type starship that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

title: SS Carlos
intro: The SS Carlos was supposedly a colonial ship in service during the 23rd century.

title: SS Columbia
intro: The SS Columbia (NC 1540-J) was a 23rd century Federation survey ship. The ship was launched from Earth and disappeared in 2236.

title: SS Conestoga
intro: The SS Conestoga was an Earth colony ship that was in service with the Space Agency in the mid-21st century.

title: SS Conestoga
intro: The SS Conestoga was an Earth colony ship that was in service with the Space Agency in the mid-21st century.

title: SS Dierdre
intro: The SS Dierdre was a 23rd century Federation freighter. This starship had, at best, a maximum speed of warp 2.

title: SS Eleos XII
intro: The SS Eleos XII (NAR-59019) was a civilian Federation starship that was in service during the early 25th century. It was affiliated with the Mariposas and operated by Doctor Beverly Crusher and her son, Jack Crusher. ()

title: SS Emmette
intro: The SS Emmette was an starship in use on Earth and Luna before the of starships.

title: SS Hatteras

infobox.caption: The SS Hatteras listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Hatteras''

intro: The SS Hatteras was a 22nd century Federation DY-245-class starship.

title: SS Hokule'a

infobox.caption: The SS Hokule'a listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Hokule'a''

intro: The SS Hokule'a was a Terran DY-500-C (sub)class starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.

title: SS Kogin
intro: The SS Kogin (NAR-24016) was a 24th century Federation transport.

title: SS La Sirena
intro: SS La Sirena (NAR-93131), or simply Sirena, was an unregistered Kaplan F17 Speed Freighter owned and operated by Cristóbal Rios during the late 24th century.

title: SS Lakul
intro: The SS Lakul (NFT-7793) was a transport, under El-Aurian registry, that was in operation during the late-23rd century. It had a crew of twelve.

title: SS Manila
intro: The SS Manila was a Federation transport ship that was in service in the early 24th century.

title: SS Manoa
intro: The SS Manoa (NAR-28474) was a 24th century Federation transport.

title: SS Mariposa
intro: The SS Mariposa (NAR-7678) was a 22nd century colony ship from Earth, owned by OCC. It was captained by Walter Granger.

title: SS Molokai
intro: The SS Molokai was a 24th century Federation starship.

title: SS Oregon
intro: The Oregon was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.

title: SS Puget Sound
intro: The SS Puget Sound was a 23rd century Federation colony ship.

title: SS Raccoona
intro: The SS Raccoona was supposedly a colonial ship in service during the 23rd century.

title: SS Robert Fox
intro: The SS Robert Fox (NFT-1327) was a transport, under El-Aurian registry, that operated during the late 23rd century. This vessel had a crew of seventeen.

title: SS Santa Maria
intro: The SS Santa Maria (BDR-529) was a 24th century Federation personnel transport. Santa Maria was sent out to colonize Gemulon V in 2360. En route to her destination, the ship developed problems and crash landed on a planet in the Orellius system for repairs. Once the ship landed, all of its systems failed due to a duonetic field, and the ship's passengers and crew became stranded. Stripped of all technology, the ship was used as living quarters for the colonists, who affectionately renamed it "The Cabin".

title: SS Seattle

infobox.caption: The SS Seattle listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Seattle''

intro: The SS Seattle was a Terran NAR18834-type starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.

title: SS Shiku Maru
intro: The SS Shiku Maru (NBT-30894) was a 24th century Federation starship. This vessel was commanded by Captain A. Silvestri.

title: SS Tiptree
intro: The SS Tiptree was supposedly a colonial ship in service during the 23rd century.

title: SS Tomobiki

infobox.caption: The SS Tomobiki listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Tomobiki''

intro: The SS Tomobiki was a Terran RT-2203-class starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.

title: SS Tsiolkovsky
intro: The SS Tsiolkovsky (NCC-53911), also known as К. Э. Циолковский, (Romanized from Cyrillic: K. E. Tsiolkovsky) was a 24th century Federation starship operated by Starfleet. The Tsiolkovsky was built at the Baikonur Cosmodrome, USSR and commissioned on stardate 40291.7.

title: SS Tsiolkovsky dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of . ()

title: SS Urusei Yatsura

infobox.caption: The SS Urusei Yatsura listed on Picard's monitor
infobox.name: SS ''Urusei Yatsura''

intro: The SS Urusei Yatsura was a Terran DY-430 class starship that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

title: SS Valiant

infobox.caption: The disaster recorder from the SS Valiant
infobox.name: SS ''Valiant''

intro: The SS Valiant was an Earth starship that was in service in the mid-21st century. In 2065, the Valiant embarked on a mission of deep space exploration. (, )

title: SS Vico
intro: The SS Vico (NAR-18834) was a 24th century Federation starship. The Vico was designed for traveling through gravitational wavefronts.

title: SS Wisconsin
intro: The SS Wisconsin (NAR-50732) was a 24th century Federation transport.

title: SS Xhosa
intro: The SS Xhosa was an cruiser, which according to its dedication plaque, was constructed at the Luna Shipyards during the 23rd century. By 2371, the Xhosa was commanded by the civilian Kasidy Yates.

title: SS Xhosa dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of civilian freighter . ( set artwork)

title: Saavik (shuttle)
intro: The Saavik was a Federation Type 14 shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet in the early 25th century. It was attached to the , with the number 3.

title: Saber class
intro: The Saber class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s.

title: Sabrerunner class
intro: The Sabrerunner class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Sacagawea
intro: The Sacagawea was the diplomatic shuttle that carried Gwyndala to Solum.

title: Sacagawea type
intro: The Sacagawea type shuttlecraft was a type of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the 2380s.

title: Sacajawea
intro: The Sacajawea was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet during the late-24th century. The shuttle was attached to the and was given the designation of "Shuttle 05". ()

title: Sacajawea (illusion)
intro: The Sacajawea was an illusion of the Type 6 shuttlecraft of the same name. It was created in 2373 by a member of an unidentified alien species as part of a plan to entice Captain Kathryn Janeway into joining it. ()

title: Sagan class
intro: The Sagan class was a type of Federation starship used by Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Sahil's relay station
intro: Sahil's relay station was a former Federation relay station used as a courier waypoint in the 32nd century. The station was damaged long ago, with the probable cause being a main reactor breach; it was located in a debris field that contained a wrecked starship.

title: Sakharov
intro: The Sakharov was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 01.

title: Saladin class
intro: The Saladin-class destroyer was a type of starship operated by Starfleet for the during the 23rd century.

title: Salvoxia
intro: Around the 2270s, the Salvoxia suffered a cascade failure. System after system failed, and eventually, the generators began to fail one by one. There wasn't enough air to sustain the whole crew, so they began to draw lots, hopefully awaiting rescue, which never came. The entire crew eventually asphyxiated. The Salvoxia drifted in space for eighty years until it was discovered.

title: Sam Freedle (shuttlepod)

infobox.caption: The Sam Freedle listed on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Sam Freedle''

intro: The Sam Freedle was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 12.

title: Sampaguita

infobox.name: Sampaguita
infobox.caption: Sampaguita under construction
infobox.caption2: A facsimile of the completed ship as intended

intro: The Sampaguita was a homemade racing ship designed and built by Sam Rutherford during his freshman year at Starfleet Academy in 2371. The Sampaguita was funded by winning races such as the Devron 500, but was ultimately the last of several "sick racing ships" he built in his personal garage. It was during the construction a key component overheated and exploded, causing Rutherford to suffer significant injuries, particularly to the left side of his face. At the time, it was to be the "fastest racer in the quadrant." The accident led to the Sampaguita never being completed because Lieutenant Commander Les Buenamigo used an oculus to erase Rutherford's memories of him and an illegal program th

title: Sanction (freighter)

infobox.caption: The Sanction
infobox.name: ''Sanction''
infobox.caption2: USS Enterprise-D attempts to tractor the Sanction

intro: The Sanction was an Ornaran freighter that was used to transport goods between the worlds of Ornara and Brekka, in the Delos star system. For two hundred years, freighters were critical to both planets due to the medicine traded between them.

title: Sanctuary of P'Jem
intro: The Sanctuary of P'Jem, or simply P'Jem, was a Vulcan monastery on the northern hemisphere of the planet P'Jem. This planet was located in the Alpha Quadrant and was near the Andorian system. The outpost was destroyed in 2152 due to the Vulcan High Command misusing it for illicit surveillance of the Andorian Empire.

title: Saowin's shuttle
intro: Saowin's shuttle was a shuttle that Saowin used to visit the Think Tank.

title: Sarajevo
intro: The Sarajevo (NC-27) was an United Earth transport that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

title: Sarajevo type
intro: The Sarajevo-type starship was a class of warp driven vessel utilized by Earth during the mid-22nd century.

title: Saratoga
intro: The Saratoga was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century.

title: Sarcophagus

infobox.image: Klingon ship of the dead forward view.jpg
infobox.name: ''Sarcophagus''

intro: The Sarcophagus, or Ship of the Dead, was a Klingon starship that originally served as the command vessel of the House of T'Kuvma.

title: Satarran starship
intro: The Satarran starship was a small spacecraft used by the Satarrans. It could be piloted by one person and lacked discernible armament. However, it was equipped with an advanced sensor system that could remotely access the optical data network of a Federation starship, penetrate its shields, and alter computer records and memories.

title: Satellite control
intro: Satellite control was a department on the responsible for deploying and activating satellites.

title: Sato Atrium
intro: The Sato Atrium, also called the Athena Atrium, was a large public space that served as both a part of the and the campus on Earth. It was named in honor of Hoshi Sato. ()

title: Saturn V

infobox.name: Saturn V
infobox.caption: Saturn V at McKinley Rocket Base

intro: The Saturn V was an American Human-rated expendable rocket that was in service with NASA in the mid-to-late 20th century. This rocket was used for the Apollo and Skylab programs.

title: Saturn class
intro: The Saturn class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. It featured a ring-shaped design with two nacelles connected at the aft directly to the primary hull.

title: Scanner probe
intro: A scanner probe was a type of basic probe that was used by Starfleet ships in the late-24th century.

title: School shuttle
intro: A school shuttle was a shuttlecraft classification used for shuttles that transported students to school.

title: Science Library
intro: The Science Library was a facility where science microtapes were stored on a starship. On the , this room was located on Deck 14.

title: Science Station 0912
intro: Science Station 0912 was a Federation scientific outpost operational in the late 24th century. This outpost was located in the Beta Quadrant.

title: Science Station Delta-05

infobox.name: Science Station Delta-05
infobox.location:
On a [[Science Station Delta-05 planet|planet]]
[[Sector 30]]
[[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Science Station Delta-05, also known as Outpost Delta-05 or Science Station D-5, was a distant Federation science station and outpost located on a planet in Sector 30, Beta Quadrant. It was one of nine outposts located in its sector.

title: Science Station Tango Sierra
intro: Science Station Tango Sierra was a Federation science station in the Rachelis system, Beta Quadrant. This station was operational by the mid-24th century.

title: Science laboratory
intro: A science laboratory, also known as a science lab, research laboratory, or lab, was any area set-up for work in experimental or observational science. Areas like these were commonplace aboard explorational vessels such as Federation starships, space stations and outposts, under the auspices of Starfleet's sciences division.

title: Science station
intro: The science station was a console located on the bridge of Starfleet and other starships. The station was designed to monitor scientific activity aboard the ship, () and was manned by a science officer.

title: Science vessel
intro: In starship classification, a science vessel (aka science ship or research vessel) was a limited-role starship.

title: Scimitar

infobox.name: ''Scimitar''
infobox.caption: The ''Scimitar'' confronts the USS ''Enterprise''-E
infobox.armament:
52 pulse [[disruptor]] cannons;
27 [[photon torpedo]] launchers;
[[thalaron radiation|thalaron]] [[cascading biogenic pulse]] weapon
infobox.caption2: The damaged Scimitar deploys its cascading biogenic pulse weapon

intro: The Scimitar was a massive, heavily-armed Reman warbird. It was constructed under the command of Shinzon as part of a secret plot to overthrow the Romulan Senate, defeat the United Federation of Planets, and liberate the subjugated natives of Remus.

title: Scorch
intro: The scorch was the oldest unreplaced piece of hull plating on the . In 2259, it was located on the forward dorsal section on the primary hull.

title: Scorpion class
intro: The Scorpion-class vessels were small attack fliers stored aboard the Reman warbird Scimitar in 2379.

title: Scout ship
intro: In starship classification, a scout ship, or simply scout, was a lightly armed, limited-role starship type.

title: Seat belt
intro: A seat belt was a harness designed to hold and protect a passenger of a vehicle in case of an accident or a sudden stop.

title: Secondary hull
intro: On many Federation starships, the secondary hull (also known as the engineering hull, the engineering section, the stardrive section, or the battle section) was a major component of the overall hull structure. The secondary hull was generally located behind and below the primary hull.

title: Section
intro: A section was an area in a facility set aside for a particular purpose or person.

title: Section 31 Headquarters
intro: Section 31 Headquarters was a space station used during the mid-23rd century by the covert Starfleet organization Section 31. Listed as an abandoned penal colony, the station was used by Section 31 as a forward operating base and housed the AI known as Control.

title: Section 31 drone ship
intro: A drone ship was a type of auxiliary craft used by Section 31 Control in 2257 after going rogue.

title: Section 31 shuttle
intro: The Section 31 shuttle was a class of auxillary vessel in use by Section 31 in the 23rd century.

title: Section 31 starships
intro: The following is a list of Section 31 starships.

title: Security board
intro: A security board was a display that indicated abnormal increases in power utilization on a starship.

title: Security office
intro: A security office was the administrative room for security chiefs to keep records of their work and supervise the work of their security officers and deputies. Security offices can be found on starships and space stations.

title: Security satellite
intro: A security satellite or recon satellite was a type of artificial satellite. As part of a Vulcan orbital security grid, they were employed to monitor the atmosphere of for any breaches to the planet's surface. Each of these recon satellites had an imaging node, linked to a central processor. Recon satellites near Vulcan's Forge often malfunctioned.

title: Security station
intro: Aboard starships, like the , the security station was located on deck 9. When the Enterprise-D received a message from the security officer of the Klingon ship , Captain Jean-Luc Picard ordered Lieutenant Worf to handle the call at the security station. ()

title: Seed vault
intro: A seed vault was a place where seeds were stored long-term.

title: Seeker
intro: The Seeker was a reconnaissance device developed by the Xindi-Reptilians originally for use in the Xindi Civil War. It incorporated anti-gravity technology to fly and seek out enemies and then report back to its operator. Each containing at least one techno-larva, the Seekers, like much other Xindi technology, incorporated biological components – so much so that a Starfleet scanner could actually mistake it for a Xindi bio-sign. Seekers could be prevented from detecting bio-signs using topaline ore.

title: Selective amplifier screen
intro: A selective amplifier screen was a technological component found in the early 21st century Earth space probe Nomad. ()

title: Seleya
intro: The Seleya was a Vulcan combat cruiser that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. This ship was under the command of Captain Voris. Its standard crew complement was 147.

title: Sensor drone
intro: A sensor drone was a type of automated surveillance probe. These probes were connected by a transmission network. Sensor drones were utilized by the Xindi and the .

title: Sensor maintenance
intro: Sensor maintenance, or sensor maintenance room, was a room on starships.

title: Sensor section
intro: The sensor section was one or more sections on the that took sensor readings.

title: Sentry pod
intro: Sentry pods were small, unmanned spacecraft used for defense, primarily deployed to intercept and prevent hostile incursions into a certain area.

title: Sepulo
intro: The Sepulo was a Ferengi transport that was in service during the mid-24th century.

title: Sequoia
intro: The Sequoia was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, and attached to the .

title: Seran T-1
intro: Seran T-1 was the designation for a 24th century Federation outpost. The outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Serene Squall
intro: The Serene Squall was a pirate vessel operated in space outside the Federation in the 2250s by . It had a mixed-species crew and conducted raids along the border of Federation space. It was briefly commandeered by Starfleet Captain Christopher Pike and his senior officers in 2259, after which it and its crew were taken into custody. ()

title: Seronian fighter craft
intro: Seronian fighter craft were a type of defensive starship used by the Seronians.

title: Serosian vessel
intro: The Serosian vessel was a type of warp-capable starship used by the Serosians during the late-24th century. They operated with a crew of six and were usually equipped with isomorphs; holographic programs used for ship maintenance. 59.2 percent of the vessel's power reserves were dedicated to its life support systems.

title: Service chute
intro: The service chute was a system aboard the that dispensed clean Starfleet uniforms to crew members.

title: Service docking port
intro: The service docking port was an integral design element of the starship. The location of this port on the starboard warp nacelle was labeled on a schematic of the that was seen on William T. Riker's bridge console. ()

title: Setar
intro: The Setar (NCC-1631⁄4) was a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: Setar (Ferengi)
intro: The Setar was a 24th century Ferengi Alliance starship.

title: Setlik III
intro: Setlik III was the formerly inhabited third planet in the Setlik system, Alpha Quadrant.

title: Sh'Raan
intro: The Sh'Raan was a Vulcan combat cruiser that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century.

title: Sh'Rel
intro: The Sh'Rel was a Vulcan starship that was in service during the mid-23rd century of an alternate timeline.

title: Sh'vhal type
intro: The Sh'vhal type was a class of cruiser utilized by the Vulcan High Command during the late 24th century. This class of vessel was significantly larger in size than a starship.

title: Shaenor
intro: The Shaenor was a late 24th century Romulan Imperial scout ship operated by the Tal Shiar.

title: Shango X-1
intro: The Shango X-1 was an early 21st century Earth spacecraft assigned to the Europa Mission. The ship was named after , the Yoruba people's god of thunder and lightning.

title: Shangri-La class
intro: The Shangri-La class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Shangri-La class
intro: The Shangri-La class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.

intro: A Sheliak colony ship was a type of starship used by the reclusive Sheliak species for the transport of "the membership", which was their term for "colonists".

title: Shenandoah
intro: The Shenandoah was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century.

title: Shepard class
intro: The Shepard class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 2250s and 2260s.

title: Shepherd ship
intro: The Shepherd ship was a type of starship used by the species in the mid-23rd century to protect ancient comets that they venerated as Arbiters of Life. These vessels were substantially larger and more technologically advanced than a Federation starship, endowed with superior speed and firepower. They were equipped with several forward torpedo launchers and a tractor beam.

title: Sherval Das
intro: The Sherval Das was a Valerian transport ship in operation in the 24th century.

title: Sherval Das
intro: The Sherval Das was a Valerian transport ship in operation in the 24th century.

title: Ship class
intro: A ship class was a shared construction design of spacecraft or starship operated by an entity.

title: Ship prefix
intro: A ship prefix was an acronym prefixed onto the front of a ship's name. Ship prefixes were used by both ocean-going vessels and starships. The ship prefix could serve to identify the ship's purpose, its technology, or its allegiance.

title: Ship prefix
intro: A ship prefix was an acronym prefixed onto the front of a ship's name. Ship prefixes were used by both ocean-going vessels and starships. The ship prefix could serve to identify the ship's purpose, its technology, or its allegiance.

title: Ship's bell
intro: The ship's bell was a traditional Earth nautical device designed to indicate time intervals in relation to duty watches aboard a ship with the sounding of a .

title: Ship's store
intro: The ship's store was, historically, a retail space aboard a naval vessel where sailors could purchase non-regulation essentials and non-essentials. When Human's ventured into outer space, such facilities were later placed aboard Federation starships. Such items included apparel, tools, and samples of compounds. On a starship, ship's stores were located on deck four. ()

title: Shiva class
intro: The Shiva class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.

title: Shock attenuation cylinder
intro: The shock attenuation cylinders were components aboard an starship.

intro: The Shrike was a formidable starship commanded by the Changeling Vadic. The ship was named after the , a small carrion bird from Earth. ()

title: Shuttle 06
intro: Shuttle 06 was a Federation Protostar type shuttlecraft that was manufactured by a vehicle replicator aboard the at the request of Gwyn in 2383. As the shuttle was under construction, Rok-Tahk attempted to stop Gwyn, and became tangled in the shuttle's framework, before eventually breaking free of the shuttle and ultimately destroying it. ()

title: Shuttle 06 (2384)
intro: Shuttle 06 was a Federation Protostar type shuttlecraft that was manufactured by a vehicle replicator aboard the in 2384. It was a replacement for the earlier Shuttle 06.

title: Shuttle 07
intro: Shuttle 07 was a Federation Protostar-type aquashuttle.

title: Shuttle 12091
intro: Shuttle 12091 was a military shuttle used by Starfleet during the late 2250s of the .

title: Shuttle 4709
intro: Shuttle 4709 was a Bajoran transport ship that was in service in the late 24th century.

title: Shuttle 78072
intro: Shuttle 78072 was a military shuttle assigned by Starfleet to an outpost on in 2258.

title: Shuttle drone
intro: A shuttle drone was a small Federation auxiliary craft employed during the 24th century and usually attached to a starbase or a space station. ()

title: Shuttlebay
intro: The shuttlebay (variously called the flight deck, hangar deck, shuttlecraft bay, shuttlecraft deck, launch bay, or landing bay) was a facility on a starship where shuttlecraft were launched, received, stored, and maintained. The shuttlebay was externally accessed via the hangar doors and internally by the pressure doors.

title: Shuttlebay 2
intro: Shuttlebay 2 was the second shuttlebay aboard a starship.

title: Shuttlebay 3
intro: Shuttlebay 3, also known as docking bay 3, was one of the three shuttlebays aboard starships.

title: Shuttlebay door
intro: The shuttlebay doors, shuttlecraft bay doors, launch bay doors, bay launch doors, bay doors, hangar doors, space doors, flight hatch, or simply hatch were the main access points for a space vehicle, such as a shuttlecraft, to enter or depart a starship or space station. On a space station, these were known as spacedock doors.

title: Shuttlecraft
intro: In starship classification, a shuttlecraft, shuttle, or glider was a type of auxiliary space vessel typically attached to a starship or a starbase. Most shuttles were short-range transports, possessing only impulse drive or a limited warp capability. Utilization of shuttlecraft was common for most spacefaring civilizations, and along with the transporter, were two of the more common conventional modes of transportation to and from one place to another. () Shuttles were generally used for landings when transporters were inoperable, or not yet within the technological capabilities of a species. At times shuttlecraft were used by individuals who preferred not to use transporters or were unable

title: Shuttlecraft 3
intro: Shuttlecraft 03 was a Federation Type 4 shuttlecraft operated by Starfleet.

title: Shuttlecraft fuel storage
intro: Shuttlecraft fuel storage was a section where fuel for shuttlecraft was stored on a starship. Its location was labeled on a ship diagram of the . ()

title: Shuttlepod
intro: In starship classification, a shuttlepod was a smaller type of shuttlecraft which was usually only capable of impulse speed or low-warp speeds. This designation was given to small craft that do not have passenger capacity like their larger relatives.

title: Shuttlepod (22nd century)

infobox.name: Shuttlepod (22nd century)
infobox.speed: One-quarter [[impulse]] ''(normal maximum speed, faster with modifications)''

intro: A shuttlepod was a type of shuttlecraft operated by Starfleet in the 2150s and early 2160s. The shuttlepods were used to transport personnel to and from planets and/or spacecraft.

title: Shuttlepod 1 (2151)
intro: Shuttlepod 1 was an United Earth that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century, attached to .

title: Shuttlepod 1 (2154)
intro: Shuttlepod 1 was an United Earth that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century, attached to . It was the replacement pod for the that was scuttled in an alternate 1944. ()

title: Shuttlepod 1 (mirror)
intro: Shuttlepod 1 was a used by the crew of the starship in 2155 of the mirror universe.

title: Shuttlepod 2
intro: Shuttlepod 2 was an United Earth that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century, attached to .

title: Sickbay
intro: Sickbay, also known as the dispensary or the medbay, was the main medical center aboard Federation starships. The section was presided over by the chief medical officer (CMO), a senior staff member. The CMO was supported by various medical practitioners. The area was also used for certain analyses of new lifeforms a starship might encounter, and for developing treatments for unknown diseases or illnesses. When rendering aid to a stricken planet or spacecraft, the sickbay staff treated and cared for the wounded. On starbases, sickbay was typically called the infirmary.

title: Sierra VI
intro: Sierra 6, also known as Outpost Sierra 6, was a Federation outpost administered by Starfleet. Located in the Beta Quadrant, this outpost was near the Federation-Romulan border.

title: Sikarian vessel
intro: The Sikarian vessel was a small starship used by the Sikarians for interstellar travel.

title: Single stage-to-orbit
intro: Single stage-to-orbit, also known as SSTO, was a type of space vehicle.

title: Singularity (ship)
intro: The Singularity was a large Borg starship encountered by the Federation in the early 25th century. It was manned by a separate Borg Collective that originated from the assimilation in 2024 of Doctor Agnes Jurati by a Borg Queen from an alternate timeline in which she was the last surviving Borg. This new Collective was founded on the principles of cooperation and assimilating only the willing. ()

title: Sisko's attack ship
intro: Sisko's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship captured by Captain Benjamin Sisko and the crew of Deep Space 9 in the Gamma Quadrant in 2373.

title: Sister ship
intro: A sister ship was a metaphorical term that described a ship of the same class as, or virtually identical to, another ship. The term was used by the Federation, Klingons, and Romulans.

title: Situation room
intro: The situation room was a small section located on A Deck of some starships in the 22nd century. () On those craft that included a situation room, it was situated at the rear of the bridge. The room was designed for officers to discuss mission details. As such, it was a precursor to the briefing room aboard Federation vessels, where senior officers could hold discussions on subjects such as the progress of a mission. (, et al.) When it was not used for briefings, the situation room was often manned by several crewmembers. ()

title: Skagaran starship
intro: The Skagaran starship was a class of warp-capable ship in use by the Skagarans during the 19th century.

title: Skrreean ships
intro: The vessels used by the Skrreea were of various designs.

title: Sky machine
intro: "Sky machine" was the term that the Shore Leave Planet's master computer used to describe starships visiting its world, including the .

title: Skylab
intro: Skylab was a Human space station active in the late 20th century. The station was placed into Earth orbit by the United States of America with NASA overseeing the facility. The solar-powered Skylab could house three astronauts. These astronauts were transported to the facility and were returned to Earth by a command/service module from the Apollo program.

title: Sleeper ship
intro: A sleeper ship was a spacecraft in which the crew could be placed into suspended animation, or even actual sleep of some kind, for all or part of the journey. Civilizations which used sleeper ships included Earth (in the late 20th to early 21st century), and Tellar.

title: Snakehead
intro: The snakehead was a type of warp-capable scout ship employed by Romulans in the late 24th century. Despite its small size, it was heavily armed with twin retractable ventral-mounted disruptor cannons and featured double subthrusters. It was protected by deflector shields and a cloaking device, which could be reversed to project a false decoy image of the ship. It was operated by a single pilot.

title: Snipe class
intro: The Snipe class was a classification of starship used by the Romulan military.

title: Soil department
intro: The soil department was a unit of the sciences division aboard the that studied soil composition. ()

title: Sol Station
intro: Sol Station (ID number Sol 398392), also known as Probert Station but most commonly referred to as Spacedock, was a Federation space station located in Earth orbit and operated by Starfleet in the early 25th century. It resembled its predecessor in design, but featured several additional structures. The station was armed with phasers and photon torpedoes. ()

title: Sol-398391
intro: The Sol-398391 was a Federation defense satellite that was in service to Starfleet in the early 25th century. This satellite was located near to the Sol Station. It was destroyed by the Borg-captured Starfleet ships. ()

title: Solar probe
intro: A solar probe was a type of probe designed to study stars at close distance for scientific research. They could be modified to crash into a sun. The Egg was an example of a solar probe.

title: Solar research vessel
intro: A solar research vessel was a starship that was equipped for the close-up study of stars.

title: Soliton wave rider
intro: The soliton wave rider was an unmanned test ship used during the mid-24th century.

title: Sombra class

infobox.name: ''Sombra'' class
infobox.caption: Forward view of a damaged ship

intro: The Sombra class was a type of Federation starship in service with Starfleet during the 23rd century. In 2259, one such vessel was assigned to a mapping mission in non-Federation space. ()

title: Son'a battle cruiser
intro: The Son'a battle cruiser was a type of large warship utilized by the Son'a. These vessels were armed with photon torpedoes and isolytic bursts, a variety of subspace weapon banned by the Second Khitomer Accords. Two of them outmatched a Federation starship.

title: Son'a collector
intro: The Son'a collector was a massive spacecraft designed by the Son'a to harvest metaphasic radiation from the rings of the planet , which conferred immortality.

title: Son'a drone
intro: Son'a drones were small automated flying devices used by the Son'a, capable of shooting isolinear tags. These probes were capable of pursuing moving humanoids, targeting them and firing dart-like tags onto them.

title: Son'a shuttle
intro: The Son'a shuttles were medium-sized auxiliary craft utilized by the Son'a. These vessels were equipped with transporters and an indeterminate type of torpedo.

title: Sovereign type escape pod
intro: The Sovereign-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard , , , and starships. (; )

title: Soyuz
intro: The Soyuz was a manned Russian spacecraft in service with the Soviet space program, and later the Russian Space Agency, in the 20th and 21st centuries.

intro: The Soyuz class was a type of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the late 23rd century. The class was retired by the late 2280s. ()

title: Space capsule
intro: A space capsule was a spacecraft vehicle or a component of a larger vehicle which was designed to protect, support, and transport astronauts to and from space.

title: Space shuttle
intro: A space shuttle was a form of low-orbit spacecraft commonly launched from Earth during the 20th and 21st centuries.

title: Space shuttle orbiter
intro: A space shuttle orbiter was a type of low-orbit spacecraft developed on Earth by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration of the United States of America.

title: Space station
intro: A space station was an artificial structure in space, often built to support life. Space stations could serve many purposes, including research, defense, and starship maintenance. Depending on their purpose, they may have been referred to by another term, such as a spacelab or outpost. Space stations could be in orbit of a planet, or be completely free floating in space.

title: Space telescope
intro: A space telescope was a telescope in space used for observing celestial bodies.

title: Spacecraft
intro: A spacecraft, or space vessel, was a natural term used to describe any sort of craft designed for simple orbital to more advanced space travel, in designs ranging from rockets and probes, to shuttles, space capsules, and spaceships.

intro: Spacedock One was a Federation space station operated by Starfleet from the late 23rd to the early 25th centuries. The prototypical example of a "spacedock", it was located in orbit of Earth for most of its service, until it was moved to Athan Prime sometime before 2401.

title: Spacematic

infobox.caption: The Spacematic in Deep Space Station K-7's hangar bay next to NCC-K7
infobox.name: ''Spacematic''

intro: The Spacematic was a one-man scout ship that was in service in the mid-23rd century. This ship was owned by Cyrano Jones, and was larger than a Class F shuttlecraft.

title: Spaceship
intro: A spaceship, space vehicle, or space vessel was any type of manned spacecraft capable of traveling in space, by the means of space normal or warp speeds. Specifically, a spaceship was capable of achieving or leaving a planet's orbit. () In the Risan language, the term was translated as "woomar". ()

title: Spare parts deposit
intro: Spare parts deposit was a room on board the starships.

title: Spatial discriminator
intro: Spatial discriminators were components of Earth vessels' stabilizers in the 22nd century.

title: Species 10026 vessel
intro: Species 10026 vessels were advanced starships utilized by Species 10026 during the latter half of the 24th century. These vessels were armed with modulating phaser pulses, which was considered by the Borg to be the vessel's tactical strength, as they were capable of penetrating Borg deflector shielding. The tactical weakness of these vessels was their lack of maneuverability.

title: Species 116 sentry vessel
intro: A sentry vessel was a type of spacecraft used by a species in the Delta Quadrant which the Borg knew as Species 116. These vessels were posted at specific locations to prevent the passage of the Borg into the territory of Species 116.

title: Species 6339 shuttle
intro: The Species 6339 shuttle was a short-range craft used by a species known to the Borg as Species 6339.

title: Species 6339 starship
intro: The Species 6339 starship was a type of starship utilized by Species 6339.

title: Species 8472 bio-ship
intro: The Species 8472 bio-ship was a type of organic-based vessel used by Species 8472 in large numbers during their invasion of the Milky Way Galaxy in 2373. ()

title: Species 8472 energy focusing ship
intro: The Species 8472 energy focusing ship was a type of organic starship used by Species 8472. Similar in configuration to the more numerous bio-ship, it was also capable of crossing between normal space and fluidic space using quantum singularities.

title: Sphere 634
intro: Sphere 634 was a Borg sphere that was in service in the late 24th century.

title: Sphere 878
intro: Sphere 878 was a Borg sphere that was in service in the late 24th century. This sphere had a complement of eleven thousand drones.

title: Sphere-Builder vessels
intro: Sphere-Builder vessels were armed starships used by the Sphere-Builders while they attempted to invade the Milky Way Galaxy in a possible alternate 26th century, part of their arsenal that also included the Delphic Expanse spheres. In the pivotal Battle of Procyon V, three different vessel designs were employed by the Sphere-Builders, with none of them being able to survive counterattacks from Federation forces. ()

title: Sphinx workpod
intro: A sphinx workpod was a type of auxiliary craft that was used during the 24th century.

title: Spider ship
intro: "Spider ship" was the term Captain Kathryn Janeway, playing the character of Queen Arachnia in Tom Paris' Captain Proton holonovel, used to describe the vessels in Arachnia's space force. She improvised the term while proposing an alliance with Doctor Chaotica. ()

title: Spike (nickname)
intro: Spike was Renée Picard's nickname for OV-165. She called the ship that for its aerospike engines. ()

title: Spray tank
intro: A spray tank was a component that could be installed on board starships.

title: Springfield class

infobox.name: ''Springfield'' class

intro: The Springfield class was a type of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century. ()

intro: Sputnik 1 was the first artificial satellite launched by Humans. It was built by the Earth's Soviet Union, and its 1957 launch ushered in the Space Age. ( okudagram)

title: Squash court
intro: A squash court was a where the sport of squash was played.

title: Srivani vessel
intro: The Srivani vessel was a type of small craft used by the Srivani in the late-24th century. It was equipped with stealth technology to render it invisible and intangible at a phase variance of 0.15.

title: Stabilizer
intro: Stabilizer was a term used to describe a general category of equipment used in various spacecraft that were used to keep equipment or fields maintained at certain levels.

title: Staff deck
intro: The staff deck was an area aboard the starships.

title: Stamets
intro: The Stamets was a Federation Stamets-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet during the mid-23rd century.

title: Stamets type shuttlecraft
intro: The Stamets-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft design in use by Starfleet in the 2250s and 2260s. ()

title: Star cruiser
intro: A star cruiser was a type of large interstellar spaceship with offensive/defensive armament. This descriptive term was applied to Federation starships and was a synonym for cruiser.

title: Starbase
intro: A starbase, less commonly called starship base or command base, was a permanent support facility operated by Starfleet, consisting of space stations, drydocks, and/or ground installations. Starbases were hubs of activity and could serve multiple military and civilian functions. (e.g., ; ; )

title: Starbase 0834
intro: Starbase 0834, abbreviated SB0834, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet in the Beta Quadrant. This base was located in Sector 001.

title: Starbase 1
intro: Starbase 1, abbreviated as SB1, was a Federation space station administered by Starfleet. Located in the Sol system, it was considered to be one of Starfleet's oldest and most venerable installations. ()

title: Starbase 1 (alternate reality)
intro: In the , Starbase 1 was a spacedock in Earth orbit and was constructed some time prior to 2258. ()
