title: Starbase 103
intro: Starbase 103, abbreviated as SB103, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. Located in the Alpha Quadrant, this was the nearest starbase to the Lorenze Cluster and its planet Minos.

title: Starbase 105
intro: Starbase 105, abbreviated as SB105, was a Federation starbase located in the Beta Quadrant, administrated by Starfleet.

title: Starbase 11
intro: Starbase 11, abbreviated as SB11, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This starbase, located on planet M-11, was in the Alpha Quadrant. The base had repair and maintenance facilities for starships and at least some facilities were located on the planetary surface. In 2267, command of Starbase 11 passed from Commodore to Commodore Mendez. Starbase 11 was located approximately 2 light years away from Talos IV. (; )

title: Starbase 117
intro: Starbase 117, abbreviated as SB117, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This base, located in the Beta Quadrant, was in operation as early as 2257. ()

title: Starbase 118
intro: Starbase 118 was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet.

One function of the starbase was as a patrol base for starships patrolling the Federation-Romulan border. (; )

title: Starbase 121
intro: Starbase 121, abbreviated as SB121, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This starbase was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 123, abbreviated as SB123, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This starbase was located in the Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 13, abbreviated as SB13, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This base was located in the Alpha Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 133, abbreviated as SB133, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. The space station orbited a planet that was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 134 was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. The outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 137 was a Federation starbase in operation during the mid-24th century.

intro: Starbase 14, abbreviated SB14, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. The starbase was located in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 152, abbreviated as SB152, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This base, located in the Beta Quadrant, was in operation as early as 2257. ()

title: Starbase 153
intro: Starbase 153, abbreviated as SB153, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This starbase was located in the Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 157, abbreviated as SB157, was a Federation starbase administrated by Starfleet. This starbase was located in the Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 17, abbreviated as SB17, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This base was located in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Starbase 172
intro: Starbase 172 was a Federation starbase administrated by Starfleet.

title: Starbase 173
intro: Starbase 173, abbreviated as SB173, was a Federation space station that was in service with Starfleet for many centuries. This starbase was located in Sector 23, Beta Quadrant.

title: Starbase 174
intro: Starbase 174, abbreviated as SB174, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. This starbase was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

intro: Starbase 185, abbreviated as SB185, was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet. The starbase was located in the Beta Quadrant.

title: Starbase 19

title: Starliner
intro: A starliner, liner, or passenger ship was a type of starship dedicated to transporting passengers from one destination to another; those that focused on comfort cruises were known as luxury liners or pleasure craft.

title: Starship
intro: A starship was any manned spacecraft that was capable of viable interstellar travel, i.e. any manned spacecraft that could transport and support a crew across interstellar distances. Most starships accomplished this via the employment of some form of faster-than-light spacecraft propulsion technology, such as warp drive.

title: Starship class
intro: The Starship-class was a spacecraft classification used by the Starfleet from its inception in the mid-22nd century to the late-23rd century. The exclusivity of the term "starship" as a class essentially fell out of use by the late 23rd century, and was redefined as a term interchangeable with spaceship and spacecraft. Starship-class vessels, like the and the , were then referred to as heavy cruisers. (; ; ; ; )

title: Starship classification
intro: Starship classification or ship classification was terminology used to define a spacecraft based on distinction as a means of categorization.

title: Starships in the Dominion War
intro: The following is a list of starships known to have participated in the Dominion War. This included starships operated by Starfleet, as well as the Cardassian, Klingon and Romulan Empires.

title: Station K43
intro: Station K43 was a Federation station in the late-23rd century.

title: Stealth ship
intro: In starship classification, a stealth ship was a type of vessel which utilized stealth via the means of stealth technology.

title: Stealth technology
intro: Stealth technology was a description used of several types of technology used to remain undetected or invisible from sensors.

title: Steamrunner class
intro: The Steamrunner class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s. By the 2380s, Starfleet had built a smaller variant of this class, the .

title: Stella
intro: The Stella was a small 23rd century Federation Class J cargo ship that was in the possession of Harcourt Fenton Mudd in 2266. Although officially designated as a cargo ship, Mudd was using it as a personnel transport.

title: Stellar cartography (section)
intro: Stellar cartography was an area of a starship dedicated to the science and practice of charting planets or space. It fell under the direction of the department head of stellar sciences department. ()

title: Stellar dynamics
intro: Stellar Dynamics was a department on board .

title: Stellar dynamics lab
intro: The stellar dynamics lab was a laboratory onboard .

title: Stellar physics
intro: Stellar physics was the field of physics which studied phenomenon within a star. It was distinguished from quantum physics and astrophysics, in the sense that the former studied subatomic particles and the latter studied whole star systems at a time. One studying stellar physics was called a stellar physicist. ()

title: Stellar sciences
intro: Stellar sciences was a science aboard the . It contained stellar cartography and spectral analysis, the latter employing at least several people. ()

title: Storage bay
intro: A storage bay was a type of facility in which various items were kept.

title: Straleb security vessel
intro: The Straleb security vessel was a Class 7 interplanetary starship commanded by Kushell, from the Legation of Unity, of the planet Straleb.

title: Structural engineering
intro: Structural engineering was a department aboard the .

title: Subsector 11
intro: Subsector 11 was an area aboard the Romulan-recovered Borg cube known as the that contained the queencell.

title: Subspace field tap
intro: Subspace field taps were part of the framework of a Federation starship like the .

title: Subspace tractor beam
intro: A subspace tractor beam was a technology initially conceived of by B'Elanna Torres in 2371, aboard the , when attempting to rescue what appeared to be a vessel trapped within the event horizon of a type-4 quantum singularity.

title: Subytt freighter
intro: Subytt freighters were a type of freighter employed by the Subytts during the late 24th century.

title: Suliban cell ship (cylindrical)
intro: Suliban cell ships were the primary ship types used by the during the mid-22nd century. They were armed with particle weapons and equipped with cloaking devices.

title: Suliban cell ship (spherical)
intro: Suliban cell ships were the primary ship types used by the during the mid-22nd century. They were armed with particle weapons and equipped with cloaking devices.

title: Suliban freighter
intro: The Suliban freighter was a type of starship operated by the during the 22nd century.

title: Suliban shuttle
intro: The Suliban shuttle was a small spacecraft employed by the Suliban, capable of atmospheric flight and landing.

title: Suliban stealth cruiser

infobox.caption: A vessel of the class, docked
infobox.caption2: A vessel of the class, docked and cloaked

intro: The Suliban stealth cruiser was a starship used by the Suliban . It was normally undetectable by Starfleet technology due to its cloaking device. Its armaments included four particle beam weapon banks. The standard crew complement was at least twenty.

title: Suliban transport
intro: The Suliban transport was a type of transport vessel in use by the Suliban in the mid-22nd century.

title: Supply and Maintenance
intro: Supply and Maintenance was a department located aboard starships of the mid-23rd century. This department was responsible for the supplying and maintaining of equipment for the ship's crew.

title: Supply ship
intro: A supply ship was a type of vessel used by various powers.

title: Support ship
intro: In starship classification, a support ship or support vessel was a type of starship that was used to support capital ships.

title: Surak (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Surak (VS-5047-61192259584-5) was a Federation-registered long range shuttle that was in service in the late 23rd century.

title: Surak class
intro: The Surak-class was a type of Vulcan starship used by the High Command during the mid-22nd century.

title: Surge tank
intro: A surge tank was a component of the NX-Alpha and NX-Beta.

title: Surgery bay
intro: The surgery bay was a section aboard starships where surgeries were performed.

title: Surplus Depot Z15
intro: Surplus Depot Z15 was a Federation surplus depot operated by the Zakdorn, located on and in orbit of Qualor II in Sector 213. The facility was responsible for salvaging useful components from decommissioned vessels before storing them in the depot. In the 2360s, its quartermaster was Klim Dokachin.

title: Surveillance satellite
intro: A surveillance satellite or spy satellite was a type of artificial satellite used to spy on a country.

title: Survey probe
intro: A survey probe was a type of probe used by Starfleet to conduct surveys in the 24th century.

title: Survey ship
intro: In starship classification, a survey ship or survey vessel was a specialized type of starship designed for conducting surveys. They shared many common features with both scouts and science vessels.

title: Suspiria's array
intro: Suspiria's array, also known as the Ocampa array, was a space station in the Delta Quadrant. Built by a Nacene individual known as Suspiria, it was similar to the Caretaker's array in configuration and surface composition, but only a tenth its size. According to scans taken by the , the facility was at least three hundred years old, as of 2372.

title: Sutherland class
intro: The Sutherland class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Suurok class
intro: The Suurok-class was a type of Vulcan starship designated by the High Command as a science vessel as early as 2136, and additionally used as a combat cruiser into the mid-22nd century. () At least some ships of the class remained in service well into the late 24th century. ()

title: Swarm ship
intro: Swarm ships were small, two-person craft left in large numbers on Altamid by the planet's original inhabitants sometime prior to the 2160s.

title: Swarm species vessel
intro: The Swarm species vessel was a vessel used by the Swarm species to protect their space from foreign vessels.

title: Sweet spot
intro: The "sweet spot" was a location aboard most starships in the 22nd century, where the artificial gravity field became inverted, leading to a reversal of the vertical orientation relative to the rest of the ship. Usually located approximately halfway between the bow plate and the artificial gravity generator, Travis Mayweather was familiar with it from growing up aboard the .

title: Sydney class
intro: The Sydney class was a class of relatively large personnel transport ship utilized by the Federation from the late 23rd century through as late as 2375. (; )

title: Synth ship
intro: "Synth ships" were a type of Starfleet starship in the late 24th century. They were armed with at least one phaser array and torpedo launcher, and featured a large white Starfleet insignia on their ventral and dorsal hull.

title: Systems monitor room
intro: The systems monitor room was an area aboard starships associated with the engineering department.

title: T'Lani cruiser
intro: A T'Lani cruiser was a type of starship utilized by the T'Lani during the late 24th century. This class of vessel greatly outmatched Starfleet's runabout in speed, firepower and defenses.

title: T'Met
intro: The T'Met was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Tal Shiar in the late 24th century. Commanded by Sub-Commander Almak, the T'Met led the force of three warbirds assigned to meet the after its hijacking by Romulan operatives in 2374.

intro: The T'Pau (NSP-17938) was a Vulcan Mahl'kom group transport that was in service with the Vulcan National Merchant Fleet in the mid-24th century.

title: T'Pau type
intro: The T'Pau-type was a design of Ni'Var starship in use in the late 32nd century. It featured an arrow-shaped primary hull within a ring-shaped warp nacelle, common to Vulcan starship design.

title: T'Plana
intro: The T'Plana was a Vulcan starship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command around 2052. The T'Plana and its crew were destroyed when it failed to outrun a class 5 neutronic storm. Details of this incident were recorded into the Vulcan database carried aboard starships.

title: T'Plana type
intro: The T'Plana type was a class of small starship first used by the Vulcans during the mid-23rd century for both private and official business. They remained in service through the late 24th century.

title: T'Plana-Hath (mirror)
intro: The T'Plana-Hath was a Vulcan vessel in service during the mid-21st century. It was the first Vulcan ship to land on .

title: T'Plana-Hath (starship)
intro: The T'Plana-Hath was a Vulcan survey ship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-21st century.

title: T'Plana-Hath type
intro: The T'Plana-Hath type was a type of warp-capable Vulcan starship in service between the mid-21st and 23rd century.

title: T'Vran
intro: The T'Vran was a Vulcan science vessel that was in service during the mid-24th century. In 2369, the T'Vran was on an exploration mission of the Gamma Quadrant. The T'Vran transmitted messages to other starships through a Vulcan band frequency.

title: Tactical Cube 138
intro: Tactical Cube 138 was a Borg tactical cube in service with the Borg in the 24th century.

title: Tactical data module
intro: A tactical data module was a device used on Federation starships such as the .

title: Tactical flyer
intro: The tactical flyer was a type of small attack fighter used by Starfleet. It was armed with phasers.

title: Tactical laboratory
intro: The tactical laboratory was a room aboard a Federation starship were the tactical officer could review data and plan further proceedings.

title: Tactical station
intro: The tactical station was one of the primary weapons control stations found on the bridge of a starship. This station allows the tactical officer to control the ship's phasers, torpedoes, and shields. 24th century Starfleet tactical stations also often access/control communications functions as well as the ship's long range sensors. The tactical station may also be known as the weapons console () or weapons station. ()

title: Tak Tak starship
intro: The Tak Tak starship was a type of starship in use by the Tak Tak during the late-24th century. Their weapons systems included torpedoes.

title: Takayama
intro: The Takayama was a Federation Takayama-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the . It was shuttle 5.

title: Takayama type shuttlecraft
intro: The Takayama-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type in use by Starfleet in the late 2250s and early 2260s. (; )

title: Tal's ship

title: Talak'talan's attack ship

intro: The Talarian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Talarians during the 24th century.

title: Talarian observation craft
intro: Talarian observation craft were a type of observation craft used by the Talarians during the mid-24th century for basic training. These ships could be operated with a crew of five.

title: Talarian warship

infobox.name: Talarian warship
infobox.caption: Vessels of the class, in formation
infobox.caption2: Two vessels of the class, compared with a Galaxy-class starship

intro: The Talarian warship was a type of warship used by the Talarians during the mid-24th century.

title: Talavian freighter
intro: A Talavian freighter was a cargo vessel of Talavian design.

title: Talaxian freighter
intro: A Talaxian freighter was a type of freighter operated by the Talaxians.

title: Talaxian garbage scow
intro: A Talaxian garbage scow was a type of garbage scow used by the Talaxians for transporting waste products.

title: Talaxian ship (2365)
intro: A Talaxian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Talaxians in the 2360s.

title: Talaxian ship (2373)
intro: The Talaxian ship was a type of small starship used by the Talaxians to defend their colonies. The ship was armed with a bow-mounted directed energy weapon and protected by shields, though it lacked transporter capability.

title: Talaxian ship (2378)
intro: The Talaxian ship was a type of small spaceship used by the Talaxians. It was equipped with torpedo tubes and shields. It could carry over 500 passengers, albeit with no room for anything else.

title: Talvath

infobox.caption: Dr. R'Mor at the communications station aboard the Talvath
infobox.name: ''Talvath''

intro: The Talvath was a Romulan science vessel that was in service in the mid-24th century. In early 2350, the Talvath, operating under the direction of Dr. Telek R'Mor of the Romulan Astrophysical Academy, began an extended three-year scientific mission.

title: Tamaal

infobox.name: Tamaal
infobox.location:
In a [[Unnamed Alpha and Beta Quadrant stars#Tamaal's system stars|binary star system]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: Tamaal was the fourth planet of a binary star system, located inside or near Enolian space. In 2152, the planet was home to a trading outpost with two million inhabitants.

title: Tamarian deep space cruiser
intro: The Tamarian deep space cruiser was an advanced starship-cruiser design utilized by the Tamarians in the 24th century.

title: Tamarian vessel 08

infobox.name: Tamarian vessel 08
infobox.caption: Port ventral view, facing a Galaxy-class starship

intro: "Tamarian vessel 08" was the Federation spacecraft ID for the Tamarian deep space cruiser commanded by Captain Dathon.

title: Tan Ru

infobox.name: ''Tan Ru''
infobox.caption: Tan Ru after merging with Nomad

intro: Tan Ru was an advanced alien probe of unknown origin and great power, programmed to collect and soil samples, possibly in anticipation of colonization.

title: Tandaran patrol ship
intro: Tandaran patrol ships were a type of patrol ship utilized by the Tandarans during the mid-22nd century.

title: Tandaran transport
intro: The Tandaran transport was a type of transport vessel in use by the Tandarans in the mid-22nd century.

title: Tanker
intro: In starship classification, a tanker was a starship with a limited role. Similar in purpose to a freighter, tankers were designed to carry large amounts of bulk fuel or other liquid-type substances.

title: Tanuga IV research station

infobox.name: Tanuga IV research station
infobox.location:
In [[orbit]] of [[Tanuga IV]]
[[Tanuga system|Tanuga]] [[star system|system]]
[[Unnamed Alpha and Beta Quadrant sectors#Sector containing Tanuga system|Unnamed sector]]
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: The Tanuga IV research station was a research station administrated by the Tanugans in the 24th century. This station was in orbit of Tanuga IV at a minimum distance of 5,000 kilometers. This planet was located in a sector of the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. The station was destroyed in 2366, on stardate 43610.3.

title: Tarchannen III

infobox.name: Tarchannen III
infobox.scaption: Building One on the surface of Tarchannen III

intro: Tarchannen III was the third planet in the Tarchannen system. This Class M planet was home to the Tarchanne. This planet was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.

title: Tarellian starship
intro: Tarellian starships (also referred to as Tarellian plague ships) were vessels used as late as the 2360s to carry Tarellian refugees, following the Tarellian Civil War. These ships were equipped with warp drive and transporter technology.

title: Taresian starship
intro: The Taresian starship was a type of patrol ship used by the Taresians in 2373.

title: Targ pit
intro: A targ pit was an area aboard a Klingon starship where targs were kept.

title: Target drone
intro: A target drone was a type of probe which could be launched from a starship.

title: Targeting control
intro: Targeting control was a function of a starship's tactical control systems, specifically, it was "means" of firing weapons, such as phasers.

title: Taris Murn
intro: In 2368, the Taris Murn and its three crewmembers were lost in a pocket of null space in their star system. While the phenomenon absorbed all the shuttle's energy, the backup systems maintained for as long as ten days. The shuttle was also able to still send out neutrino emissions from within the pocket to help locate it. The shuttle Magellan, piloted by William T. Riker and Soren, was able to rescue the crew. The Taris Murn was, however, deemed irretrievable. ()

title: Tarkalean freighter

infobox.name: Tarkalean freighter
infobox.caption: A Tarkalean freighter under attack by the Borg

intro: Tarkalean freighters were starships utilized by the Tarkaleans during the 22nd century. They had two decks and carried at least twenty-two crewmembers.

title: Tarkalean vessel
intro: Tarkalean vessels were starships utilized during the early 22nd century.

title: Tarod IX
intro: Tarod IX was the formerly inhabited ninth planet of the Tarod system. This planet's system was located in Sector 30, Beta Quadrant.

title: Tau Ceti (ship)
intro: The Tau Ceti was a Breen Imperium warship in service during the 32nd century.

title: Tau Ceti Deep Space Station
intro: Tau Ceti Deep Space Station was a deep space station in the Tau Ceti system. Located in the Alpha Quadrant, this station was approximately 12 light years from Sol.

title: Taxicab
intro: A taxicab (also, taxi and/or cab) was a form of public transport vehicle in which patrons paid to be taken to requested destinations. An operator of a taxicab was called a taxi driver.

title: Teldarian cruiser
intro: A Teldarian cruiser was a type of cruiser in service during the mid-24th century.

title: Telemetry probe
intro: A telemetry probe was a type of unmanned probe used by Starfleet in the late-23rd century. The probe could feed its sensor readings directly to the library computer and science officer of a starship.

title: Telev's battle cruiser
intro: Telev's battle cruiser was an Andorian battle cruiser that was captained by Telev during the mid-22nd century.

title: Tellarite cruiser
intro: The Tellarite cruiser was a class of cruiser utilized by the Tellarites during the mid-22nd century. These vessels were also utilized as Tellar sleeper ships, in which capacity some continued to function into the 24th century. ()

title: Tellarite escape pod
intro: A Tellarite escape pod was a type of one-occupant emergency vessel-escape vehicle used by the Tellarites aboard their cruisers during the 22nd century. Escape pods aboard surviving sleeper ships remained functional through the 24th century.

title: Tellarite freighter (20th century)
intro: The Tellarite freighter was a type of freighter used by the Tellarites during the 20th century.

title: Tellarite freighter (22nd century)
intro: Tellarite freighters were the backbone of the Tellarite Mining Consortium during the 22nd century.

title: Tellarite freighter (24th century)
intro: Tellarite freighters were a type of freighter used by the Tellarites during the 24th century.

title: Tellarite merchant ship
intro: The Tellarite merchant ship was a warp-capable type of 23rd century Tellarite freighter that included Tevrin Krit's D-756. ()

title: Tellarite ship
intro: Tellarite ships were vessels used by the Tellarites during the mid-23rd century, for questionable, possibly illegal mining operations, on Coridan.

title: Tellarite shuttle
intro: The Tellarite shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Tellarites in the mid-22nd century. It was capable of landing on a planet's surface, and had numerous armaments.

title: Tellarite station
intro: The Tellarite space station was a Tellarite supply base near the Klingon border in operation in the 22nd century, only a few days from Qo'noS.

title: Tellarite transport
intro: A Tellarite transport was a type of Tellarite starship utilized in the first half of the 22nd century used to transport passengers.

title: Telsian freighter
intro: The Telsian freighter was a type of cargo ship in use by the Telsians in the late-24th century.

title: Temperature control louver
intro: A temperature control louver was a piece of advanced technology aboard NASA's Mariner 2 space probe when it was launched in the mid-20th century.

title: Temporal core
intro: A temporal core was a central component of vessels which were equipped with time travel technology.

title: Temporal matrix
intro: A temporal matrix was an integral component of 29th century Federation timeships. The temporal matrix had to be precisely recalibrated when creating a temporal rift, otherwise the resultant unstable temporal field could lead to a massive temporal explosion.

title: Ten Forward
intro: Ten Forward was a lounge and recreation facility located on Deck 10, forward section 1 of a starship. ()

title: Teracaq (shuttle)
intro: In 3195, the Teracaq was assigned to transport prisoner Caleb Mir to the V'Rilik Penal Colony on . En route, Mir overpowered the two guards and the pilot and seized the controls, incidentally sending the shuttle into an out-of-control spiral. Mir used the shuttle to connect with Federation subspace relays and ordered its computer to search for prison records of his mother, but found nothing. However, the shuttle was then caught in a tractor beam, and afterward delivered Mir to the penal colony. ()

title: Teracaq type
intro: The Teracaq type was a type of Torothan prison shuttle in service in the late 32nd century. Piloted by a single pilot, the vessel could hold at least two guards and one prisoner, with room for more. ()

title: Teratogenic coolant
intro: Teratogenic coolant was a type of coolant. It was brown in color and sticky in texture. ()

title: Terellian cargo freighter
intro: A Terellian cargo freighter was a type of cargo freighter utilized by the Terellians during the 24th century. To the trained eye, they could be readily identified by their interior design. The cargo module utilized rechargeable power cells to function. They also carried a large supply of microfusion flares.

title: Tereshkova (2366)

infobox.caption: The Tereshkova on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Tereshkova''

intro: The Tereshkova was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft number 20.

title: Tereshkova (2366)

infobox.caption: The Tereshkova on a LCARS display
infobox.name: ''Tereshkova''

intro: The Tereshkova was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft number 20.

title: Tereshkova (2371)
intro: The Tereshkova was a Federation Type 8 shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to . It was shuttlecraft 01.

title: Terix
intro: The Terix was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the late 24th century. Commanded by Commander Sirol, the Terix discovered a hull fragment from the Starfleet testbed vessel in the Devolin system in 2370. The warbird was subsequently ordered to find the rest of the ship. When the arrived with the same mission, Sirol claimed that the Terix was investigating gaseous anomalies.

title: Terok Nor (mirror)

infobox.name: Terok Nor
infobox.docking: 6 large [[docking pylon]] ports; 3 medium docking ring ports; 9 small docking ring ports; 6 [[landing pad]]s
infobox.caption2: The ISS Defiant under construction using Terok Nor's docking scaffold

intro: Terok Nor was a space station built under the authority of the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance in orbit of .

title: Terran Empire shuttlecraft
intro: The shuttlecraft and shuttlepods of the Terran Empire in the mirror universe. (; )

title: Terran fighter
intro: A Terran fighter was a type of medium-sized craft used by the Terran Resistance Forces in the mirror universe against the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance during the 2370s.

title: Terran raider

infobox.name: Terran raider
infobox.image: Terran raider fighting off the Regent's forces.jpg
infobox.caption: Terran raider evading a photon torpedo fired by Worf's forces

intro: The Terran raider was a type of small craft used during the late 24th century by the Terran Resistance Forces in the mirror universe against the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance, who referred to the vessel as a Rebel raider.

title: Terrasphere 8
intro: Terrasphere 8 was one of about a dozen environmental domes, known as terraspheres, built by Species 8472 throughout the Delta Quadrant to train its people for eventual infiltration of Earth and the Federation. The facility contained an elaborate simulation of the Starfleet Headquarters and in San Francisco, Earth, and was occupied by the fluidic space lifeforms, who had been isomorphically altered to live as humanoids.

title: Tesnian escape pod
intro: The Tesnian escape pod was a small Tesnian craft used to evacuate a ship in an emergency. Tesnian starships were equipped with this type of escape pods.

title: Tesnian starship
intro: The Tesnian starship was a type of ship in use by the Tesnians in the mid-22nd century. They were equipped with escape pods and had a typical crew complement of 34.

title: Tetryon compositor
intro: The tetryon compositor was part of a Romulan-designed cloaking device. Damage to the compositor could prevent the cloak from working.

title: Texas class
intro: The Texas class was a type of Federation starship briefly operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. Commissioned by Vice Admiral Les Buenamigo in a misguided effort to compete with other Starfleet flag officers, it was the organization's first fully automated starship. All three vessels of the class malfunctioned and became unhinged due to faulty artificial intelligence, resulting in Buenamigo's death when he lost control of the and a subsequent attack on Douglas Station that ultimately led to the deranged vessels being destroyed by vessels of the .

title: Tezber (outpost)
intro: Tezber was an Acamarian outpost on the planet Acamar III. This outpost, in the Vackrinos District and near to Felker City, was home to a weapons supply depot.

title: Tezra
intro: Tezra was a owned and operated by Tellarite Captain Skalaar and his brother and first officer Gaavrin, operating under the authority of the Tellarite Mining Consortium in the 22nd century. Tezra was the first ship of her class, and the fastest ever built, as Skalaar retrofitted her engines himself. Tezra was able to haul one million metric tons of cargo at a maximum speed of Warp 4.5, something even the most powerful Earth vessels could not match.

title: Thasian ship
intro: The Thasian ship was a space-faring vessel utilized by the non-corporeal Thasians. Apparently energy-based, the ship took on the appearance of an indistinct, green mass of light.

title: The Egg

infobox.caption: The Egg, waiting to be launched
infobox.name: The Egg

intro: "The Egg" was the name of an advanced solar probe, designed during the 24th century by Doctor Paul Stubbs. Its purpose was to study a neutron star/red giant star system in the Kavis Alpha sector.

title: The Festoon
intro: The Festoon was a starship that was personally owned by the arms dealer Baron during the 2250s.

title: The Risa Bar
intro: The Risa Bar was a bar on the Cosmic Duchess named for the resort planet Risa. It was located in a biome with artificial sunlight, which was programmed to know when guests had been sufficiently tanned.

title: Theater
intro: A theater was a room in a building or on a ship where s, musical performances, and films were presented to an audience. (; ; )

title: Thermal array
intro: A thermal array was a heating element used in cooking food.

title: Thermal chamber
intro: Thermal chambers were extensively heated quarters used by Xindi-Reptilians on their ships. Because the Reptilians were cold-blooded, they frequently required the extra heat provided by the chambers' massive sunlamps to keep them energized and active.

title: Thermal imaging array
intro: A thermal imaging array was a part of a sensor array aboard Federation starships, like the .

title: Thermowave multiplexer
intro: Thermowave multiplexer was a type of technology used on Federation space stations in the 23rd century.

title: Theta class (starship)
intro: The Theta-class raider was a type of starship used by the Miradorn during the 2360s and 70s.

title: Think Tank vessel
intro: The "Think Tank" vessel was a type of starship operated by the "Think Tank", described by Kurros as being a "modest vessel". In reality, this vessel was incredibly advanced, as it was composed of a neutronium-based alloy that made it very resilient. The vessel spent most of its time hidden in subspace. Because of this, most vessels could not detect or attack it; the only indication of its presence was a brief subspace flux before it entered normal space. The vessel's offensive systems were impressive as well; the directed energy weapons (sixteen weapon hardpoints in all) were able to target and fire on multiple vessels at once.

title: Tholian asteroid dock
intro: The Tholian asteroid dock was a drydock facility constructed within an asteroid-moon that orbited a gas giant in the Vintaak system in the mirror universe. It was there that the Tholian Assembly, harbored the in 2155, unexpectedly obtained from the future of an alternate universe, for study and evaluation. ()

title: Tholian freighter
intro: A Tholian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Tholians in the 2370s.

title: Tholian ship (22nd century)

infobox.name: Tholian starship
infobox.caption: Forward view
infobox.crew: Could be operated by a single individual

intro: The Tholian starship of the 22nd century was a relatively small starship employed by the Tholian Assembly.

title: Tholian ship (23rd century)
intro: Tholian ships were small starships of characteristic shape, utilized by the Tholian Assembly during the 23rd century. These vessels were armed with plasma torpedo-like weaponry. But their most powerful weapon was the so-called "Tholian web". This web was "woven" by two or more Tholian vessels around an enemy ship. This web could be used as a high power immobilization field/tractor beam to pull captured starships back to Tholian territory. ()

title: Tholian vessel
intro: A Tholian vessel was a type of starship employed by the Tholians during the mid-24th century.

title: Thorn type
intro: The Thorn type was a class of Federation starship used by Starfleet during the 23rd century. It was equipped with a tractor beam capable of towing a vessel. ()

title: Throne room
intro: The throne room served as the seat of command for the Terran Empire's emperor and her flagship, the . ()

title: Ti'Mur
intro: The Ti'Mur was a Vulcan combat cruiser that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. The vessel was commanded by Captain Vanik, who assumed command in 2136.

title: Ticonderoga
intro: The Ticonderoga was an United Earth cargo ship that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

title: Tieran's ship
intro: Tieran's ship was a type of ship utilized by the Ilari during the late 24th century. One of these vessels was used by the Ilari tyrant Tieran, along with and Adin.

title: Time beacon
intro: A time beacon or time-base beacon is a device used by starships to synchronize their internal chronometers.

title: Time-pod
intro: A time-pod was a small vessel originating from the 26th century, which had the ability to travel through time.

title: Timeship
intro: Timeships were vessels which had undergone temporal transit. Some timeships were designed and constructed for that purpose, while others underwent time travel through accidental or external forces.

title: Titan (ship)

infobox.name: ''Titan''
infobox.caption: A model of the Titan in 2381

intro: The Titan was a spacecraft in operation sometime between the 20th and 24th centuries.

title: Titan II

infobox.name: Titan II
infobox.caption: Titan II rocket
infobox.caption2: A modified Titan II missile launch

intro: The Titan II was an American Human-rated expendable rocket that was in service with NASA and the United States Air Force in the mid-20th century. The rocket was used for national defense and space exploration.

title: Titan dedication plaque
intro: The following information was listed on the dedication plaque of . (, et al.)

title: Titan raider
intro: The Titan raider was a class of spacecraft used by the Humans from Titan for dilithium raids on Earth in the late 32nd century.

title: Titan ship
intro: The Titan ship was a spacecraft sent from Titan in the late 32nd century.

title: Toron class
intro: The Toron class was a type of small Klingon shuttle in service during the mid-24th century. It could be piloted by a single person.

title: Torpedo bay
intro: A torpedo bay was the area of a starship in which torpedos are stored, and the torpedo launcher can be accessed by personnel. In the bay, torpedoes were removed from storage and placed into the torpedo tubes immediately prior to launch.

title: Torpedo launcher
intro: Torpedo launcher or torpedo bank was a common term for systems that deployed projectiles such as torpedoes and probes. Polities known to have used such devices include the Cardassian Union, the Dominion, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, and the United Federation of Planets. A torpedo tube was a part of a torpedo launcher. Torpedo launchers could usually be accessed by personnel from a torpedo bay. (; ; ; etc.) Those torpedo launchers dedicated to firing photon torpedoes were called photon launchers.

title: Torpedo storage bank
intro: The torpedo storage bank was a section aboard starships for storing photon torpedoes. According to the systems alert diagram, there were at least two banks present on board the starships. Its location was labeled on a ship diagram of the . ()

title: Torpedo tube
intro: A torpedo tube was a compact area of a starship where torpedoes were stored immediately prior to launch. It was a part of the torpedo launcher. Tubes could be controlled from the bridge or from the torpedo bay or armory. ()

title: Torture chamber
intro: A torture chamber was a room equipped for carrying out torture.

title: Torus 4 Deep Space Research Outpost
intro: The Torus 4 Deep Space Research Outpost or Torus 4 Outpost was a Federation outpost located in a turbulent region containing several celestial objects.

title: Tosk's ship
intro: The Tosk's ship was a type of small spacecraft used by the during the late-24th century. Their engineering systems were equipped with arva nodes for collecting space matter and converting it into usable coladrium fuel. When in motion, the ship's engines also gave off detectable ionized L-band emissions, identical to that of the Hunters' ship.

title: Trabalian freighter
intro: A Trabalian freighter was a starship employed in the Delta Quadrant during the 24th century.

title: Tracking screen
intro: A tracking screen was a technological component found in the 21st century Earth space probe Nomad. ()

title: Tractor beam emitter
intro: A tractor beam emitter was a starship component that projects a graviton beam called a "tractor beam". This graviton beam was capable of either attraction or repulsion.

title: Tractor rig
intro: A tractor rig was a type of unmanned spacecraft used by Federation starships to give a boost to the tractor beam. The beam emitted from a starship would connect to a rig, instead of to the target. They were about the size of worker bees.

title: Trading vessel
intro: A trading vessel or trading ship was a type of starship used for trade.

title: Trager

infobox.name: ''Trager''
infobox.image2: Trager hit near aft shield generator.jpg

intro: The Trager was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century. Trager was under the command of Gul Macet.

title: Training division
intro: The training division was one of the many divisions a Federation starship could have. The primary purpose of the training division was the training of crew for the various tasks which were required in the daily running of a ship.

title: Training ship
intro: A training ship, or training vessel, also called a cadet ship or cadet vessel, was a starship that was used to train cadets to fly real starships. Typically, the training vessel's crew would go on training cruises.

title: Traitor's Claw
intro: The Traitor's Claw was a 23rd century Kzinti police vessel. It was officially recorded as stolen in 2269, but was in fact a privateer in service of the Kzinti government, in violation of the Treaty of Sirius.

title: Transducer matrix
intro: A transducer matrix was a section on a starship.

title: Transfer bridge
intro: The transfer bridge was a spacecraft component on the starships.

title: Transfer coil
intro: A transfer coil was a technological component of starships.

title: Transfer line
intro: A transfer line was a physical distribution mechanism utilized aboard 22nd century Starfleet vessels for the purpose of connecting the ship's central ventilation to the appropriate tank. The transfer lines could by rerouted to a different tank by recalibrating the switches on the control panel of the ship's atmospheric recycling manifold in sequence for the desired gas.

title: Transformer bank
intro: A transformer bank was an important component in starships, responsible for properly configuring the energy to be fed into the impulse engines.

title: Transkinetic chamber
intro: A transkinetic chamber was a component utilized aboard Federation starships in the 24th century, for the purpose of breaking down residual antimatter on the subatomic level.

title: Transport pod
intro: The transport pod was a type of spacecraft that allowed a single individual from the Sphere-Builders' trans-dimensional realm to be monitored in terraformed sections of the Delphic Expanse. The pod was believed to allow an individual's bio-signs to be recorded to gauge the effectiveness of the Sphere-Builder's terraforming of the Delphic Expanse, as numerous electrodes were hooked up to a test subject.

title: Transport ship
intro: In starship classification, a transport ship or ferry was a limited role starship, similar in function to a shuttle, but designed to carry people or supplies. Rarely, some transports were categorized as space cruisers. ()

title: Transport shuttle
intro: The Augment transport shuttle was a type of small shuttlecraft used during the 22nd century. Capable of being piloted by as few as two crew, this type of vessel was unarmed.

title: Transporter console
intro: The transporter console was a component of the transporter system. Located in the transporter room, it manually controlled the functions of the transporter and its maintenance. It was typically operated by the transporter chief or other operations division personnel.

title: Transporter room
intro: The transporter room was part of a starship or space station which was specially outfitted to transport lifeforms and small, inanimate objects. This room included a transporter chamber with a transporter platform.

title: Transverse bulkhead
intro: Transverse bulkheads were a technology developed by Tom Paris in an alternate 2374, Bulkheads were utilized by the ancient steamship , the honeycomb-like set of bulkheads of which would lower into place in case of a major hull breach, theoretically saving the ship even if half of it were filled with water.

title: Transwarp chamber
intro: A transwarp chamber was the section of a Borg vessel which housed the transwarp drive. Among the most important pieces of technology located in the chamber was the transwarp coil, the component responsible for the generation of transwarp conduits. Located deep within the ship, it was heavily shielded to prevent penetration by transporter beams.

title: Transwarp probe
intro: A transwarp probe was a robotic device capable of achieving transwarp velocities. It was designed to deliver and intercept communications between quadrants.

title: Trash exhaust
intro: The trash exhaust was a compartment aboard a starship. Crew could access this compartment by opening a hatch and climbing down a ladder. The internal space of the exhaust was circular. An exhaust had expulsion capability, which could jettison trash free of a ship's gravity well. There were at least twenty of these exhausts, with trash exhaust 20 located in the engineering hull. An exhaust's activation sequence could be controlled and monitored by personnel on the bridge.

title: Travel pod (23rd century)
intro: A travel pod was a small Federation shuttle predominately used during the 23rd century by facilities like the orbital office complex and Spacedock One to transfer personnel to drydocks or spaceships without having to use transporters. (, et al.)

title: Travel pod (25th century)
intro: A travel pod was a small Federation shuttle predominately used during the 25th century by facilities like Sol Station to transfer personnel to drydocks or spaceships without having to use transporters. ()

title: Travel pod 05 (23rd century)
intro: Travel pod 05 was a Federation that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to the various orbital docking facilities in orbit above Earth.

title: Travel pod 05 (25th century)
intro: Travel pod 05 was a Federation that was in service with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

title: Treaty port
intro: A treaty port was a type of base established by the Federation with the cooperation of non-Federation civilizations.

title: Trelka V Starbase
intro: The Trelka V Starbase was a Cardassian starbase administered by the Cardassian military in the 24th century. Near the Cardassian-Federation border, this base was in the Trelka system, Alpha Quadrant.

title: Tret's containment vessel
intro: Tret's containment vessel was a class of starship utilized by Tret's species to prevent any individual infected from the Loque'eque mutagenic virus from leaving the Loque'eque homeworld and infecting neighboring star systems. This class of vessel was armed with dual forward particle cannons, and were capable of exceeding warp 4. During the 2150s, a vessel of this class was commanded by Tret.

title: Triannon vessel
intro: The Triannon vessel was a type of starship class used by the Triannon species in the mid-22nd century.

title: Tricobalt satellite
intro: Tricobalt satellites were one of the computerized weapons employed by Vendikar during its five hundred year war with Eminiar VII.

title: Trill transport (2367)
intro: A Trill transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Trill during the mid-24th century.

title: Trill transport (2372)
intro: A Trill transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Trill during the mid-24th century.

title: Triona system

infobox.name: Triona system
infobox.location:
A [[Unnamed Alpha and Beta Quadrant sectors#Triona system sector|remote sector]],
[[Alpha Quadrant|Alpha]] or [[Beta Quadrant]]

intro: The Triona system was an inhabited star system located in a remote sector.

title: Triskelion Orbital Station

title: Troop transport
intro: A troop transport or troop ship was a type of military-type of transport ship designated to carry military troops.

title: Trophy room
intro: A trophy room was a room where trophies or relics were kept.

title: Tug
intro: In starship classification, a tug, tow ship, or towing vessel was a starship specialized for towing other starships or similarly large objects with tractor beams. () The term was also sometimes used for vessels that used physical attachments to pull chains of cargo containers. ( okudagram)

title: Turbolift
intro: The turbolift (also spelled turbo lift), or turbo-elevator, was a device that provided rapid transport with both vertical and horizontal transportation for personnel through a system of turboshafts between key sections of starships and space stations. The equivalent technology aboard Malon vessels was known as an ascender.

title: Turbolift control system
intro: The turbolift control system was a starship subsystem which controlled the operation of the turbolift system.

title: Turboshaft
intro: A turboshaft, or more precisely turbolift shaft, was a passageway allowing the turbolift to move through key sections of the ship.

title: Turei vessel
intro: The Turei vessel was a type of starship in use by the Turei in the late-24th century. These ships were heavily armed with plasma charge weapons.

intro: The USS Enterprise (NCC-1701) was a 23rd century Federation starship operated by Starfleet, and the first Federation starship to bear the name Enterprise. During its career, the Enterprise served as the Federation flagship and was in service from 2245 to 2285. During the latter years of its life, the Enterprise was converted into a starship to continue its missions of exploration, then assigned to Starfleet Academy as a training vessel until its destruction in 2285.

infobox.image2: USS Enterprise-D, These Are the Voyages.jpg

intro: The USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-D) was a Federation starship operated by Starfleet, and the fifth Federation vessel to bear the name. The Enterprise served from 2363 to 2371 as the Federation flagship, under the command of Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Following the ship's destruction at Veridian III, it was recovered, and slowly rebuilt as a museum ship. The Enterprise was nearing completion when in 2401, when she was utilized to repel a Borg attack. Following the successful defense of Earth, the Enterprise was finally retired to her permanent berth in 2402.

title: USS Passaro (NCC-52670)
intro: The USS Passaro (NCC-52670) was a Federation starship, formerly operated by Starfleet before it was appropriated by Nick Locarno for his Nova Fleet in the late 24th century. It was considered old and appeared to have been disused long enough for Starfleet to not notice that Locarno had stolen it. In 2381, it was commandeered and reclaimed by Lieutenant jg Beckett Mariner, but a trynar shield prevented her from escaping the Detrion system and thus returning the Passaro to Federation space. Mariner was ultimately forced to detonate a Genesis Device she had seized from Locarno and brought on board to prevent Locarno from reclaiming it, leading to the ship's destruction.

intro: The USS Prodigy (NCC-81084) was a Federation starship launched in 2385. The ship was commissioned in 2259 and it was launched from the Io Facility starbase, a spacedock in orbit of the Jovian moon Io. Its first, and only, commanding officer was Admiral . title: Unidentified flying object
intro: An unidentified flying object, or UFO, was a colloquialism of the 20th and 21st centuries, referring to any airborne object whose nature could not be adequately explained. These craft, also sometimes known as flying saucers, were often speculated to be of extraterrestrial origin, were usually dismissed by official sources as common phenomena such as sun dogs or weather balloons, at least publically. Typical actions attributed to them included the abduction of cows using a tractor beam and the creation of crop circles. ()

title: Vaadwaur assault fighter
intro: The Vaadwaur assault fighter was a small assault vessel used by the Vaadwaur in the 15th century. It was capable of operation both in an atmosphere and in space, and was armed with particle cannons.

title: Vaadwaur sentry satellite
intro: A Vaadwaur sentry satellite was a type of surveillance satellite used by the Vaadwaur. One such satellite was placed above the main city on the Vaadwaur homeworld, and survived in orbit of the planet for nearly nine centuries.

title: Vaadwaur ship
intro: This "Vaadwaur ship", as so described by Lieutenant Commander Tuvok, was the first vessel encountered by the starship in 2377, after Voyager was accidentally pulled into .

title: Vaankara
intro: The Vaankara was a Vulcan starship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century.

title: Vahklas
intro: The Vahklas was a Vulcan civilian transport commanded by Tavin, the leader of its crew of V'tosh ka'tur. The vessel used a Vulcan frequency to hail other ships and was capable of visual communication. The Vahklas left in approximately 2143.

title: Vahklas type
intro: The Vahklas-type was a class of Vulcan starship utilized during the mid-22nd century.

title: Val Jean
intro: The Val Jean was a small raider-type craft operated by the Maquis during the early 2370s. The impulse engines of Val Jean were originally built in 2332.

title: Valakian shuttle
intro: A Valakian shuttle was a small, pre-warp vessel used by the Valakians. In 2150, the Valakians launched four of these vessels to search for a cure for their plague by seeking help from more advanced species. The shuttle had propulsion modules located on the flanks of the hull above the wings, tapering inward towards the rear.

title: Valdore (starship)
intro: The Valdore was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military during the late 24th century, under the command of Commander Donatra.

title: Valdore type
intro: The Valdore type was a Romulan warbird design active in the 24th century.

title: Valerian transport
intro: A Valerian transport was a type of transport starship used by the Valerians in the 24th century.

title: Valtese ship
intro: A Valtese ship was a type of starship utilized by the Valtese during the latter half of the 24th century.

title: Vanoben transport
intro: A Vanoben transport was a type of transport starship used during the 24th century.

title: Varro generational ship
intro: A Varro generational ship was a starship operated by the Varro, first launched in the 1970s. The ship was equipped with fourteen warp reactors. During Voyager's encounter with the Varro, the Starfleet crew provided engineering assistance, including repair of the Varro's warp injectors. Rather than being a single ship in a large fleet, the vessel was comprised of many individual pods, which collectively housed several generations of Varro people. ()

title: Vau N'Akat ship
intro: The Vau N'Akat ship was a type of small vessel used by the Vau N'Akat in the late 24th century during the Vau N'Akat Civil War.

title: Vega Nine probe
intro: The Vega Nine probe was a deep space probe that was sent out by Starfleet to investigate the Beta Stromgren supernova explosion.

title: Vega colony
intro: The Vega colony was an Earth colony on a planet in the Vega system. Located in the Alpha Quadrant, this colony was located approximately 25 light years from Sol.

title: Velocity indicator
intro: A velocity indicator was a type of technology used on Starfleet Class 2 shuttles to determine how fast it was going.

title: Venari Ral ship
intro: The Venari Ral ship was a type of warship operated by the Venari Ral in the late 32nd century.

title: Venatic class
intro: The Venatic class was a type of hunting starship employed by the Hirogen during 2370s.

title: Vent
intro: A vent was an opening through which a gas or liquid could escape.

title: Ventilation system
intro: Ventilation systems, or ventilating systems, were used throughout buildings, starships, starbases, and other facilities, to direct and control the flow of breatheable atmosphere. (; )

title: Venus
intro: Venus (also known as Sol II) was the inhabited second planet of the Sol system. The planet was located in Sector 001, Alpha Quadrant.

title: Verteron probe
intro: A verteron probe was a device that emitted a massive verteron pulse. It could be used to disable warp-powered vessels.

title: Vetar
intro: The Vetar was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the late 24th century. It was commanded by Gul Evek, with Glinn Telak as executive officer. ()

title: Vidiian ship (2371)
intro: The Vidiian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Vidiian Sodality during the late 24th century. This class of vessel could be operated by a crew of two, and was evenly matched for speed with an starship.

title: Viewing lounge
intro: A viewing lounge was a room found in Federation starships in the 25th century. In 2401, there was a viewing lounge on deck 1 of the . ()

title: Viewport
intro: A viewport, or viewing port, or simply window, was a type of transparency used to see through a wall so as to view the outside of a starship or building. In nautical terms, porthole was specifically applied to ships.

title: Vindicta's Bird-of-Prey
intro: In Beckett Mariner's holo-movie Crisis Point: The Rise of Vindicta, Vindicta commanded a Klingon Bird-of-Prey of unknown class that possessed cloaking capabilities, and carried at least one boarding pod. ()

title: Viridian
intro: The Viridian was a heavy cruiser-class starship that served as the flagship of Osyraa, leader of the Emerald Chain, in the late-32nd century.

title: Vissian starship
intro: Vissian starships were advanced craft employed by the Vissians during the mid-22nd century.

title: Vissian stratopod
intro: The Vissian stratopod was a small two-person shuttlepod, utilized by the Vissians, equipped with a large round viewport at the . A stratopod carried twice the deflector shielding of the larger Vissian starships, and its navigation control was based on five spatial axes.

title: Vo'Nee
intro: The Vo'Nee was an in a dream experienced by Lieutenant Spock following a transporter accident in 2262.

title: Voltaire
intro: The Voltaire was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 03.

title: Vor'cha class
intro: The Vor'cha-class attack cruiser was one of the largest and most powerful mainstays of the Klingon Defense Forces during the mid- to late-24th century.

title: Vorok's battle cruiser
intro: Vorok's battle cruiser was a type of 22nd century Klingon battle cruiser that was in service during the early 2150s, under the command of Klingon Captain Vorok. The vessel was armed with forward and aft torpedo launchers, as well as an aft tractor beam.

title: Vostok 1
intro: The Vostok 1 was an early Earth spacecraft launched by the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics during the mid-20th century. In 1961, Vostok 1 carried the first Human into space, concluding with a single successful orbit.

title: Voth city ship
intro: The Voth city ship was a massive transwarp-capable starship that served as the center of the Voth civilization.

title: Voth research vessel
intro: The Voth research vessel was a type of starship used by the Voth for scientific research in the late-24th century. They were equipped with transwarp drives.

title: Voyager 1
intro: Voyager 1 was a deep space probe operated by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the 1970s. This probe, and Voyager 2, passed through the Jovian system and took images of the moon Europa in 1979.

title: Voyager 2
intro: Voyager 2 was a deep space probe operated by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the 1970s. This probe, and Voyager 1, passed through the Jovian system and took images of the moon Europa in 1979.

title: Voyager 6
intro: Voyager 6 was a deep space probe launched from Earth by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the latter half of the 20th century. The sixth probe in the Voyager series, it was designed to collect data and transmit it back to Earth. ()

title: Voyager series
intro: The Voyager series of space probes were unmanned spacecraft created by the American space agency NASA in the later half of the 20th century.

title: Vrek's starship
intro: Vrek's starship was a Romulan starship operated by the Romulan military in the late 24th century. The ship was equipped with a cloaking device, disruptors, and shields.

title: Vulcan cruiser (future)
intro: This Vulcan cruiser was a type of Vulcan starship that was commissioned sometime after 2152. It shared a similar design lineage with the , but instead of a single "hoop" warp nacelle, it contained three rings arranged in a clover-shaped arrangement.

title: Vulcan shuttle
intro: The Vulcan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft or transport used by the Vulcans in the early 2150s. They were about two decks high, and had a warp-ring drive, similar to most Vulcan combat cruisers of the time.

The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47561.4. The W.E.B. DuBois was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)

intro: The wardrobe section or uniform section was the department on the responsible for managing clothing under the command of the quartermaster. Aboard , this section functioned in much of the same way as the ship's store. ()

intro: A wardroom was a multipurpose room, usually used by senior commissioned officers as a mess or function room.

title: Warp pod
intro: A warp pod was a small warp-capable spacecraft utilized by the Terran Empire. It could hold at least two people.

title: Warp-capable vessel
intro: A warp-capable vessel or warp ship was a term used to describe any type of spacecraft that was capable of warp drive. This capability generally made the distinction between spaceships used spacefaring civilizations and starships of warp-capable civilizations.

title: Warp-plasma shaft
intro: A warp-plasma shaft was a highly radioactive crawlspace.

title: Warrant (shuttlecraft)
intro: The Warrant (registry NCC-1701/4) was a Federation Takayama-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

title: Warship
intro: In starship classification, a warship, war vessel, combat ship, or combat vessel was a general term for any armed starship designed for the purposes of combat or warfare. These vessels included battleships, battle cruisers, various sized cruisers, escorts, destroyers, and frigates.

intro: The warship Voyager was an incorrect Kyrian reconstruction of the , based on badly corroded schematics found in the Cyrik Ocean and an extremely biased perception of Voyager and her crew. It played a prominent role in The Voyager Encounter, a holographic simulation in the Museum of Kyrian Heritage, which depicted Voyagers biogenic attacks on the Kyrians at the start of the Great War. Quarren was aware that it would not be entirely accurate given the poor condition of the schematics, but he only became aware of how much he had gotten wrong after he activated a backup copy of The Doctor, who debunked the inaccurate history the simulation taught by bringing the true course of events on Voyager

title: Waste transfer barge
intro: A waste transfer barge was a type of ship used by the Federation to transfer waste.

title: Water turbine/pipe
intro: The water turbine/pipe was a spacecraft component on the starships.

title: Wave Matrix ETM Storage
intro: The Wave Matrix ETM Storage was a compartment aboard the space station Regula I for storing Wave Matrix ETMs. ()

title: Waverider
intro: The waverider was an atmospheric shuttlecraft in service aboard Federation starships. Unlike other auxiliary craft, the waverider was not stowed in a shuttlebay, but was instead docked to the ventral side of the primary hull, just forward of the ship's primary navigational deflector. ()

title: Weapons bay
intro: The weapons bay was an area on Federation starships where weapons were prepared and loaded.

title: Weapons department
intro: The weapons department was a department aboard Federation starships during the 2260s that was responsible for weapons control.

title: Weapons locker
intro: A weapons locker was a storage area for firearms aboard Federation starships, shuttlecraft, and outposts. These lockers were typically accessed through a simple touch interface or voice command to authenticate authorized access by Starfleet personnel.

title: Weapons pod
intro: A weapons pod was an exterior module that housed torpedo launchers on the aft roll bar of certain arrangements of starships, including the .

title: Weather balloon
intro: A weather balloon was a device used on 20th century Earth by the United States Army Air Forces and other agencies to assess wind speed and other meteorological conditions.

title: Weather satellite
intro: A weather satellite was a specialized artificial satellite dedicated to weather monitoring and meteorology.

title: Wells class
intro: The Wells class was a timeship used by Starfleet in the 29th century to protect the timeline against temporal incursions.

title: Weyoun 4's attack ship
intro: Weyoun's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship commanded by the fourth incarnation of Weyoun in late 2372. Also aboard were Omet'iklan, Toman'torax, Virak'kara and three other Jem'Hadar.

title: Weyoun 7's attack ship
intro: Weyoun's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship commanded by the seventh incarnation of Weyoun, during the Dominion War in late 2375. The ship transported Weyoun, the Female Changeling, and Legate Damar to a meeting with Thot Gor, during the final negotiations of the alliance between the Dominion and the Breen Confederacy. The ship also transported captured Starfleet officers Worf and Ezri Dax back to Cardassia Prime. ()

title: Whale Probe
intro: The Whale Probe was the designation for an immense probe of unknown origin which visited Earth in 2286. It was given this designation due to the fact that it apparently came to Earth in order to contact members of the humpback whale species.

title: Whorfin class
intro: The Whorfin class was a type of transport starship used by the El-Aurians in the late 23rd century. The class used YPS pulse fusion propulsion system, and had a maximum warp speed of warp factor 4.

title: Winston's trading vessel
intro: Winston's trading vessel was a small one-man civilian starship registered to Carter Winston, a Federation space trader.

title: Wisp ship
intro: The wisp ship was a starship inhabited by non-corporeal beings who were described as "wisps" by the crew of . Although the wisps who inhabited the ship were said to live in subspace, they relied on the ship so as to not be exposed to normal space, which they could not normally inhabit.

title: Woden
intro: The Woden (NCC-325) was a 23rd century Federation ore freighter operated by Starfleet. According to the Starfleet Registry, which listed the Woden, this ship was converted to automation, and Commander Spock described the ship as an "old-style" vessel.

title: Workbee

infobox.name:
Workbee
