{{small|Extricator}}
infobox.caption: A workbee with attached cargo containers.

intro: The workbee, also known as a cargo management unit or extricator, was a small utility spacecraft used by the Federation from the late 23rd and 24th centuries. It was an apparent successor to the worker bee from the 2250s.

title: Workbee (alternate reality)
intro: The workbee was a small utility craft operated by Starfleet in the 2250s and 2260s in the . (, )

title: Workbee storage
intro: Workbee storage was a section aboard starships for storing workbees.

title: Worker bee

infobox.name: Worker bee
infobox.caption: A worker bee investigating an interstellar relay

intro: A worker bee or CMU was a small auxiliary craft used by the Federation from the mid-23rd century to the late 24th century. Both the and her contemporary starship the carried a complement of worker bees.

title: Worker bee (32nd century)

infobox.name: Worker bee
infobox.caption: A worker bee using its arms to remove debris

intro: The worker bee was an auxiliary craft used by the Federation in the late 32nd century. Similar to its predecessors, it was a small one-person vessel with windows on all sides, equipped with a pair of manipulator arms.

title: Workpod
intro: The workpod was a small utility spacecraft utilized by the Federation in the late 24th century.

title: Wormhole relay station
intro: The wormhole relay station or relay satellite was a subspace relay station that allowed communications from the Alpha Quadrant to pass through the Bajoran wormhole into the Gamma Quadrant between stardates 48543.2 and 50564.2.

title: Wysanti starship
intro: The Wysanti starship was a type of warp-capable ship utilized by the Wysanti, who employed them in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.

title: X-15
intro: The X-15 was an American rocket plane of the mid-20th century. It was used jointly by NASA and the United States Air Force.

title: XCV
intro: This prefix was used by early Earth spacecraft, such as the (XCV-330) and the Scavenger ship (XCV-100). (; )

title: XCV-100
intro: XCV-100 was the registry of a ship built on Earth by the United States of America in the aftermath of World War III. It gained a fearsome reputation in space over the next 200 years as a monstrous scavenger ship, variously called Asaasllich, "Destroyer of Worlds" or Chach-Ka, "the Annihilator", or Astrovore.

title: Xantoras patrol ship
intro: A Xantoras patrol ship was a type patrol ship utilized by the Xantoras military during the 2150s.

title: Xarantine outpost
intro: The Xarantine outpost was an outpost in space known to have been inhabited or operated by the Xarantine.

title: Xarantine ship
intro: A Xarantine ship was a type of starship operated by the Xarantine during the 22nd century.

title: Xendi Starbase 9
intro: Xendi Starbase 9 was a Federation starbase administered by Starfleet in the Alpha Quadrant. This facility was located within the Xendi Sabu star system in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Xenoanthropology
intro: Xenoanthropology or astral anthropology was an extension of the field of anthropology that studied aliens' physical and cultural development. The had an astral anthropology department. One who studied in the field was known as a xenoanthropologist.

title: Xepolite Free Trader
intro: A Xepolite Free Trader was a type of starship utilized by the Xepolites during the late 24th century for hauling freight. These ships were built especially for weapons smuggling, notably for the Cardassians, as they had hulls that were composed of a sensor-reflective material that prevented scanning and were capable of the maximum speed of warp 9.8.

title: Xindi cruiser
intro: A Xindi cruiser was a type of cruiser employed by the Xindi during the 22nd century

title: Xindi launch platform
intro: The Xindi launch platform was a small Xindi structure used to house the prototypes of the Xindi weapon prior to deployment.

title: Xindi shuttle
intro: The Xindi shuttle was a small shuttlecraft used by the Xindi-Primates during the mid-22nd century. The vessel had a cockpit, and three adjustable landing legs that were positioned in a triangular layout, with two smaller struts at the rear, and the third extension being longer and positioned slightly forward of the others.

title: Xindi starship
intro: In 2152, a Xindi starship was attacked by an Osaarian merchant ship, two weeks prior to the 's encounter with the Osaarians.

title: Xindi-Aquatic cruiser

infobox.name: Xindi-Aquatic cruiser
infobox.caption2: Enterprise emerges from a ventral bay

intro: The Xindi-Aquatic cruiser was a type of starship used by the Xindi-Aquatics during the 22nd century. The vessel was at least 1,800 meters long, heavily armed, and equipped with the most advanced technology of any of the five Xindi species. The ship featured a hydrodynamic, swept-wing hull structure and a large hangar bay in the primary section that could be used to carry other starships. Despite also having superior weaponry, the Xindi-Aquatic ships had a drawback of being slower than other Xindi ships.

title: Xindi-Aquatic escape pod
intro: The Xindi-Aquatic escape pod was a type of small one-man escape pod of fairly typical design used aboard Xindi-Aquatic cruisers. This type of vessel was had no armaments, and was capable of maneuvering under water.

title: Xindi-Aquatic scout ship
intro: The Xindi-Aquatic scout ship was a Xindi-Aquatic starship used in the 2150s. It was much faster and more maneuverable then the Aquatics' main cruiser.

title: Xindi-Arboreal landing craft
intro: The Xindi-Arboreal landing craft was a class of shuttle utilized by the Xindi-Arboreals during the mid-22nd century.

title: Xindi-Arboreal starship

infobox.name: Xindi-Arboreal starship
infobox.caption: An Arboreal starship. (2153)
infobox.caption2: An Arboreal starship torn open by spatial anomalies (2154)

intro: The Xindi-Arboreal starship was a type of starship utilized by the Xindi-Arboreals during the 2150s.

title: Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttle

infobox.name: Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttle
infobox.caption: In flight, with spire extended
infobox.image2: Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttle in launch bay.jpg

intro: The Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft-sized two-person assault vehicle carried aboard Xindi-Insectoid starships. It was armed with a half dozen particle cannons and torpedo launchers. Much of its power was routed to structural integrity, allowing it to operate in the atmosphere of a gas giant or underwater.

title: Xindi-Insectoid patrol ship

infobox.name: Xindi-Insectoid patrol ship
infobox.caption: Two illusory vessels of the class
infobox.caption2: Three vessels of the class, pursuing a Xindi-Insectoid shuttlecraft

intro: The Xindi-Insectoid patrol ship was a small warp-capable starship utilized by the Xindi-Insectoids during the mid-22nd century. They were armed with at least one forward and one underbelly directed energy weapon emitters.

title: Xindi-Insectoid scout ship
intro: The Xindi-Insectoid scout ship was a type of warp-capable scout ship used by the Xindi-Insectoids. The vessel was much smaller than most Xindi ships, and only carried a crew of three.

title: Xindi-Insectoid starship
intro: The Xindi-Insectoid ship was a type of warship used by the aggressive Xindi-Insectoids in the 2150s.

title: Xindi-Primate starship

infobox.name: Xindi-Primate starship
infobox.caption: A vessel of the class, docked with Degra's ship

intro: The Xindi-Primate starship was a type of Xindi cruiser used by the Xindi-Primates in the 2150s.

title: Xindi-Reptilian warship

infobox.name: Xindi-Reptilian warship
infobox.caption: Degra's ship docked with a Xindi-Reptilian warship

intro: The Xindi-Reptilian warship was a large warship utilized by the Xindi-Reptilians during the mid-22nd century. They were capable of maintaining operations with a crew of twenty-two. ()

title: Xyrillian ship

infobox.name: Xyrillian ship
infobox.caption: Forward ventral view
infobox.caption2: The interior of a Xyrillian ship

intro: Xyrillian ships were utilized by the Xyrillians during the mid-22nd century.

title: Y class
intro: The Y-class freighter was a type of starship utilized by the Earth Cargo Service during the 22nd century.

title: Y-500 class
intro: The Y-500 class freighter was a vessel that was used during the 21st century. It was equipped with life pods. Y-500 class freighters were in service by 2088 and retired several decades prior to 2151.

title: YLT
intro: YLT was a registry prefix for Yridian shuttlecraft.

title: YLT-3069
intro: YLT-3069 was the registry number of an Yridian shuttle, operated by the trader Jaglom Shrek during the late 24th century.

title: Yarahla
intro: The Yarahla was a Vulcan starship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. The vessel was commanded by Captain Tok.

title: Yeager type
intro: The Yeager type was a type of Federation starship in use during the 2370s.

title: Yelikan transport
intro: A Yelikan transport was a type of transport in operation during the late 24th century.

title: Yellowstone class

infobox.name: ''Yellowstone'' class
infobox.caption: The prototype, USS Yellowstone, venting tetryon plasma

intro: In an alternate timeline, the Yellowstone-class runabout was an upgraded design of the runabout designed in the late-24th century. The Yellowstone-class was designed for a variety of mission profiles.

title: Yonada
intro: Yonada was a ten thousand-year-old asteroid ship, built by the Fabrini when they realized that their home sun was about to go supernova and completely destroy their solar system. Yonada was constructed to look like an asteroid and was sent on a computer-controlled course to a habitable colony world. The ship measured two hundred miles (320 kilometers) in diameter. Chemically, it was a typical asteroid; however, it was self-propelled by atomic power and could correct for gravitational stresses. The engines left behind a trail of debris and hard radiation. The ship could defend itself with chemically-fueled missiles.

title: Yorkshire
intro: The Yorkshire (NCC-330) was a 23rd century Federation starship operated by Starfleet.

title: Yorktown
intro: Yorktown, also known as Starbase Yorktown, Yorktown Base and Yorktown Station, was a massive Federation space station located on the frontier, near the Necro Cloud nebula, in the . Containing millions of individuals, it was Starfleet's newest and most advanced base as of 2263 and was commanded by Commodore .

title: Yosemite
intro: The Yosemite, also known as Shuttle 4, was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the .

title: Yosemite 3
intro: Yosemite 3 was an unarmed United Earth research station that was in service in the mid-22nd century. The space station orbited Earth and was usually manned with thirty to forty civilians.

title: Yosemite II
intro: The Yosemite II was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . This shuttle was a replacement for the Yosemite, which had been destroyed in 2381.

title: Yosemite class
intro: Yosemite-class was the original intended starship class designation of the , as it was listed in an okudagram in , before a later version of the graphic listed the Trieste as a starship. While the Trieste or any other ship of the Yosemite- or Merced-class has never made an on-screen appearance, confirms that Merced-class was the final and correct class designation of the Trieste.

title: Yost's ship
intro: Yost's ship was a starship assigned to Renovation Team Nova under the command of Supervisor Yost in the late 24th century in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Yridian ship
intro: A Yridian ship was a type of convoy vessel used by the Yridians.

title: Yridian shuttle
intro: The Yridian shuttle was a shuttlecraft-sized vessel utilized by the Yridians during the 2360s. Such a vessel was capable of traveling at warp speeds, and performing planetary landings.

title: Yridian starship
intro: The Yridian starship was a starship type used by the Yridians during the late 24th century as a destroyer and a freighter.

title: Yridian vessel
intro: The Yridian vessel was a type of small shuttlecraft in use with the Yridians during the 2160s. It was capable of being operated by a single individual.

title: Zahl starship
intro: A Zahl starship was a type of space vehicle operated in the Delta Quadrant in the late 24th century by the Zahl species.

title: Zalkonian escape pod
intro: The Zalkonian escape pod was a small craft designed for safe escape from Zalkonian vessels in case of emergency. Part of the computer system of the Zalkonian escape pod consisted of small gel-filled capsules.

title: Zalkonian warship
intro: The Zalkonian warship was a type of advanced warship utilized by the Zalkonians during the mid-24th century.

title: Zayra IV
intro: Zayra IV was an inhabited planet in its star system. A Federation starbase was located on this planet in the mid-24th century.

title: Zek's personal shuttle
intro: Zek's personal shuttle was the personal shuttle used by Grand Nagus Zek.

title: Zeon spacecraft
intro: A Zeon spacecraft was a type of pre-warp spacecraft utilized by the Zeon of planet .

title: Zibalian escape pod

infobox.name: Zibalian escape pod
infobox.caption: An aft view of the Zibalian escape pod
infobox.caption2: The interior of the escape pod

intro: The Zibalian escape pod was a small Zibalian craft used aboard Zibalian freighters for use during an emergency. They were berthed in the back of the ship's cargo bay and required two individuals to initiate the escape sequence.

title: Zobral's ship
intro: Zobral's ship was a small, warp-capable starship owned by Zobral during the mid-22nd century. Sleek and wedge-shaped, it could penetrate narrow gaps in the planetary defense system on without being detected.
